title.zh: 卷十一 本紀第十一: 代宗
title.raw: 卷十一 本紀第十一: 代宗 Volume 11 Annals 11: Daizong

meta.sourceNote: Body replaced from Wikisource raw text after ChineseNotes scrape due to glyph/encoding artifacts.

sentences.zh: 代宗睿文孝武皇帝諱豫，肅宗長子，母曰章敬皇太后吳氏。

translations.literal: Emperor Daizong, posthumous title Sagacious Literary Filial Martial, bore the taboo name Yu; he was Suzong's eldest son; his mother was Empress Zhangjing of the Wu clan.
translations.idiomatic: Daizong — styled Sagacious Literary Filial Martial, taboo name Yu — was Suzong's eldest son; his mother was Empress Zhangjing (née Wu).

sentences.zh: 以開元十四年十二月十三日生於東都上陽宮。

translations.literal: On the thirteenth day of the twelfth month of Kaiyuan 14 he was born at Shangyang Palace in the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: He was born on the thirteenth of the twelfth month, Kaiyuan 14, at Shangyang Palace in Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 初名俶，年十五封廣平王。

translations.literal: His original name was Chu; at age fifteen he was enfeoffed as Prince of Guangping.
translations.idiomatic: Originally named Chu, he became Prince of Guangping at fifteen.

sentences.zh: 玄宗諸孫百餘，上為嫡皇孫。

translations.literal: Among Xuanzong's more than a hundred grandsons, he alone was the legitimate imperial grandson.
translations.idiomatic: Of Xuanzong's hundred-odd grandsons, he was the sole legitimate heir in the male line.

sentences.zh: 宇量弘深，寬而能斷。

translations.literal: His bearing was vast and deep; magnanimous yet decisive.
translations.idiomatic: He was magnanimous and resolute, with a depth of presence that matched his stature.

sentences.zh: 喜懼不形於色。

translations.literal: Joy and fear did not show on his face.
translations.idiomatic: Neither joy nor fear ever showed on his face.

sentences.zh: 仁孝溫恭，動必由禮。

translations.literal: Benevolent, filial, warm, and courteous — in movement he always followed ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Benevolent, filial, and courteous, he let ritual govern every act.

sentences.zh: 幼而好學，尤專《禮》、《易》，玄宗鐘愛之。

translations.literal: From youth he loved learning, especially the Rites and Changes; Xuanzong cherished him.
translations.idiomatic: He loved learning from boyhood, above all the Rites and the Changes, and Xuanzong doted on him.

sentences.zh: 祿山之亂，京城陷賊，從肅宗搜兵靈武，以上為天下兵馬元帥。

translations.literal: In An Lushan's rebellion the capital fell to rebels; he followed Suzong to raise troops at Lingwu and was made commander-in-chief of all armies under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: When the capital fell in An Lushan's rebellion, he followed Suzong to Lingwu and was named supreme commander of the empire's forces.

sentences.zh: 時朝廷草創，兵募寡弱，上推心示信，招懷流散，比至彭原，兵眾數萬。

translations.literal: The court was then newly founded and recruits few and weak; he showed open heart and good faith, winning over the scattered — by the time he reached Pengyuan his forces numbered tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: With the court still fragile and troops scarce, he won stragglers by trust; at Pengyuan he commanded tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 及肅宗回幸鳳翔，時房琯、郭子儀繼戰不利，賊鋒方銳，屢來寇襲。

translations.literal: When Suzong returned to favor at Fengxiang, Fang Guan and Guo Ziyi met repeated defeats, the rebel spearhead was sharp, and raids came again and again.
translations.idiomatic: After Suzong reached Fengxiang, Fang Guan and Guo Ziyi kept losing; the rebels were at their peak and raided relentlessly.

sentences.zh: 上選求勇干，頻挫其鋒，聖慮遑寧，士心大振。

translations.literal: He selected the brave and capable, repeatedly blunted their edge; the sacred mind found no rest, yet soldiers' hearts greatly revived.
translations.idiomatic: He picked bold commanders, blunted rebel attacks again and again, and though the throne itself could not rest easy, the army's morale soared.

sentences.zh: 及師進討，百官辭送，步出闕門，方始乘馬。

translations.literal: When the army advanced to attack, the hundred officials took leave; he walked out the palace gate and only then mounted horse.
translations.idiomatic: When the host marched out, officials saw him off on foot through the gate before he at last mounted.

sentences.zh: 回紇葉護王子率兵入助，勇冠諸蕃，上接以優恩，結為兄弟，故香積之戰，賊徒大敗，遂委西京而遁。

translations.literal: The Uyghur Yabghu's prince led troops to aid; his courage topped all the foreign tribes — the Prince received him with generous favor and swore brotherhood, so at Xiangji the rebels were crushed and abandoned the Western Capital in flight.
translations.idiomatic: The Uyghur Yabghu's son brought allies whose valor outshone every tribe; the Prince treated him as a brother, and at Xiangji the rebels were shattered and fled Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 雖子儀、嗣業之奮命，由上恩信結於士心，故人思自效。

translations.literal: Though Ziyi and Siye fought with desperate valor, it was because the Prince's grace and trust bound the soldiers' hearts that men wished to give their utmost.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Ziyi and Li Siye fought fiercely, but the army fought for a prince who had earned their trust.

sentences.zh: 既收京城，令行禁止，民庶按堵，秋毫不犯，耆老歡迎，對之歔欷。

translations.literal: Once the capital was retaken, orders ran and prohibitions held; the people lived in peace, not a hair was harmed, elders came welcoming and wept before him.
translations.idiomatic: After Chang'an was recovered, discipline held and civilians were untouched; old men came weeping to greet him.

sentences.zh: 聞賊殘眾猶保陜郊，即日長驅，東趨虢洛。

translations.literal: Hearing rebel remnants still held the Shaanxi suburbs, that very day he drove hard east toward Guo and Luo.
translations.idiomatic: Learning rebels still held the approaches to Shaanxi, he pressed east the same day toward the Guo-Luo region.

sentences.zh: 新店之役，一戰大捷，慶緒之黨，十殲七八。

translations.literal: At the battle of Xindian one great victory; of An Qingxu's faction, seven or eight in ten were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: At Xindian he won a crushing victory, destroying seven or eight tenths of Qingxu's forces.

sentences.zh: 數旬之間，河南底定，兩都恢復，二聖回鑾，統率之功，推而不受。

translations.literal: Within several tens of days Henan was settled, both capitals restored, the Two Sages returned — the merit of supreme command he declined to accept.
translations.idiomatic: Within weeks Henan was pacified and both capitals restored; he refused credit for commanding the return of the two emperors.

sentences.zh: 肅宗還京，大赦，改封楚王。

translations.literal: When Suzong returned to the capital, a general amnesty was proclaimed and he was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: Suzong's return brought a great amnesty and his title became Prince of Chu.

sentences.zh: 乾元元年三月，改封成王。

translations.literal: In the third month of Qianyuan 1 he was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Qianyuan 1 he became Prince of Cheng.

sentences.zh: 四月庚寅，立為皇太子，改名豫。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on gengyin, he was established as crown prince and renamed Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the fourth month he was made crown prince and took the name Yu.

sentences.zh: 上元末年，兩宮不豫，太子往來侍疾，躬嘗藥膳，衣不角帶者久之，及承監國命，流涕從之。

translations.literal: In the last years of Shangyuan both palaces were ill; the crown prince went back and forth tending sickness, personally tasted medicines and food, long went without the angled belt of mourning dress — when he received the order to supervise the state he followed it in tears.
translations.idiomatic: When both emperors fell ill in Shangyuan's last years, the crown prince nursed them, tasted their food and medicine, and long wore plain dress; accepting regency, he obeyed in tears.

sentences.zh: 寶應元年寶應元年四月，肅宗大漸，所幸張皇后無子，后懼上功高難制，陰引越王系於宮中，將圖廢立。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of Baoying 1 Suzong was near death; the favored Empress Zhang had no son — the empress feared the crown prince's merit was too high to control, secretly brought Prince of Yue Li Xi into the palace, and plotted deposition and installation.
translations.idiomatic: In Baoying 1's fourth month Suzong lay dying; childless Empress Zhang feared the crown prince's power, smuggled Prince of Yue Li Xi into the palace, and plotted to replace him.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，皇后矯詔召太子。

translations.literal: On yichou the empress forged an edict summoning the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the empress forged an order calling the crown prince to court.

sentences.zh: 中官李輔國、程元振素知之，乃勒兵於凌霄門，俟太子至，即衛從太子入飛龍廄以俟其變。

translations.literal: Eunuchs Li Fuguo and Cheng Yuanzhen had long known of it; they mustered troops at Lingxiao Gate and, when the crown prince arrived, immediately escorted him into the Flying Dragon Stable to await developments.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fuguo and Cheng Yuanzhen, forewarned, seized Lingxiao Gate and, when the prince came, rushed him to the Flying Dragon Stable.

sentences.zh: 是夕，勒兵於三殿，收捕越王系及內官朱光輝、馬英俊等禁錮之，幽皇后於別殿。

translations.literal: That night troops were mustered in the Three Halls; Prince of Yue Li Xi and eunuchs Zhu Guanghui, Ma Yingjun, and others were seized and imprisoned; the empress was confined in a separate hall.
translations.idiomatic: That night they occupied the Three Halls, arrested Li Xi and several eunuchs, and confined the empress apart.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，肅宗崩，元振等始迎上於九仙門，見群臣，行監國之禮。

translations.literal: On dingmao Suzong died; Yuanzhen and others first received the Prince at Jiuxian Gate, had him see the ministers, and performed the regency rites.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Suzong died; Yuanzhen brought the prince to Jiuxian Gate to meet officials and conduct regency.

sentences.zh: 己巳，即皇帝位於柩前。

translations.literal: On jisi he took the throne before the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he ascended the throne beside the bier.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔：「國之大事，戎馬為先，朝有舊章，親賢是屬。

translations.literal: On jiaxu an edict stated: "State affairs of greatest weight put arms first; the court has ancient statutes — kin and worthies are entrusted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu an edict declared that in great affairs of state war came first, and that kin and the worthy should command the armies.

sentences.zh: 故求諸必當，用制於中權；

translations.literal: Therefore seek what must be fitting and employ it within central authority;
translations.idiomatic: The right man must be found and given command at the center;

sentences.zh: 存乎至公，豈慚於內舉。

translations.literal: keeping utmost fairness, how could one shrink from promoting from within?"
translations.idiomatic: with full fairness, without shame at an inner promotion."

sentences.zh: 特進、奉節郡王适可天下兵馬元帥。

translations.literal: Special eminence, Prince of Fengjie Li Shi, is fit to be commander-in-chief of all armies under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shi, Prince of Fengjie, is named commander-in-chief of all forces.

sentences.zh: 」乙亥，以兵部尚書、判元帥行軍、閑廄等使李輔國進號尚父，飛龍閑廄副使程元振為右監門將軍。

translations.literal: 」 On yihai the Minister of War and acting commander of the commander's campaign, Director of Studs and the like Li Fuguo was advanced in title to Sublime Father; Flying Dragon Studs deputy Cheng Yuanzhen was made Right Gate Guardian General.
translations.idiomatic: Thus ended the edict. On yihai Li Fuguo became "Sublime Father," and Cheng Yuanzhen Right Gate Guardian General.

sentences.zh: 流宦官朱光輝、啖庭瑤、陳仙甫等於黔中。

translations.literal: Eunuchs Zhu Guanghui, Tan Tingyao, Chen Xianfu, and others were banished to Qianzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Guanghui, Tan Tingyao, Chen Xianfu, and other eunuchs were exiled to Qian.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯朔，以李輔國為司空兼中書令，餘如故。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jimao new moon, Li Fuguo was made Grand Minister of Works and concurrently Grand Secretariat Director; the rest unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth month's jimao new moon Li Fuguo became Grand Minister of Works and chancellor as well.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，制曰：「三年之喪，天下達禮，茍或變革，何以教人？

translations.literal: On xinmao a proclamation stated: "Three years' mourning is the universal rite under Heaven — if one alters it, how may one teach the people?
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao a proclamation opened: three years' mourning was the world's rite — to alter it was to undo teaching.

sentences.zh: 朕遘此閔兇，攀號罔極，公卿固請，俾聽朝務，斬焉縗絰，痛貫心靈，豈可便議公除，遽移諒陰。

translations.literal: We have met this bereavement; wailing knows no limit; the dukes and ministers firmly beg that We hear court affairs — cut hemp and sackcloth pierce the spirit — how can We at once discuss public removal of mourning and hasten from the mourning hut?
translations.idiomatic: Struck by my father's death, I am beyond consolation; ministers urge me to govern, yet sackcloth still cuts to the bone — I cannot rush from mourning.

sentences.zh: 昨見所司儀注，今月十三日大祥，十五日從吉。

translations.literal: Yesterday We saw the ritual officials' schedule: this month's thirteenth day is the great felicity rite, the fifteenth the return to auspicious dress.
translations.idiomatic: Yesterday's ritual schedule set the thirteenth for great felicity and the fifteenth for auspicious dress.

sentences.zh: 仰憑遺制，又欲抑予，竅惟哀思，深謂未可。

translations.literal: Looking up to rely on the late emperor's testament yet again they wish to restrain Us — probing Our grief, We deeply deem it not yet possible.
translations.idiomatic: They cite my father's testament to restrain me again; in deepest grief I judge the time not ripe.

sentences.zh: 其百僚並以此釋服，朕將繼武丁之道，《素冠》之詩，恭默再周，不忍權奪。

translations.literal: Let the hundred officials all on this account remove mourning dress; We shall follow King Wu Ding's way and the Ode of the Plain Cap — twice a full cycle in reverent silence, unwilling to seize power by force.
translations.idiomatic: Let officials leave mourning; I will keep Wu Ding's silence and the Plain Cap ode two full cycles before I take power.

sentences.zh: 凡庶在位，宜悉哀懷。

translations.literal: All who hold office should share this grieving heart.
translations.idiomatic: Let every officer share this grief.

sentences.zh: 」宰臣苗晉卿等三上表請依遺制，方聽政。

translations.literal: 」 Chancellor Miao Jinqing and others thrice memorialized begging to follow the late testament before he at last heard government.
translations.idiomatic: Thus ended the proclamation. Miao Jinqing and other chancellors begged three times to follow the late edict before he took up rule.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，嗣魯王宇改封鄒王，奉節郡王适進封魯王，李光弼進封臨淮王。

translations.literal: On bingxu Heir Apparent Prince of Lu Li Yu was re-enfeoffed Prince of Zou; Prince of Fengjie Li Shi advanced to Prince of Lu; Li Guangbi advanced to Prince of Linhuai.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Li Yu became Prince of Zou; Li Shi became Prince of Lu; Li Guangbi Prince of Linhuai.

sentences.zh: 貶禮部尚書蕭華為陜州司馬。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Xiao Hua was demoted to Shaanzhou assistant prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Hua, Minister of Rites, was demoted to Shaanzhou.

sentences.zh: 改行乾元錢。

translations.literal: Qianyuan coinage was reissued.
translations.idiomatic: The Qianyuan currency was put back into circulation.

sentences.zh: 重棱小錢一當二，重棱大錢一當三。

translations.literal: Heavy-rim small coins counted one as two; heavy-rim large coins one as three.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy-rim small coins traded at two to one; large heavy-rim coins at three.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以戶部侍郎元載同中書門下平章事，充度支轉運使。

translations.literal: On bingshen Households Vice Minister Yuan Zai was made Grand Secretariat Associate and Director of Revenue and Transport.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Yuan Zai became chancellor and head of revenue and transport.

sentences.zh: 改乾元大小錢一當一。

translations.literal: Qianyuan large and small coins were changed to one for one.
translations.idiomatic: Large and small Qianyuan coins were again valued equally.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，御丹鳳樓，大赦。

translations.literal: On dingyou he ascended Danfeng Tower and proclaimed a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he proclaimed amnesty from Danfeng Tower.

sentences.zh: 子儀、光弼、李光進諸道節度使並加實封。

translations.literal: Ziyi, Guangbi, Li Guangjin, and the various circuit military commissioners all received increased substantive fiefs.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Ziyi, Li Guangbi, Li Guangjin, and other commissioners gained enlarged fiefs.

sentences.zh: 四月十七日立功人並號「寶應功臣」。

translations.literal: Those who had earned merit on the seventeenth day of the fourth month were all titled "Baoying Merit Lords."
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers meritorious on the seventeenth of the fourth month were named Baoying merit lords.

sentences.zh: 內外文武官三品已上進爵，四品已下加階。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials inside and outside of third rank and above advanced in noble rank; fourth rank and below gained steps in grade.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of third rank and above were promoted in rank; those below gained grade steps.

sentences.zh: 諸州防禦使並停。

translations.literal: Defense commissioners of all prefectures were all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: All prefectural defense commissioners were abolished.

sentences.zh: 內外官三考一轉。

translations.literal: Inside and outside officials were transferred once every three evaluations.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military posts rotated after three performance reviews.

sentences.zh: 益昌郡王邈進封鄭王，延慶郡王迥進封韓王。

translations.literal: Prince of Yichang Li Miao advanced to Prince of Zheng; Prince of Yanqing Li Jiong advanced to Prince of Han.
translations.idiomatic: Li Miao became Prince of Zheng; Li Jiong Prince of Han.

sentences.zh: 故庶人皇后王氏、故誣人太子瑛、鄂王瑤、光王琚並宜復封號。

translations.literal: The former commoner Empress Wang, the falsely accused former crown prince Ying, Prince of E Li Yao, and Prince of Guang Li Ju should all have titles restored.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wang, Crown Prince Ying, and Princes Yao and Ju — all wronged under Xuanzong — were to have honors restored.

sentences.zh: 棣王琰、永王璘並與昭雪。

translations.literal: Prince of Di Li Yan and Prince of Yong Li Lin were both cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yan and Li Lin were posthumously cleared.

sentences.zh: 建昌王追封齊王，崇恩王追封衛王，靈昌王追封鄆王。

translations.literal: Prince of Jianchang was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Qi; Prince of Chong'en Prince of Wei; Prince of Lingchang Prince of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Three princes were posthumously raised: Jianchang to Qi, Chong'en to Wei, Lingchang to Yan.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以來瑱復為襄州刺史、山南東道節度使。

translations.literal: On renyin Lai Tian was again made Xiangzhou prefect and Hedong South circuit military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Lai Tian returned as Xiangzhou prefect and South Shannan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉朔，百僚臨於西宮，上不視朝。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiyou new moon, the hundred officials attended at the Western Palace; the emperor did not hold court.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth month's new moon officials mourned at the Western Palace while the emperor stayed away from court.

sentences.zh: 自是每朔望皆如之，迄於山陵。

translations.literal: From then on every new and full moon was the same, until the mountain tomb was complete.
translations.idiomatic: He skipped court at every new and full moon until the burial was finished.

sentences.zh: 凡人臣有事辭見，先臨西宮，然後詣朝。

translations.literal: Whenever a minister had business to take leave and be received, he first attended the Western Palace, then went to court.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers with business first paid respects at the Western Palace, then entered court.

sentences.zh: 改豫州為蔡州，避上名也。

translations.literal: Yuzhou was renamed Caizhou, avoiding the emperor's name.
translations.idiomatic: Yuzhou became Caizhou to avoid the emperor's taboo name.

sentences.zh: 待中苗晉卿以老疾，請三日一入中書，從之。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant Miao Jinqing, aged and ill, asked to enter the Secretariat once every three days; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Miao Jinqing, old and ill, was allowed to attend the Secretariat every third day.

sentences.zh: 己未，罷尚父李輔國判元帥行軍及兵部尚書、閑廄等使。

translations.literal: On jiwei Sublime Father Li Fuguo was removed from acting commander of the commander's campaign, Minister of War, Director of Studs, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Li Fuguo lost his military, war ministry, and stud duties.

sentences.zh: 輔國請遜位。

translations.literal: Fuguo requested to yield his post.
translations.idiomatic: Fuguo asked to step down.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以輔國為博陸王，罷中書令，許朝朔望。

translations.literal: On xinyou Fuguo was made Prince of Bolu; Grand Secretariat Director was removed; he was permitted court at new and full moon.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he became Prince of Bolu, lost the chancellorship, and kept only new- and full-moon audiences.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以通州刺史劉晏為戶部侍郎、兼御史大夫、京兆尹，充度支轉運鹽鐵諸道鑄錢等使。

translations.literal: On renshen Tongzhou prefect Liu Yan was made Households Vice Minister, concurrent Censor-in-Chief, and Jingzhao prefect, charged with revenue, transport, salt iron, coinage of all circuits, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Liu Yan became revenue chief, censor-in-chief, and Jingzhao prefect, overseeing transport, salt, and coinage.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己卯朔。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jimao new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, jimao new moon.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，觀軍容使魚朝恩封馮翊郡開國公，宦官程元振為鎮軍大將軍、保定郡開國公。

translations.literal: On xinsi Army Viewing Commissioner Yu Chao'en was enfeoffed Duke of Fengyi commandery; eunuch Cheng Yuanzhen was made Great General Securing the Army and Duke of Baoding commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Yu Chao'en became Duke of Fengyi; Cheng Yuanzhen Great General Securing the Army and Duke of Baoding.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，襄州剌史裴義長流費州，賜死於藍田驛。

translations.literal: On yiyou Xiangzhou prefect Pei Yi was banished far to Feizhou and ordered to die at Lantian post station.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Pei Yi was exiled to Fei and forced to kill himself at Lantian.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔不許匭使閱投匭人文狀，賜道州司馬敬羽自盡。

translations.literal: On gengyin an edict forbade petition-box envoys from reading documents placed in the petition boxes; Daozhou assistant prefect Jing Yu was ordered to take his own life.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin petition-box inspectors were forbidden to read submissions; Jing Yu of Daozhou was ordered to commit suicide.

sentences.zh: 來瑱自襄州來朝。

translations.literal: Lai Tian came to court from Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Lai Tian arrived from Xiangzhou for audience.

sentences.zh: 郭子儀自河中來朝。

translations.literal: Guo Ziyi came to court from Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Ziyi came from Hezhong for audience.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉朔。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jiyou new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jiyou new moon.

sentences.zh: 自七月不雨，至此月癸丑方雨。

translations.literal: From the seventh month there was no rain; only in this month on guichou did rain fall.
translations.idiomatic: Drought since the seventh month broke on guichou of the eighth.

sentences.zh: 庚午夜，西北有赤光亙天，貫紫微，漸移東北，彌漫半天。

translations.literal: At midnight on gengwu a red light stretched across the sky in the northwest, pierced Ziwei, gradually shifted northeast, and filled half the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: At midnight on gengwu a red aurora crossed the northwest sky through Ziwei toward the northeast, flooding half the heavens.

sentences.zh: 貶太子少傅李遵為袁州刺史。

translations.literal: Heir Apparent Junior Tutor Li Zun was demoted to Yuanzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zun was demoted to Yuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 臺州賊袁晁陷臺州，連陷浙東州縣。

translations.literal: The bandit Yuan Chao of Taizhou took Taizhou and in succession took prefectures and counties of eastern Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Chao seized Taizhou and swept through eastern Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑朔，魯王适改封雍王。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dingchou new moon, Prince of Lu Li Shi was re-enfeoffed Prince of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Li Shi became Prince of Yong.

sentences.zh: 以山南東道節度使來瑱為兵部尚書，同中書門下平章事，節度如故。

translations.literal: Hedong South circuit military commissioner Lai Tian was made Minister of War, Grand Secretariat Associate; his commission unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Lai Tian became Minister of War and chancellor while keeping his command.

sentences.zh: 程元振進封邠國公。

translations.literal: Cheng Yuanzhen advanced to Duke of Bin.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Yuanzhen was made Duke of Bin.

sentences.zh: 丙申，右僕射、山陵使裴冕貶施州刺史。

translations.literal: On bingshen Right Vice Director Pei Mian, tomb commissioner, was demoted to Shizhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Pei Mian was demoted to Shizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，回紇登里可汗率眾來助國討逆，令御史大夫尚衡宣慰之。

translations.literal: On wuxu the Uyghur Ton-yabghu Qaghan led troops to aid the state in suppressing rebellion; Censor-in-Chief Shang Heng was ordered to comfort them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the Uyghur qaghan brought allies; Shang Heng was sent to welcome them.

sentences.zh: 甲午，太州至陜州二百餘里黃河清，澄澈見底。

translations.literal: On jiawu from Taizhou to Shazhou, more than two hundred li of the Yellow River ran clear, transparent to the bottom.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the Yellow River ran clear for two hundred li between Taizhou and Shazhou.

sentences.zh: 甲午，秘書監韓穎、中書舍人劉烜配流嶺表，尋賜死，坐狎暱李輔國也。

translations.literal: On jiawu Secretariat Director Han Ying and Secretariat Drafter Liu Xuan were banished to Lingnan; soon they were ordered to die — the crime was intimacy with Li Fuguo.
translations.idiomatic: The same day Han Ying and Liu Xuan were exiled to the far south and soon executed for currying favor with Li Fuguo.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛酉，詔天下兵馬元帥雍王統河東、朔方及諸道行營、回紇等兵十餘萬討史朝義，會軍於陜州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on xinyou, an edict ordered Commander-in-Chief Prince of Yong to command Hedong, Shuofang, and all campaign circuits plus Uyghur troops — more than a hundred thousand — to attack Shi Chaoyi, assembling at Shazhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Prince of Yong was ordered to lead over a hundred thousand troops, including Uyghurs, against Shi Chaoyi at Shazhou.

sentences.zh: 加朔方行營節度使、大寧郡王僕固懷恩同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Shuofang campaign circuit military commissioner, Prince of Daning commandery Pugu Huai'en was added Grand Secretariat Associate.
translations.idiomatic: Pugu Huai'en of Shuofang was made a chancellor as well.

sentences.zh: 丁卯夜，盜殺李輔國於其第，竊首而去。

translations.literal: On dingmao night thieves killed Li Fuguo at his residence and stole away his head.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao night assassins killed Li Fuguo and took his head.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，元帥雍王率諸軍進發，留郭英乂、魚朝恩鎮陜州。

translations.literal: On wuchen the commander Prince of Yong led the armies forward; Guo Yingyi and Yu Chao'en were left to guard Shazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Prince of Yong marched out, leaving Guo Yingyi and Yu Chao'en at Shazhou.

sentences.zh: 壬申，王師次洛陽北郊。

translations.literal: On renshen the imperial army halted at Luoyang's northern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the host camped north of Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，戰於橫水，賊大敗，俘斬六萬計。

translations.literal: On jiaxu they fought at Hengshui; the rebels were greatly defeated — captives and heads numbered on the order of sixty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu at Hengshui the rebels lost some sixty thousand killed or captured.

sentences.zh: 史朝義奔冀州。

translations.literal: Shi Chaoyi fled to Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Chaoyi fled toward Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，雍王奏收東京、河陽、汴、鄭、滑、相、魏等州。

translations.literal: On yihai Prince of Yong memorialized the recovery of the Eastern Capital, Heyang, Bian, Zheng, Hua, Xiang, Wei, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he reported retaking Luoyang and the Henan prefectures.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，陜西節度使郭英乂權知東京留守。

translations.literal: On yiyou Shaanxi military commissioner Guo Yingyi was made acting Eastern Capital garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Guo Yingyi became acting Luoyang commandant.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，偽恆州節度使張忠志以趙、定、深、恆、易五州歸順，以忠志檢校禮部尚書、恆州刺史，充成德軍節度使，賜姓名曰李寶臣。

translations.literal: On dingyou the false Hengzhou military commissioner Zhang Zhongzhi submitted Zhao, Ding, Shen, Heng, and Yi — five prefectures in surrender; Zhongzhi was made acting Minister of Rites and Hengzhou prefect, made Chengdé army military commissioner, and granted the surname and name Li Baochen.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Zhang Zhongzhi surrendered five Hebei prefectures, was made Chengdé commissioner, and renamed Li Baochen.

sentences.zh: 於是河北州郡悉平。

translations.literal: Thereupon all prefectures and commanderies of Hebei were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei was now fully pacified.

sentences.zh: 賊范陽尹李懷仙斬史朝義首來獻，請降。

translations.literal: The rebel Fan Yang prefect Li Huaixian cut off Shi Chaoyi's head and presented it, requesting surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Li Huaixian sent Chaoyi's head and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚戌，太子太師，邠國公韋見素薨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengxu, Heir Apparent Grand Tutor, Duke of Bin Wei Jiansu died.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month: Wei Jiansu, Duke of Bin and grand tutor to the heir, died.

sentences.zh: 辛未，僕固懷恩為尚書左僕射、兼中書令，靈州大都督府長史、河北副元帥。

translations.literal: On xinwei Pugu Huai'en was made Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, concurrent Grand Secretariat Director, chief administrator of Lingzhou metropolitan prefecture, and Hebei deputy commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Pugu Huai'en became left vice director, chancellor, Lingzhou chief, and Hebei deputy supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 邛州新置鎮南軍。

translations.literal: Zhennan army was newly established at Qiongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Qiongzhou gained a new Zhennan garrison.

sentences.zh: 是歲，江東大疫，死者過半。

translations.literal: That year a great epidemic struck Jiangdong; more than half died.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangdong suffered plague that year; over half the population perished.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃陷我臨、洮、成、渭等州。

translations.literal: Tibetans took our Lin, Tao, Cheng, Wei, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetans seized Lin, Tao, Cheng, Wei, and neighboring prefectures.

sentences.zh: 廣德元年二年春正月丁亥朔。

translations.literal: Guangde 1, in the first month of spring, on dinghai new moon.
translations.idiomatic: First month of spring, Guangde 1, dinghai new moon.

sentences.zh: 甲午，戶部尚書、兼御史大夫、都統淮南節度觀察等使、越國公李峘卒。

translations.literal: On jiawu Households Minister, concurrent Censor-in-Chief, overall commander of Huainan military and observation and the like, Duke of Yue Li Qian died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Li Qian, Duke of Yue and Huainan commander, died.

sentences.zh: 國子祭酒、兼御史大夫、京兆尹劉晏為吏部尚書、同中書門下平章事，度支諸使如故。

translations.literal: National University Chancellor, concurrent Censor-in-Chief, Jingzhao prefect Liu Yan was made Minister of Civil Appointments, Grand Secretariat Associate; revenue commissioners unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yan became Minister of Civil Appointments and chancellor while keeping his revenue posts.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，制開府儀同三司、行兵部尚書、同中書門下平章事、充山南東道節度觀察處置等使、上柱國、潁國公來瑱削在身官爵，長流播州，尋賜死於路。

translations.literal: On renyin a decree stripped Acting Three Excellencies, acting Minister of War, Grand Secretariat Associate, Hedong South circuit military and pacification commissioner, Upper Pillar of State, Duke of Ying Lai Tian of all ranks held in person, banished him far to Bozhou, and soon ordered his death on the road.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Lai Tian was stripped of rank, exiled to Bo, and executed en route.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊申，以史朝義下降將李寶臣為檢校禮部尚書、兼御史大夫、恆州刺史、清河郡王，充成德軍節度使；

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on wushen, Shi Chaoyi's surrendering general Li Baochen was made acting Minister of Rites, concurrent Censor-in-Chief, Hengzhou prefect, Prince of Qinghe commandery, and Chengdé army military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, wushen: Li Baochen was made Chengdé commissioner and Prince of Qinghe;

sentences.zh: 薛嵩為檢校刑部尚書、相州刺史、相衛等州節度使；

translations.literal: Xue Song was made acting Minister of Punishments, Xiangzhou prefect, and Xiang-Wei circuit military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Xue Song became Xiang-Wei commissioner;

sentences.zh: 李懷仙檢校兵部尚書、兼侍中、武威郡王、幽州節度使；

translations.literal: Li Huaixian acting Minister of War, concurrent Palace Attendant, Prince of Wuwei commandery, and Youzhou military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Li Huaixian became Youzhou commissioner and Prince of Wuwei;

sentences.zh: 田承嗣檢校戶部尚書、魏州刺史、雁門郡王、魏博等州都防禦使。

translations.literal: Tian Chengsi acting Minister of Households, Weizhou prefect, Prince of Yanmen commandery, and Wei-Bo circuit defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Chengsi received Wei-Bo and the title Prince of Yanmen.

sentences.zh: 二月甲午，回紇登里可汗辭歸蕃。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jiawu, the Uyghur Ton-yabghu Qaghan took leave to return to his realm.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jiawu: the Uyghur qaghan departed for home.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰朔，襄州右兵馬使梁崇義殺大將李昭，據城自固，仍授崇義襄州刺史、山南東道節度使。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiachen new moon, Xiangzhou right army commander Liang Chongyi killed great general Li Zhao, held the city in defiance, and was still appointed Xiangzhou prefect and Hedong South military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: Liang Chongyi murdered Li Zhao, seized Xiangzhou, and was rewarded with the commission.

sentences.zh: 丁未，袁傪破袁晁之眾於浙東。

translations.literal: On dingwei Yuan Dai defeated Yuan Chao's forces in eastern Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Yuan Dai crushed Yuan Chao in eastern Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 玄宗、肅宗歸祔山陵。

translations.literal: Xuanzong and Suzong were interred in the mountain tombs.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong and Suzong were buried in the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 自三月一日廢朝，至於晦日，百僚素服詣延英門通名起居。

translations.literal: From the first day of the third month court was suspended until month's end; the hundred officials in plain dress went to Yanying Gate to announce names and pay respects.
translations.idiomatic: Court was closed all third month; officials in mourning dress reported at Yanying Gate daily.

sentences.zh: 四月戊寅朔，太州依舊為華州，太陰縣為華陰縣。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on wuyin new moon, Taizhou was restored as Huazhou and Taiyin county as Huayin county.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month: Taizhou reverted to Huazhou; Taiyin to Huayin.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，河南副元帥李光弼奏生擒袁晁，浙東州縣盡平。

translations.literal: On gengchen Hebei deputy commander-in-chief Li Guangbi memorialized the capture of Yuan Chao alive; eastern Zhejiang prefectures and counties were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Li Guangbi reported Yuan Chao captured and eastern Zhejiang pacified.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，屬臣請上尊號。

translations.literal: Subordinate ministers requested the emperor be given an honorific title.
translations.idiomatic: Officials petitioned for an honorific reign title.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯朔。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on guimao new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, guimao new moon.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，尚書省試制舉人，命左右丞、侍郎對試，賜食如舊儀。

translations.literal: On bingyin the Ministry of Civil Appointments tested decree-examination candidates; Left and Right Vice Directors and Vice Ministers paired to examine them; food was granted as in old ritual.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin decree examinations were held with vice ministers as examiners and the old feast granted.

sentences.zh: 太常卿杜鴻漸奏：「婚葬合給鹵簿，望於國立大功及二等已上親則給，餘不在給限。

translations.literal: Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Du Hongjian memorialized: "Wedding and funeral processions should receive guard of honor — We hope that for those who established great merit for the state and for kin of second rank and above it be granted; the rest are outside the limit of grant.
translations.idiomatic: Du Hongjian urged that funeral and wedding escorts be granted only to great merit-holders and kin of second rank or higher.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」 It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Thus ended the memorial; it was approved.

sentences.zh: 六月癸酉朔。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on guiyou new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, guiyou new moon.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以陳鄭澤潞節度使李抱玉檢校司空，封武威郡王；

translations.literal: On guiwei Chen-Zheng-Ze-Lu military commissioner Li Baoyu was made acting Grand Minister of Works and enfeoffed Prince of Wuwei commandery;
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Li Baoyu became acting grand minister of works and Prince of Wuwei;

sentences.zh: 河中節度使王昂檢校刑部尚書，封䢵國公；

translations.literal: Hezhong military commissioner Wang Ang was made acting Minister of Punishments and enfeoffed Duke of Yi commandery;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ang became acting minister of punishments and Duke of Yi;

sentences.zh: 同華節度使李懷讓檢校工部尚書。

translations.literal: Tong-Hua military commissioner Li Huairang was made acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Li Huairang became acting Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 同日入省，宰相送上。

translations.literal: The same day they entered the Secretariat; the chancellor presented them.
translations.idiomatic: All three entered the Secretariat that day at the chancellor's presentation.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以前淮西節度使王仲升為右羽林大將軍，兼御史大夫。

translations.literal: On jiashen former Huai-Xi military commissioner Wang Zhongsheng was made Right Forest General of the Guard and concurrent Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Wang Zhongsheng became right guard general and censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 六軍將軍兼大夫，自仲升始也。

translations.literal: Six-army generals concurrently holding the censor title began with Zhongsheng.
translations.idiomatic: Six-army generals holding the censor post began with Zhongsheng.

sentences.zh: 甲午，觀軍容使魚朝恩自陜州入朝。

translations.literal: On jiawu Army Viewing Commissioner Yu Chao'en entered court from Shazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Yu Chao'en arrived from Shazhou.

sentences.zh: 上御達禮門，命公卿百僚觀兵馬。

translations.literal: The emperor went to Dali Gate and ordered dukes, ministers, and the hundred officials to view the troops and horses.
translations.idiomatic: At Dali Gate he held a grand review for the court.

sentences.zh: 同華節度使李懷讓自殺，為程元振所構。

translations.literal: Tong-Hua military commissioner Li Huairang killed himself, framed by Cheng Yuanzhen.
translations.idiomatic: Li Huairang committed suicide after Cheng Yuanzhen framed him.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅朔。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on renyin new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renyin new moon.

sentences.zh: 戊申，群臣上尊號曰寶應元聖文武皇帝，御含元殿受冊。

translations.literal: On wushen the ministers presented the honorific Sagacious Martial of Baoying and Primordial Sage; he received the seal at Hanyuan Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he took the title Sagacious Martial of Baoying and Primordial Sage at Hanyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 壬子，御宣政殿宣制，改元曰廣德，大赦天下，常赦不原者咸赦除之。

translations.literal: On renzi he went to Xuanzheng Hall to proclaim the decree, changed the era name to Guangde, and proclaimed a great amnesty under Heaven — even those normally excluded by routine amnesties were all pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he proclaimed Guangde, universal amnesty, and pardoned even crimes usually excluded.

sentences.zh: 安祿山、史思明親族應在諸道，一切原免不問。

translations.literal: Kin of An Lushan and Shi Siming on all circuits who should have been punished were all pardoned without inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: Relatives of An Lushan and Shi Siming were pardoned everywhere without question.

sentences.zh: 民戶三丁免一丁庸，租稅依舊每畝二升。

translations.literal: Households with three males were exempted one corvée laborer; land tax remained two sheng per mu as before.
translations.idiomatic: Three-son households lost one corvée; the land tax stayed two sheng per mu.

sentences.zh: 男子二十成丁，五十入老。

translations.literal: Men formed adult households at twenty; at fifty they entered old age.
translations.idiomatic: Adulthood began at twenty; old age at fifty.

sentences.zh: 元帥雍王兼尚書令，河北副元帥僕固懷恩加太保，回紇登里可汗進徽號。

translations.literal: Commander Prince of Yong was also made Director of the Imperial Secretariat; Hebei deputy commander Pugu Huai'en was advanced to Grand Mentor; the Uyghur qaghan received an honorific epithet.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Yong became director of the secretariat; Huai'en grand mentor; the Uyghur qaghan a new title.

sentences.zh: 功臣皆賜鐵券，藏名太廟，畫像凌煙閣。

translations.literal: Merit lords were all granted iron certificates, their names stored in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, their portraits placed in Lingyan Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: Merit lords received iron charters, temple inscription, and portraits in Lingyan Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 刺史、縣令自今後改轉，刺史以三年為限，縣令四年為限，員外及攝試，不得厘務。

translations.literal: Prefects and county magistrates from now on were transferred on fixed terms — prefects three years, magistrates four; supernumeraries and acting appointees might not administer affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Prefects rotated every three years, magistrates every four; acting officials could not govern.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，僕固瑒兼御史大夫，充朔方行營節度。

translations.literal: On dingsi Pugu Chang was made concurrent Censor-in-Chief and Shuofang campaign military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Pugu Chang became censor-in-chief and Shuofang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是月，吐蕃大寇河、隴，陷我秦成、渭三州，入大震關，陷蘭、廓、河、鄯、洮、岷等州，盜有隴右之地。

translations.literal: That month Tibetans raided greatly on the He and Long circuits, took our Qin, Cheng, and Wei — three prefectures — entered Dazhen Pass, and took Lan, Kuo, He, Shan, Tao, Min, and other prefectures, seizing the land of Longyou.
translations.idiomatic: That month Tibet overran Longyou, taking Qin, Cheng, Wei, and a chain of western prefectures through Dazhen Pass.

sentences.zh: 八月，以荊南節度使李峴為宗正卿。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Jingnan military commissioner Li Xian was made Director of the Imperial Clan Court.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: Li Xian became director of the imperial clan court.

sentences.zh: 九月壬戌朔，僕固懷恩拒命於汾州，遣宰臣裴遵慶往宣撫之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renxu new moon, Pugu Huai'en defied orders at Fenzhou; Chancellor Pei Zunqing was sent to comfort him.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Huai'en rebelled at Fen; Pei Zunqing was sent to pacify him.

sentences.zh: 已丑，吐蕃寇涇州，刺史高暉以城降，因為吐蕃鄉導。

translations.literal: On jichou Tibetans raided Jingzhou; prefect Gao Hui surrendered the city and became Tibetan guide.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Gao Hui surrendered Jingzhou to the Tibetans and guided them.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚午朔。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on gengwu new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, gengwu new moon.

sentences.zh: 辛未，高暉引吐蕃犯京畿，寇奉天、武功、盩厔等縣。

translations.literal: On xinwei Gao Hui led Tibetans to invade the capital region, raiding Fengtian, Wugong, Zhouzhi, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Gao Hui guided Tibetans against the capital suburbs.

sentences.zh: 蕃軍自司竹園渡渭，循南山而東。

translations.literal: Tibetan troops crossed the Wei at Sizhu Garden and followed the southern hills eastward.
translations.idiomatic: They crossed the Wei at Sizhu and marched east along the southern hills.

sentences.zh: 丙子，駕幸陜州，上出苑門，射生將王獻忠率四百騎叛，脅豐王已下十王歸京。

translations.literal: On bingzi the carriage went to Shazhou; the emperor went out the garden gate; archer-general Wang Xianzhong led four hundred horsemen in revolt, coercing the Prince of Feng and nine other princes to return to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the court fled to Shazhou; Wang Xianzhong mutinied with four hundred horse and forced ten princes back toward Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 從官多由南山諸穀赴行在。

translations.literal: Many in the entourage went by the southern-hill valleys toward the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: Much of the entourage escaped through southern valleys to join the emperor.

sentences.zh: 郭子儀收合散卒，屯於商州。

translations.literal: Guo Ziyi gathered scattered soldiers and encamped at Shangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Ziyi rallied broken units at Shangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，次華州，官吏藏竄，無復儲擬。

translations.literal: On dingchou the court halted at Huazhou; officials hid away; no stores were prepared.
translations.idiomatic: At Huazhou officials had fled and supplies were gone.

sentences.zh: 會魚朝恩領神策軍自陜來迎駕，乃幸朝恩軍。

translations.literal: When Yu Chao'en led the Divine Strategy Army from Shaan to welcome the carriage, the emperor then lodged with Chao'en's army.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Chao'en's Divine Strategy Army met him at Shaan, and the emperor lodged with them.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，吐蕃入京師，立廣武王承宏為帝，仍逼前翰林學士於可封為制封拜。

translations.literal: On wuyin Tibetans entered the capital, set up Prince of Guangwu Li Chenghong as emperor, and compelled former Hanlin academician Yu Kefeng to draft investiture documents.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Tibetans occupied Chang'an and enthroned Li Chenghong as puppet emperor.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，車駕至陜州。

translations.literal: On xinsi the carriage reached Shazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the emperor reached Shazhou.

sentences.zh: 子儀在商州會六軍使張知節，烏崇福、長孫全緒等率兵繼至，軍威遂振。

translations.literal: Ziyi at Shangzhou joined Six-Army commissioner Zhang Zhijie, Wu Chongfu, Zhangsun Quanxu, and others, who led troops in succession — military prestige revived.
translations.idiomatic: At Shangzhou Guo Ziyi linked with Zhang Zhijie and others until the army's spirit returned.

sentences.zh: 舊將王甫誘聚京城惡少，齊擊街鼓於朱雀街，蕃軍震懾，狼狽奔潰。

translations.literal: Former general Wang Fu incited the capital's ruffians to strike street drums together on Zhuque Avenue; the Tibetan army was shaken and fled in disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Fu rallied street toughs to beat drums on Zhuque Avenue, panicking the Tibetans into flight.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，子儀收京城。

translations.literal: On gengyin Ziyi recovered the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Guo Ziyi retook Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以宰臣元載判天下元帥行軍司馬，京兆尹、兼吏部侍郎嚴武為黃門侍郎，朗州刺史第五琦為京兆尹、兼御史大夫。

translations.literal: On renchen Chancellor Yuan Zai was made acting commander-in-chief's campaign chief of staff; Jingzhao prefect and acting Minister of Civil Appointments Yan Wu was made Yellow Gate Vice Director; Langzhou prefect Diwu Qi was made Jingzhao prefect and concurrent Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Yuan Zai ran the supreme headquarters; Yan Wu and Diwu Qi received capital and censor posts.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以郭子儀為京留守。

translations.literal: On guisi Guo Ziyi was made capital garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Guo Ziyi became Chang'an commandant.

sentences.zh: 高暉聞吐蕃潰，以三百騎東奔至潼關，為關守李伯越所殺。

translations.literal: Hearing the Tibetans had collapsed, Gao Hui with three hundred horse fled east to Tong Pass and was killed by pass defender Li Boyue.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Hui fled east and was killed at Tong Pass by Li Boyue.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛丑朔，太常博士柳伉上疏，以蕃寇犯京師，罪由程元振，請斬之以謝天下。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinchou new moon, Court of Imperial Sacrifices erudite Liu Kang memorialized that because Tibetans had violated the capital the fault lay with Cheng Yuanzhen and begged execution to appease the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: Liu Kang blamed Cheng Yuanzhen for the fall of Chang'an and demanded his head.

sentences.zh: 上甚嘉納，以元振有保護之功，削在身官爵，放歸田里。

translations.literal: The emperor greatly approved and accepted it, but because Yuanzhen had protective merit, ranks held in person were stripped and he was released to his home district.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised the memorial yet spared Yuanzhen for past service, stripping rank and sending him home.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰，宦官市舶使呂太一逐廣南節度使張休，縱下大掠廣州。

translations.literal: On jiachen the eunuch maritime-trade commissioner Lü Taiyi expelled Huainan South military commissioner Zhang Xiu and let his subordinates plunder Guangzhou greatly.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen eunuch Lü Taiyi drove out Zhang Xiu and looted Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，車駕發陜郡還京。

translations.literal: On dinghai the carriage departed Shaan commandery to return to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the court left Shaan for Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，鄂州大風，火發江中，焚船三千艘，焚居人盧舍二千家。

translations.literal: On xinmao a great wind struck Ezhou; fire broke out on the river and burned three thousand boats and two thousand households' dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: At Ezhou wind and river fire destroyed three thousand boats and two thousand homes.

sentences.zh: 甲午，上至自陜州。

translations.literal: On jiawu the emperor returned from Shazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the emperor came back from Shazhou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以侍中苗晉卿為太保，黃門侍郎、同平章事裴遵慶為太子少傅，並罷知政事；

translations.literal: On yiwei Palace Attendant Miao Jinqing was made Grand Mentor; Yellow Gate Vice Director and Associate Grand Secretariat Pei Zunqing was made Heir Apparent Junior Tutor — both removed from managing government;
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Miao Jinqing became grand mentor and Pei Zunqing heir-apparent tutor; both left the chancellery;

sentences.zh: 宗正卿、梁國公李峴為黃門侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Director of the Imperial Clan Court, Duke of Liang Li Xian was made Yellow Gate Vice Director and Grand Secretariat Associate.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xian entered the chancellery as yellow gate vice director.

sentences.zh: 丙申，放廣武王承宏於華州，一切不問。

translations.literal: On bingshen Prince of Guangwu Li Chenghong was released at Huazhou; all was not pursued.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the puppet emperor Li Chenghong was freed at Huazhou without punishment.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，朔方行營節度使僕固瑒為帳下梟首來獻。

translations.literal: On dingyou Shuofang campaign military commissioner Pugu Chang presented the severed heads of men under his command.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Pugu Chang sent heads of executed subordinates.

sentences.zh: 懷恩聞瑒死，燒營遁入吐蕃。

translations.literal: Hearing Chang was dead, Huai'en burned camp and fled into Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: When Chang died, Huai'en burned his camp and fled to Tibet.

sentences.zh: 朝臣稱賀，上不悅，曰：「朕之涼德，信不及人，致勛臣顛覆，用增愧恧，何至賀焉！

translations.literal: Courtiers offered congratulations; the emperor was displeased and said: "Our cool virtue and trust do not reach others, causing meritorious ministers to be overturned — how this increases shame! Why congratulate?
translations.idiomatic: When courtiers congratulated him, he refused: "My poor virtue destroyed loyal servants — what is there to celebrate?

sentences.zh: 」程元振自三原縣衣婦人服入京城，京兆府擒之以聞，乃下御史臺鞫問。

translations.literal: 」 Cheng Yuanzhen in women's dress entered the capital from Sanyuan county; the Jingzhao office seized him and reported — he was sent to the Censorate for interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: Thus ended his rebuke. Yuanzhen sneaked into Chang'an in disguise and was arrested for trial.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃陷松州、維州、雲山城、籠城。

translations.literal: Tibetans took Songzhou, Weizhou, Yunshan city, and Long city.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetans seized Song, Wei, and several border fortresses.

sentences.zh: 廣德二年二年春正月己亥朔。

translations.literal: Guangde 2, in the first month of spring, on jihai new moon.
translations.idiomatic: First month of spring, Guangde 2, jihai new moon.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，御史臺以程元振獄狀聞，配流溱州。

translations.literal: On renyin the Censorate reported Cheng Yuanzhen's case; he was banished to Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Yuanzhen was exiled to Qin.

sentences.zh: 既行，追念舊勛，特矜遐裔，令於江陵府安置。

translations.literal: After he had gone, recalling old merit, he was specially shown mercy in the far region and ordered settled at Jiangling prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Later, remembering his service, the court softened his exile to Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，復置京畿觀察使，以御史中丞領之。

translations.literal: On jiachen the capital-region observation commissioner was restored, led by the vice censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the capital observer post was revived under the vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，尚書右丞顏真卿為刑部尚書、兼御史大夫，充朔方宣慰使。

translations.literal: On guimao Right Secretariat Vice Director Yan Zhenqing was made Minister of Punishments, concurrent Censor-in-Chief, and Shuofang pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Yan Zhenqing became minister of punishments and Shuofang pacifier.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，吏部尚書、同平章事、度支轉運使劉晏為太子賓客，黃門侍郎、同平章事李峴為太子詹事，並罷知政事。

translations.literal: On guihai Minister of Civil Appointments, Associate Grand Secretariat, revenue and transport commissioner Liu Yan was made Heir Apparent Guest of the Crown; Yellow Gate Vice Director and Associate Li Xian was made Heir Apparent Household Administrator — both removed from managing government.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Liu Yan and Li Xian left the chancellery for heir-apparent posts.

sentences.zh: 以前右散騎常侍王縉為黃門侍郎，太常卿杜鴻漸為兵部侍郎，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Former Right Palace Companion Wang Jin was made Yellow Gate Vice Director; Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Du Hongjian was made Vice Minister of War — both Grand Secretariat Associates.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jin and Du Hongjian joined the chancellery.

sentences.zh: 罷度支使，以户部侍郎第五𤦺專判度支及諸道鹽鐵、轉運𨮾錢等使。

translations.literal: The revenue commissioner was abolished; Households Vice Minister Diwu Qi alone judged revenue and salt-iron transport and coinage of all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Diwu Qi alone took over revenue, salt, transport, and coinage.

sentences.zh: 甲子，元帥，尚書令雍王三上章讓皇太子。

translations.literal: On jiazi the commander, Director of the Secretariat, Prince of Yong thrice memorialized yielding the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Prince of Yong three times refused the heirship.

sentences.zh: 第五𤦺奏諸道置常平倉使司，量置本錢和糴，許之。

translations.literal: Diwu Qi memorialized that each circuit should establish Ever-Normal Granary commissioner offices, set capital to buy and harmonize grain — approved.
translations.idiomatic: Diwu Qi's plan for circuit Ever-Normal granaries was approved.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，司徒、兼中書令郭子儀充河東副元帥、河中等處觀察，兼雲州大都督、單于鎮北大都護。

translations.literal: On dingmao Grand Mentor, concurrent Grand Secretariat Director Guo Ziyi was made Hedong deputy commander-in-chief and observer of Hezhong and elsewhere, concurrent Yunzhou metropolitan chief and Chanyu Defender-General of the North.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Guo Ziyi took Hedong deputy command and northern frontier titles.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳朔，冊天下兵馬元帥，尚書令，雍王适為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jisi new moon, Commander-in-Chief, Director of the Secretariat, Prince of Yong Li Shi was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: Second month: Li Shi was made crown prince.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，上親薦獻太清宫、太廟。

translations.literal: On guiyou the emperor personally offered sacrifice at the Supreme Ultimate Palace and Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he sacrificed at the Supreme Ultimate and ancestral temples.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，祀昊天上帝於圓丘，即日還宫。

translations.literal: On yihai he sacrificed to the August Heaven at the Round Mound; that day he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he worshipped Heaven at the Round Mound and returned the same day.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以澧州剌史裴冕為左僕射兼御史大夫，充東都、河南、江南、淮南轉運使。

translations.literal: On wuyin Lizhou prefect Pei Mian was made Left Vice Director, concurrent Censor-in-Chief, and commissioner for Eastern Capital, Henan, Jiangnan, and Huainan transport.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Pei Mian became left vice director and transport chief for the east.

sentences.zh: 己未，第五𤦺開決汴河。

translations.literal: On jiwei Diwu Qi opened and cleared the Bian Canal.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Diwu Qi reopened the Bian Canal.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉朔。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on dingyou new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, dingyou new moon.

sentences.zh: 戊午，勑中書、門下兩省加置散騎常侍四員，官為正三品。

translations.literal: On wuwu an order added four Palace Companions without regular assignment to the Secretariat and Chancellery — rank regular third grade.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu four new third-rank palace companions were added to the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 𢈏申，罷𫞓貢孝悌力田、童子等科。

translations.literal: On shen the regional-recommendation categories Filial Piety, Diligence in Farming, and Youth were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Filial-piety and related examination categories were abolished.

sentences.zh: 甲子，禁鈿作珠翠等，委所司切加捉搦。

translations.literal: On jiazi inlay of pearls and kingfisher feather was forbidden; the responsible offices were ordered to seize it strictly.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi pearl and kingfisher inlay was banned with strict enforcement.

sentences.zh: 癸未，制：「太保、兼中書令、靈州大都督府長史、單于鎮北副大都護、充朔方節度、關內度支營田鹽池押諸蕃部落副大使、知節度事、六城水運使、河北副元帥、上柱國、大寧郡王僕固懷恩，先任靈州大都督府長史、單于鎮北副元帥、朔方節度使宜並停，其太保、兼尚書令、大寧郡王如故。

translations.literal: On guiwei a decree stated: "Grand Mentor, concurrent Grand Secretariat Director, chief of Lingzhou metropolitan prefecture, Chanyu Defender-General deputy, Shuofang military commissioner, Guannei revenue and garrison farms salt ponds controller of all foreign tribes deputy ambassador, knowing military affairs, Six Cities water transport commissioner, Hebei deputy commander-in-chief, Upper Pillar of State, Prince of Daning commandery Pugu Huai'en — his former posts as chief of Lingzhou, Chanyu deputy, and Shuofang military commissioner should all cease; Grand Mentor, concurrent Director of the Secretariat, Prince of Daning are unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Huai'en was stripped of Lingzhou and Shuofang commands but kept grand mentor and princely rank.

sentences.zh: 七月己酉，河南副元帥、太尉、兼侍中、臨淮王李光弼薨於徐州，廢朝三日。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on jiyou, Hebei deputy commander-in-chief, Grand Preceptor, concurrent Palace Attendant, Prince of Linhuai Li Guangbi died at Xuzhou; court mourning was suspended three days.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, jiyou: Li Guangbi died at Xuzhou; court mourned three days.

sentences.zh: 判度支第五琦兼京兆尹、御史大夫。

translations.literal: Acting revenue commissioner Diwu Qi was also made Jingzhao prefect and Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Diwu Qi added Jingzhao prefect and censor-in-chief to his revenue duties.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，宰臣王縉為侍中，持節都統河南、淮西、淮南、山南東道節度行營事，進封太原郡公。

translations.literal: On dingmao Chancellor Wang Jin was made Palace Attendant, holding credentials as overall commander of Henan, Huai-Xi, Huainan, and Hedong South campaign circuits, advanced to Duke of Taiyuan commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Wang Jin became palace attendant and eastern campaign commander, Duke of Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 固讓侍中，從之。

translations.literal: He firmly declined Palace Attendant; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: He refused the palace attendant post and was allowed to.

sentences.zh: 宰相杜鴻漸判門下省事。

translations.literal: Chancellor Du Hongjian judged Chancellery affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Du Hongjian took over the chancellery portfolio.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，王縉兼領東京留守。

translations.literal: On guisi Wang Jin also took acting Eastern Capital garrison command.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Wang Jin became acting Luoyang commandant as well.

sentences.zh: 九月乙未朔。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on yiwei new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, yiwei new moon.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔征河中兵討吐蕃，將發，是夜軍眾喧噪，劫節度使崔寓家財及民家財產殆盡，皆重裝而行，吏不能禁。

translations.literal: On bingshen an edict ordered Hezhong troops to attack Tibet; as they were about to march, that night the army clamored, plundered Military Commissioner Cui Yu's household and commoners' property almost completely, all marching with heavy packs — clerks could not forbid it.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Hezhong troops mutinied on the eve of marching against Tibet, looting their commander and civilians before bolting.

sentences.zh: 自七月大雨未止，京城米斗值一千文。

translations.literal: From the seventh month great rain did not cease; in the capital rice was a thousand cash per dou.
translations.idiomatic: Rain since the seventh month drove Chang'an rice to a thousand cash per dou.

sentences.zh: 蝗食田。

translations.literal: Locusts ate the fields.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts devoured the crops.

sentences.zh: 丙午，河東節度使辛云京檢校尚書右僕射、同中書門下平章事、太原尹、北京留守。

translations.literal: On bingwu Hedong military commissioner Xin Yunjing was made acting Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, Associate Grand Secretariat, Taiyuan prefect, and Northern Capital garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Xin Yunjing became chancellor and Taiyuan commander.

sentences.zh: 己酉，江南西道觀察，洪州刺史張鎬卒。

translations.literal: On jiyou Jiangnan West circuit observer and Hongzhou prefect Zhang Gao died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Zhang Gao, observer of Jiangnan West, died.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，河東副元帥、中書令、汾陽郡王郭子儀加太尉，充北道邠寧、涇原、河西已東通和吐蕃及朔方招撫使；

translations.literal: On xinhai Hedong deputy commander-in-chief, Grand Secretariat Director, Duke of Fenyang commandery Guo Ziyi was advanced to Grand Preceptor and made commissioner to harmonize with Tibet on the northern road, Binxia, Jingyuan, Hexi east of the pass, and Shuofang pacification;
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Guo Ziyi became grand preceptor and frontier commissioner against Tibet;

sentences.zh: 陳鄭、澤潞節度使李抱玉進位司徒，充南道通和吐蕃使、鳳翔秦隴臨洮已東觀察使。

translations.literal: Chen-Zheng-Ze-Lu military commissioner Li Baoyu advanced to Grand Mentor and commissioner to harmonize with Tibet on the southern road, Fengxiang, Qin-Long, Lintao east of the pass observer.
translations.idiomatic: Li Baoyu became grand mentor and southern frontier commissioner.

sentences.zh: 子儀三表懇讓太尉，許之。

translations.literal: Ziyi thrice memorialized earnestly declining Grand Preceptor; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Ziyi three times refused grand preceptor and was excused.

sentences.zh: 己未，劍南節度嚴武攻拔吐蕃當狗城，破蕃軍七萬。

translations.literal: On jiwei Jiannan military commissioner Yan Wu attacked and took the Tibetan fortress Danggou, breaking more than seventy thousand Tibetan troops.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Yan Wu took Danggou and shattered seventy thousand Tibetans.

sentences.zh: 尚書左丞楊綰知東京選，禮部侍郎賈至知東都舉。

translations.literal: Left Secretariat Vice Director Yang Wan supervised Eastern Capital selection; Vice Minister of Rites Jia Zhi supervised Eastern Capital examinations.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Wan ran capital selection; Jia Zhi ran Luoyang examinations.

sentences.zh: 兩都分舉選，自此始也。

translations.literal: The two capitals divided selection — from this it began.
translations.idiomatic: Dual-capital civil service exams began here.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以太子詹事李峴為吏部尚書、兼御史大夫，知江南東西及福建道選，並觀農宣慰使。

translations.literal: On xinyou Heir Apparent Household Administrator Li Xian was made Minister of Civil Appointments, concurrent Censor-in-Chief, supervising Jiangnan east and west and Fujian circuit selection, and farming-pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Li Xian took civil appointments and southeastern selection.

sentences.zh: 仍命洪州刺史李勉副知選事。

translations.literal: Hongzhou prefect Li Mian was still ordered to assist in selection affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Li Mian of Hongzhou was named his deputy in selection.

sentences.zh: 是秋，蝗食田殆盡，關輔尤甚。

translations.literal: That autumn locusts ate the fields almost completely; the Guan region was worst.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn locusts nearly stripped the fields; the capital region suffered most.

sentences.zh: 米斗千錢。

translations.literal: Rice was a thousand cash per dou.
translations.idiomatic: Grain again reached a thousand cash per dou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙寅，僕固懷恩引吐蕃二萬寇邠州，節度使白孝德閉城拒守。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on bingyin, Pugu Huai'en led twenty thousand Tibetans to raid Binzhou; military commissioner Bai Xiaode closed the city and refused defense.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, bingyin: Huai'en and twenty thousand Tibetans besieged Bin; Bai Xiaode held the walls.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，寇奉天，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: On dingmao they raided Fengtian; the capital was put on alert.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao they reached Fengtian and Chang'an went on alert.

sentences.zh: 先鋒郭晞斬賊營於邠州西，俘斬數百計。

translations.literal: Vanguard Guo Xi beheaded enemy camps west of Binzhou; captives and heads numbered in the hundreds.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Xi's vanguard cut down hundreds west of Binzhou.

sentences.zh: 子儀屯涇陽，蕃軍挑戰，子儀不出。

translations.literal: Ziyi encamped at Jingyang; the Tibetan army challenged battle — Ziyi did not go out.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Ziyi camped at Jingyang and refused battle when Tibet challenged.

sentences.zh: 甲申，河南尹蘇震卒。

translations.literal: On jiashen Henan prefect Su Zhen died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Su Zhen, Henan prefect, died.

sentences.zh: 劍南嚴武奏收吐蕃鹽川城。

translations.literal: Jiannan Yan Wu memorialized recovery of the Tibetan Yanchuan fortress.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Wu reported retaking Yanchuan from Tibet.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未，懷恩與蕃軍自潰，京師解嚴。

translations.literal: On yimao Huai'en and the Tibetan army dissolved on their own; the capital alert was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the invaders collapsed and the capital stood down.

sentences.zh: 丁未，子儀自涇陽入覲，詔宰臣百僚迎之於開遠門，上御安福寺待之。

translations.literal: On dingwei Ziyi entered audience from Jingyang; an edict ordered chancellors and the hundred officials to welcome him at Kaiyuan Gate; the emperor waited at Anfu Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Guo Ziyi was welcomed at Kaiyuan Gate while the emperor waited at Anfu Temple.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑，加子儀關內、河中副元帥兼尚書令，吏部侍郎暢璀為左散騎常侍、河中尹。

translations.literal: On yichou Ziyi was advanced Guannei and Hezhong deputy commander-in-chief and concurrent Director of the Secretariat; Minister of Civil Appointments Vice Director Chang Hui was made Left Palace Companion and Hezhong prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Guo Ziyi gained Guannei and Hezhong commands; Chang Hui became Hezhong prefect.

sentences.zh: 子儀三表讓尚書令，詞情懇切，優詔從之。

translations.literal: Ziyi thrice memorialized declining Director of the Secretariat; the wording was earnest — a gracious edict granted it.
translations.idiomatic: He three times refused the secretariat directorship and the emperor relented.

sentences.zh: 丁卯夜，星流如雨。

translations.literal: On dingmao night stars fell like rain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao night a meteor shower lit the sky.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，子儀於都省領副元帥事，宰臣百僚送，仍令射生五百戎服自光範門送至省門。

translations.literal: On wuchen Ziyi at the Imperial Secretariat assumed deputy commander affairs; chancellors and the hundred officials escorted him — still ordered five hundred archer-guards in martial dress from Guangfan Gate to the secretariat gate.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he took up deputy command at the secretariat under ceremonial escort of five hundred guards.

sentences.zh: 右僕射郭英乂以樂迎之。

translations.literal: Right Vice Director Guo Yingyi welcomed him with music.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Yingyi received him with music.

sentences.zh: 是日便赴奉天。

translations.literal: That day he at once went to Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: That same day he marched to Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 是歲，戶部計帳，管戶二百九十三萬三千一百二十五，口一千六百九十二萬三百八十六。

translations.literal: That year the Households Ministry tallied registers: administered households two million nine hundred thirty-three thousand one hundred twenty-five, mouths sixteen million nine hundred twenty thousand three hundred eighty-six.
translations.idiomatic: The year's census counted 2,933,125 households and 16,920,386 persons.

sentences.zh: 永泰元年永泰元年正月癸巳朔，制曰：

translations.literal: Yongtai 1, on jiasi new moon of the first month, a decree stated:
translations.idiomatic: First month of Yongtai 1, jiasi new moon, an edict declared:

sentences.zh: 是日雪盈尺。

translations.literal: That day snow piled a foot deep.
translations.idiomatic: Snow that day reached a foot deep.

sentences.zh: 戊申，澤潞李抱玉兼鳳翔隴右節度使，兼南道通和吐蕃、鳳翔「秦隴，臨洮已東」，觀察處置等使。

translations.literal: On wushen Ze-Lu Li Baoyu also took Fengxiang-Longyou military commissioner, and commissioner to harmonize with Tibet on the southern road, Fengxiang, Qin-Long, Lintao east observer and pacification.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Li Baoyu added Fengxiang-Longyou and southern Tibet pacification.

sentences.zh: 仍命四鎮行營節度使馬璘為副和吐蕃使。

translations.literal: Ma Lin, Four Garrisons campaign military commissioner, was still ordered deputy commissioner to harmonize with Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Lin was named his deputy for Tibet talks.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，罷岐州之鳳翔縣，並入天興縣。

translations.literal: On guimao Qizhou's Fengxiang county was abolished and merged into Tianxing county.
translations.idiomatic: Fengxiang county was merged into Tianxing.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，左散騎常侍高適卒。

translations.literal: On yimao Left Palace Companion Gao Shi died.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Gao Shi died.

sentences.zh: 戊午，劍南節度使嚴武加檢校吏部尚書，山南節度使張獻誠加檢校工部尚書。

translations.literal: On wuwu Jiannan military commissioner Yan Wu was advanced acting Minister of Civil Appointments; Shannan military commissioner Zhang Xianchéng was advanced acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Yan Wu and Zhang Xianchéng gained acting ministry ranks.

sentences.zh: 以前袁州刺史李遵為太子少保，聽朝朔望。

translations.literal: Former Yuanzhou prefect Li Zun was made Heir Apparent Junior Tutor, permitted court at new and full moon.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zun returned as heir-apparent tutor with limited audiences.

sentences.zh: 二月甲子夜。

translations.literal: On jiazi night.
translations.idiomatic: Night of jiazi.

sentences.zh: 雷霆震擊。

translations.literal: Thunder crashed.
translations.idiomatic: Thunder rolled across the sky.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，內出宮女千人，品官六百人守洛陽宮。

translations.literal: On dingchou the inner palace released a thousand palace women; six hundred ranked officials guarded Luoyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou a thousand palace women were released and six hundred officials garrisoned Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，黨項羌寇富平；

translations.literal: On wuyin Tangut Qiang raided Fuping;
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Tangut Qiang attacked Fuping;

sentences.zh: 焚定陵寢殿。

translations.literal: they burned the sleeping hall of Ding Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: and burned the tomb hall at Dingling.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，儀王璲薨。

translations.literal: Prince of Yi Li Lin died.
translations.idiomatic: Li Lin, Prince of Yi, died.

sentences.zh: 諸陵署復隸太常寺。

translations.literal: All mausoleum offices were again subordinate to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Mausoleum offices returned to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 戊子，河西黨項永、定等十二州部落內屬，請置宜、芳等十五州，許之。

translations.literal: On wuzi twelve Tangut prefectures Yong, Ding, and others submitted and requested establishment of Yi, Fang, and fifteen other prefectures — approved.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi twelve Tangut prefectures submitted and fifteen new prefectures were approved.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰朔，詔左僕射裴冕、右僕射郭英乂、太子少傅裴遵慶、檢校太子少保白志貞、太子詹事臧希讓、左散騎常侍暢璀、檢校刑部尚書王昂高升、檢校工部尚書崔渙、吏部侍郎李季卿王延昌、禮部侍郎賈至、涇王傅吳令瑤等十三人，並集賢院待詔。

translations.literal: In the third month, on renchen new moon, an edict ordered Left Vice Director Pei Mian, Right Vice Director Guo Yingyi, Heir Apparent Junior Tutor Pei Zunqing, Acting Heir Apparent Junior Tutor Bai Zhizhen, Heir Apparent Household Administrator Zang Xirang, Left Palace Companion Chang Hui, Acting Minister of Punishments Wang Ang, Acting Minister of Works Cui Huan, Minister of Civil Appointments Vice Directors Li Jiqing and Wang Yanchang, Vice Minister of Rites Jia Zhi, Prince of Jing tutor Wu Lingyao, and thirteen others altogether to await edicts at the Hall of Assembled Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: thirteen senior ministers were ordered to the Hall of Assembled Worthies to await imperial drafts.

sentences.zh: 上以另臣罷節制者，京師無職事，仍合於禁門書院，間以文儒公卿，寵之也。

translations.literal: The emperor thought that when separate ministers had ceased holding commissions, the capital had no duties — they should still assemble in the forbidden gate academy; from time to time literary Confucian dukes and ministers were added — this was favor.
translations.idiomatic: Retired commissioners were kept at the palace academy as a mark of favor when they lacked active posts.

sentences.zh: 仍特給飧本錢三千貫。

translations.literal: They were specially granted three thousand strings of meal money.
translations.idiomatic: Each received three thousand strings for meals.

sentences.zh: 庚子夜，降霜，木有冰。

translations.literal: On gengzi night frost fell; trees bore ice.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi night frost glazed the trees with ice.

sentences.zh: 歲饑，米斗千錢，諸穀皆貴。

translations.literal: Famine year — rice a thousand cash per dou; all grains were dear.
translations.idiomatic: Famine drove grain to a thousand cash per dou and every crop dear.

sentences.zh: 丙午，鳳翔李抱玉讓司徒，從之，授左僕射、同平章事。

translations.literal: On bingwu Fengxiang Li Baoyu declined Grand Mentor; it was granted; he was appointed Left Vice Director and Associate Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Li Baoyu gave up grand mentor for left vice director and chancellorship.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，吐蕃請和。

translations.literal: On gengxu Tibet requested peace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Tibet sued for peace.

sentences.zh: 詔宰臣元載、杜鴻漸與蕃使同盟於興唐寺。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Chancellor Yuan Zai and Du Hongjian to ally with Tibetan envoys at Xingqing Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Zai and Du Hongjian swore peace with Tibet at Xingqing Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，大風拔木。

translations.literal: On xinhai a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai a gale uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 是春大旱，京師米貴，斛至萬錢。

translations.literal: That spring great drought; capital rice was dear — a hu reached ten thousand cash.
translations.idiomatic: Spring drought pushed Chang'an grain to ten thousand cash per hu.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己巳，乃雨。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jisi, rain finally fell.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, jisi: rain ended the drought.

sentences.zh: 戊子，太保致仕苗晉卿薨。

translations.literal: On wuzi retired Grand Mentor Miao Jinqing died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Miao Jinqing died in retirement.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，劍南節度使、檢校吏部尚書嚴武卒。

translations.literal: On gengyin Jiannan military commissioner, acting Minister of Civil Appointments Yan Wu died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Yan Wu of Jiannan died.

sentences.zh: 五月癸丑，以尚書右僕射、定襄郡王郭英乂為成都尹、御史大夫，充劍南節度使。

translations.literal: On guichou Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, Prince of Dingxiang commandery Guo Yingyi was made Chengdu prefect, Censor-in-Chief, and Jiannan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Guo Yingyi was sent to Chengdu as Jiannan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是月麥稔。

translations.literal: That month wheat ripened.
translations.idiomatic: Wheat ripened that month.

sentences.zh: 判度支第五琦奏請十畝稅一畝，效古什一而征，從之。

translations.literal: Acting revenue commissioner Diwu Qi memorialized requesting tax of one mu in ten, emulating antiquity's one-tenth levy — approved.
translations.idiomatic: Diwu Qi's ten-percent land tax was approved.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥，吏部尚書李峴南選回，至江陵，貶衢州刺史。

translations.literal: On guihai Minister of Civil Appointments Li Xian returned from southern selection; reaching Jiangling he was demoted to Quzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Li Xian was demoted to Quzhou after southern selection.

sentences.zh: 自春無雷，至此月甲申，大風而雷。

translations.literal: From spring there had been no thunder; until this month on jiashen, great wind and thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Thunder returned on jiashen after a thunderless spring.

sentences.zh: 代州置代北軍，平州置柳城，析通州石鼓縣置巴渠縣。

translations.literal: Daibei army was established at Daizhou; Liucheng at Pingzhou; from Tongzhou Shigu county Biqu county was split off.
translations.idiomatic: Daibei and Liucheng garrisons were founded and Biqu county carved from Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛卯朔，淄青節度使侯希逸為副將李懷玉所逐。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinmao new moon, Ziqing military commissioner Hou Xiyi was expelled by deputy Li Huaiyu.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Hou Xiyi was ousted by Li Huaiyu at Ziqing.

sentences.zh: 制以鄭王邈為平盧、淄青節度大使，令懷玉權知留後事。

translations.literal: A decree made Prince of Zheng Li Miao grand ambassador of Pinglu and Ziqing military commission; Huaiyu was ordered to act as regent.
translations.idiomatic: Li Miao was named grand ambassador; Huaiyu acted regent at Ziqing.

sentences.zh: 以久旱，遣近臣分錄京城諸獄系囚。

translations.literal: Because of long drought, near ministers were sent to record prisoners in all capital prisons.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial confidants reviewed capital prisoners during the drought.

sentences.zh: 甲午，升平公主出降駙馬都尉郭曖。

translations.literal: On jiawu Princess Shengping was married to Chief Commandant of the Horse Empress Cadet Guo Ai.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Princess Shengping wed Guo Ai.

sentences.zh: 庚子，雨。

translations.literal: On gengzi rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi it rained at last.

sentences.zh: 時久旱，京師米斗一千四百，他穀食稱是。

translations.literal: Long drought — capital rice fourteen hundred per dou; other grains likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Despite rain, rice still cost fourteen hundred per dou.

sentences.zh: 八月乙亥，河南道副元帥、涇原節度使馬璘封扶風郡王。

translations.literal: On yihai Henan deputy commander-in-chief and Jingyuan military commissioner Ma Lin was enfeoffed Prince of Fufeng commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Ma Lin became Prince of Fufeng.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，太白經天。

translations.literal: On xinmao the White Planet crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Venus transited the meridian.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，僕固懷恩死於靈州之鳴沙縣。

translations.literal: On dingyou Pugu Huai'en died at Mingsha county in Lingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Pugu Huai'en died at Mingsha in Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 時懷恩誘吐蕃數十萬寇邠州，客將尚品息贊磨、尚悉東贊等寇奉天、醴泉，黨項羌、渾、奴剌寇同州及奉天，逼鳳翔府、盩厔縣，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: At the time Huai'en had incited several hundred thousand Tibetans to raid Binzhou; guest officers Shangpin Xizanmo and Shang Xidongzan and others raided Fengtian and Liquan; Tangut Qiang, Hun, and Nulaz raided Tongzhou and Fengtian, pressing Fengxiang prefecture and Zhouzhi county — the capital was on alert.
translations.idiomatic: He had stirred vast Tibetan raids while Qiang and Hun allies pressed the capital approaches.

sentences.zh: 時以星變，羌虜入寇，內出《仁王佛經》兩輿付資聖、西明二佛寺，置百尺高座講之。

translations.literal: Because of the star anomaly and barbarian invasion, the inner palace issued two carriages of the Benevolent King Sutra to Zisheng and Ximing monasteries, setting hundred-foot high seats to lecture it.
translations.idiomatic: A celestial omen and invasion brought public lectures on the Benevolent King Sutra at two monasteries.

sentences.zh: 及奴虜寇逼京畿，方罷講。

translations.literal: When slave barbarians pressed the capital region, the lectures were only then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The sermons stopped only when invaders neared the capital.

sentences.zh: 己酉，郭子儀自河中至，進屯涇陽，李忠臣屯東渭橋，李光進屯雲陽，馬璘、郝玉屯便橋，駱奉仙、李伯越屯盩厔，李抱玉屯鳳翔，周智光屯同州，杜冕屯坊州。

translations.literal: On jiyou Guo Ziyi came from Hezhong, advanced and encamped at Jingyang; Li Zhongchen encamped at East Wei Bridge, Li Guangjin at Yunyang, Ma Lin and Hao Yu at Bian Bridge, Luo Fengxian and Li Boyue at Zhouzhi, Li Baoyu at Fengxiang, Zhou Zhiguang at Tongzhou, Du Mian at Fangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Guo Ziyi and a ring of generals encircled the capital with their camps.

sentences.zh: 上親率六軍屯苑內。

translations.literal: The emperor personally led the Six Armies encamped within the park.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor camped with the Six Armies inside the palace park.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，下詔親征。

translations.literal: On gengxu an edict ordered the emperor to campaign in person.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he proclaimed a personal campaign.

sentences.zh: 內官魚朝恩上言，請括私馬，京城男子悉皁衣團結，塞京城二門之一。
