translations.literal: Eunuch Yu Chao'en spoke up requesting requisition of private horses; capital men were all clothed in black and mustered; one of the capital's two gates was blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Chao'en demanded private horses and black-clad militia; panic filled the city as people fled over walls.

sentences.zh: 士庶大駭，有逾垣鑿竇出城者，吏不能禁。

translations.literal: Gentry and commoners were greatly terrified; some climbed walls and bored holes to flee the city — clerks could not forbid it.
translations.idiomatic: Officials could not stop the flight of terrified citizens.

sentences.zh: 自丙午至甲寅大雨，平地水流。

translations.literal: From bingwu to jiayin great rain fell; water flowed on level ground.
translations.idiomatic: From bingwu to jiayin floods covered the streets.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，吐蕃大掠京畿男婦數萬計，焚廬舍而去。

translations.literal: On dingsi Tibet greatly plundered tens of thousands of men and women in the capital region, burned dwellings, and departed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Tibetans looted the suburbs and withdrew burning towns.

sentences.zh: 同華節度周智光以兵追擊於澄城，破賊萬計。

translations.literal: Tong-Hua military commissioner Zhou Zhiguang with troops pursued at Chengcheng and broke more than ten thousand bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Zhiguang pursued and killed ten thousand at Chengcheng.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己未，復講《仁王經》於資聖寺。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jiwei, the Benevolent King Sutra was lectured again at Zisheng Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: the Benevolent King Sutra lectures resumed.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃至邠州，與回紇相遇，復合從入寇。

translations.literal: Tibetans reached Binzhou, met the Uyghur, and again joined to enter in raid.
translations.idiomatic: At Binzhou Tibetans allied again with Uyghurs and raided together.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，逼奉天。

translations.literal: On xinyou they pressed Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou they besieged Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，黨項攻同州，焚州民廬舍。

translations.literal: On guihai Tangut attacked Tongzhou and burned the people's dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Tangut burned Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，郭子儀說諭回紇，令與吐蕃疑貳。

translations.literal: On dingchou Guo Ziyi persuaded the Uyghur, making them suspect and divide from Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Guo Ziyi turned Uyghur against Tibetan allies.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，子儀先鋒將白元光合回紇軍擊吐蕃之眾於靈臺縣之西原，斬首五萬級，俘獲人畜凡三百里不絕。

translations.literal: On gengchen Ziyi's vanguard Bai Guangye joined Uyghur troops and struck the Tibetan host west of Lingtai county on the western plain — heads numbered fifty thousand; captives and livestock stretched three hundred li without break.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Bai Guangye and the Uyghurs slaughtered fifty thousand Tibetans west of Lingtai.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，京師解嚴。

translations.literal: On xinsi the capital alert was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the capital stood down.

sentences.zh: 壬午，僕固懷恩大將僕固名臣以千騎來降。

translations.literal: On renyang Pugu Huai'en's great general Pugu Mingchen came to surrender with a thousand horse.
translations.idiomatic: On renyang Mingchen defected with a thousand cavalry.

sentences.zh: 詔稅百官錢；

translations.literal: An edict levied cash on the hundred officials;
translations.idiomatic: Officials were taxed for cash;

sentences.zh: 市絹十萬以賞回紇。

translations.literal: silk was purchased in one hundred thousand bolts to reward the Uyghur.
translations.idiomatic: a hundred thousand bolts of silk were bought to reward the Uyghurs.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，回紇首領胡祿都督來朝。

translations.literal: On yiyou the Uyghur chief, Protectorate Commander Hulu, came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the Uyghur leader Hulu came for audience.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，朔方將李回方奏收靈武郡。

translations.literal: On guimao Shuofang general Li Huifang memorialized recovery of Lingwu commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Li Huifang reported retaking Lingwu.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，分宣饒、歙戶口於秋浦縣置池州，分信州弋陽置貴溪縣。

translations.literal: On dinghai Xu and Rao households of Xuan and She were split into Chizhou at Qiupu county; Yiyang of Xinzhou was split to establish Guixi county.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Chizhou and Guixi county were carved from southern Anhui.

sentences.zh: 閏十月辛卯，以京兆少尹黎幹為京兆尹。

translations.literal: Intercalary tenth month, on xinmao, Jingzhao Assistant Prefect Li Gan was made Jingzhao prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month: Li Gan became Jingzhao prefect.

sentences.zh: 丙午，封朔方大將孫守亮等九人為異姓王，李國臣等十三人為同姓王。

translations.literal: On bingwu the hundred officials memorialized that with military campaigns grain was urgent — they requested contributing salary fields to aid expenses — approved.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu officials offered salary lands to fund the armies and were accepted.

sentences.zh: 丁未，百僚上表，以軍興急於糧，請納職田以助費，從之。

translations.literal: On dingwei Shuofang great generals Sun Shouliang and nine others were enfeoffed as kings of different surnames; Li Guochen and thirteen others as kings of the same surname.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei nineteen Shuofang generals received royal enfeoffments.

sentences.zh: 戊申，進封渭北節度使李光進為武威郡王。

translations.literal: On wushen Weibei military commissioner Li Guangjin was advanced to Prince of Wuwei commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Li Guangjin became Prince of Wuwei.

sentences.zh: 以刑部侍郎路嗣恭檢校工部尚書、兼御史大夫、靈州大都督府長史，充關內副元帥，兼知朔方節度等使。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Punishments Lu Sigong was made acting Minister of Works, concurrent Censor-in-Chief, chief of Lingzhou metropolitan prefecture, Guannei deputy commander-in-chief, and knowing Shuofang military commissioner and the like.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Sigong took Lingzhou and Shuofang commands.

sentences.zh: 劍南節度使郭英乂為其檢校西山兵馬使崔旰所殺，邛州柏茂林、瀘州楊子琳、劍南李昌巙皆起兵討旰，蜀中亂。

translations.literal: Jiannan military commissioner Guo Yingyi was killed by his acting western-mountain army commissioner Cui Gan; Qiongzhou Bo Maolin, Luzhou Yang Zilin, and Jiannan Li Changchong all raised troops to attack Gan — Shu was in turmoil.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Yingyi's murder by Cui Gan plunged Shu into war among regional commanders.

sentences.zh: 十一月，宰臣河南都統王縉請減諸道軍資錢四十萬貫修洛陽宮，從之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Chancellor and Henan overall commander Wang Jin requested reducing all circuits' military funds four hundred thousand strings to repair Luoyang Palace — approved.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: Wang Jin diverted four hundred thousand strings from armies to rebuild Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 十二月己酉，敕：「如聞諸州承本道節度、觀察使牒，科役百姓，致戶口凋弊，此後委轉運使察訪以聞。

translations.literal: On jiyou an order stated: "We have heard that prefectures, receiving dispatches from their circuit military and observation commissioners, levy corvée on the people and cause households to wither — hereafter the transport commissioner is to investigate and report.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the throne forbade commissioners from levying corvée that beggared the people; transport officials would investigate.

sentences.zh: 」大歷元年二年春正月丁巳朔，大雪平地二尺。

translations.literal: Dali 1, in the first month of spring, on dingsi new moon, great snow piled two feet on level ground.
translations.idiomatic: First month of Dali 1: snow two feet deep.

sentences.zh: 壬申，減子孫襲實封者半租，永為常式。

translations.literal: On renshen heirs inheriting substantive fiefs had half rent reduced — made perpetual statute.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen hereditary fiefs lost half their rent permanently.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，制：

translations.literal: On yiyou a decree:
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou an edict ordered:

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以戶部尚書劉晏充東都京畿、河南、淮南、江南東西道、湖南、荊南、山南東道轉運、常平、鑄錢、鹽鐵等使，以戶部侍郎第五琦充京畿、關內、河東、劍南西轉運、常平、鑄錢、鹽鐵等使。

translations.literal: On bingxu Households Minister Liu Yan was charged with Eastern Capital, capital region, Henan, Huainan, Jiangnan east and west, Hunan, Jingnan, and Hedong South transport, Ever-Normal, coinage, salt iron, and the like; Households Vice Minister Diwu Qi was charged with capital region, Guannei, Hedong, and Jiannan West transport, Ever-Normal, coinage, salt iron, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu revenue was split between Liu Yan in the east and Diwu Qi in the west.

sentences.zh: 至是天下財賦，始分理焉。

translations.literal: From this the realm's finances began to be separately administered.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial finances were now divided between two chiefs.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥朔，釋奠於國學，賜宰臣百官飧錢五百貫，於國學食。

translations.literal: In the second month, on dinghai new moon, libation at the National University; five hundred strings feast money was granted to chancellors and the hundred officials; they ate at the university.
translations.idiomatic: Second month: National University rites with a feast for the court.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，鎮南都護依舊為安南都護府。

translations.literal: On renchen the southern protectorate was restored as the Annan protectorate.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the Annan protectorate was restored.

sentences.zh: 乙未，貶刑部尚書顏真卿為峽州員外別駕，以不附元載，載陷之於罪也。

translations.literal: On yiwei acting Minister of Punishments Yan Zhenqing was demoted to Kuizhou supernumerary chief adjutant — because he did not attach to Yuan Zai; Zai trapped him in crime.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Yan Zhenqing was exiled to Kuizhou for defying Yuan Zai.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命黃門侍郎、同平章事杜鴻漸兼成都尹，持節充山南西道、劍南東川等道副元帥，仍充劍南西川節度使，以平郭英乂之亂也。

translations.literal: On renzi an order made Yellow Gate Vice Director and Associate Du Hongjian also Chengdu prefect, holding credentials as Shannan West and Jiannan East River campaign deputy commander-in-chief, still Jiannan West River military commissioner, to pacify Guo Yingyi's disorder.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Du Hongjian was sent to Sichuan to crush Guo Yingyi's revolt.

sentences.zh: 以四鎮行營節度使馬璘兼邠州刺史。

translations.literal: Four Garrisons campaign military commissioner Ma Lin was also made Binzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Lin also became Binzhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以山南西道節度使、梁州刺史張獻誠兼充劍南東川節度觀察使，邛州刺史柏茂林充邛南防禦使，劍南西山兵馬使崔旰為茂州刺史、充劍南西山防禦使，從杜鴻漸請也。

translations.literal: On guichou Shannan West military commissioner and Liangzhou prefect Zhang Xianchéng was also Jiannan East River military and observation commissioner; Qiongzhou prefect Bo Maolin was Qiong South defense commissioner; Jiannan western-mountain army commissioner Cui Gan was Maozhou prefect and Jiannan western-mountain defense commissioner — following Du Hongjian's request.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Sichuan commands were parceled among Zhang, Bo, and Cui at Du Hongjian's request.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，張獻誠與崔旰戰於梓州，為旰所敗，僅以身免。

translations.literal: In the third month, on xinwei, Zhang Xianchéng fought Cui Gan at Zizhou, was defeated by Gan, and barely escaped with his life.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: Zhang Xianchéng lost to Cui Gan at Zizhou and fled.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛亥，詔尚書省郎中授中州刺史，員外郎授下州刺史，為定制。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on xinhai, an edict ordered Secretariat bureau directors to be appointed Zhongzhou prefects and supernumeraries lower prefects — made fixed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Summer fourth month: director-grade officials were tied to prefectural posts by statute.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰，稅青苗地錢使、殿中侍御韋光裔諸道稅地回。

translations.literal: On bingchen Green-Sprout land-tax commissioner and Palace Attendant Wei Guangyi returned from circuit land tax.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Wei Guangyi finished the green-sprout land tax tour.

sentences.zh: 是歲得錢四百九十萬貫。

translations.literal: That year the cash obtained was four million nine hundred thousand strings.
translations.idiomatic: The levy raised 4.9 million strings.

sentences.zh: 自乾元已來，天下用兵，百官俸錢折，乃議於天下地畝青苗上量配稅錢，命御史府差使徵之，以充百官俸料，每年據數均給之，歲以為常式。

translations.literal: From Qianyuan onward the realm had used arms; officials' salary cash was discounted — therefore it was debated to assess tax cash on green-sprout of land mu empire-wide; the Censorate was ordered to send envoys to collect, to supply officials' salary materials, annually allotted by count — each year made perpetual rule.
translations.idiomatic: War had debased salaries; the green-sprout land tax on every mu was instituted to fund officials permanently.

sentences.zh: 六月戊戌，以淮南節度使崔圓檢校尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On wuxu Huainan military commissioner Cui Yuan was made acting Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Cui Yuan became acting right vice director.

sentences.zh: 自春旱，此月庚子始雨。

translations.literal: From spring drought; this month on gengzi rain first fell.
translations.idiomatic: Drought since spring broke on gengzi of this month.

sentences.zh: 丁未，日重輪。

translations.literal: On dingwei the sun showed double halos.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the sun had double halos.

sentences.zh: 其夜，月重輪。

translations.literal: That night the moon showed double halos.
translations.idiomatic: That night the moon doubled its halo.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉，檢校兵部尚書、衢州刺史李峴卒。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinyou, acting Minister of War and Quzhou prefect Li Xian died.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Li Xian died at Quzhou.

sentences.zh: 自五月大雨，洛水泛溢，漂溺居人廬舍二十坊。

translations.literal: From the fifth month great rain; Luo River overflowed and drowned dwellings in twenty wards.
translations.idiomatic: Floods since the fifth month drowned twenty Luoyang wards.

sentences.zh: 河南諸州水。

translations.literal: Henan prefectures suffered water.
translations.idiomatic: Henan prefectures flooded.

sentences.zh: 加荊南節度使衛伯玉檢校工部尚書。

translations.literal: Jingnan military commissioner Wei Boyu was advanced acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Boyu became acting minister of works.

sentences.zh: 癸未，太廟二室芝草生。

translations.literal: On guiwei twin lingzhi fungi grew in two temple chambers.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei auspicious fungi appeared in the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 八月丁亥，國子監釋奠復用牲牢。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on dinghai, the National University libation again used sacrificial victims.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: university rites again used animal victims.

sentences.zh: 上元二年，詔諸祠獻熟，至是魚朝恩請復舊制。

translations.literal: In Shangyuan 2, an edict ordered all sacrifices to offer cooked meat; until now Yu Chao'en requested restoration of the old system.
translations.idiomatic: Cooked offerings had replaced victims since Shangyuan 2; Yu Chao'en restored livestock sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以茂州刺史崔旰為成都尹、兼御史大夫、劍南西川節度行軍司馬，邛南防禦使、邛州刺史柏茂林為邛南節度使，從杜鴻漸所請也。

translations.literal: On renyin Maozhou prefect Cui Gan was made Chengdu prefect, concurrent Censor-in-Chief and Jiannan West River campaign chief of staff; Qiong South defense commissioner and Qiongzhou prefect Bo Maolin was Qiong South military commissioner — following Du Hongjian's request.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Cui Gan and Bo Maolin received expanded Sichuan commands.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，太子少保裴遵慶為吏部尚書，吏部尚書崔寓為太子少傅。

translations.literal: On guimao Heir Apparent Junior Tutor Pei Zunqing was made Minister of Civil Appointments; Minister of Civil Appointments Cui Yu was made Heir Apparent Junior Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Pei Zunqing and Cui Yu exchanged civil appointment and tutor posts.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以開府儀同三司、右監衛大將軍、觀軍容宣慰處置使、神策軍兵馬使、上柱國、馮翊郡開國公魚朝恩加內侍監、判國子監事，充鴻臚禮賓等使，進封鄭國公。

translations.literal: On jiachen Acting Three Excellencies, Right Guard General of the Monitor, Army Viewing Pacification and Disposition Commissioner, Divine Strategy Army horse commissioner, Upper Pillar of State, Duke of Fengyi Yu Chao'en was advanced Inner Palace Director, judging National University affairs, charged with Honglu ritual guest and the like, advanced to Duke of Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Yu Chao'en gained the inner palace directorship and Duke of Zheng.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以檢校禮部尚書裴士淹充禮儀。

translations.literal: On xinhai Acting Minister of Rites Pei Shiyan was charged with ritual.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Pei Shiyan took charge of court ritual.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申，京兆尹黎幹以京城薪炭不給。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on gengshen, Jingzhao prefect Li Gan because capital fuel and charcoal were insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Li Gan, lacking fuel for the capital,

sentences.zh: 奏開漕渠，自南山谷口入京城，至薦福寺東街，北抵景風、延喜門入苑，闊八尺，深一丈。

translations.literal: memorialized opening a canal from the southern mountain valley mouth into the capital to Jianfu Temple east street, north reaching Jingfeng and Yanxi gates into the park — width eight chi, depth one zhang.
translations.idiomatic: proposed a canal from the southern hills into the city eight chi wide and one zhang deep.

sentences.zh: 渠成，是日上幸安福門以觀之。

translations.literal: When the canal was complete, that day the emperor went to Anfu Gate to view it.
translations.idiomatic: When it opened, the emperor inspected it at Anfu Gate.

sentences.zh: 丙子，宣州刺史李佚坐贓二十四萬貫，集眾杖死，籍沒其家。

translations.literal: On bingzi Xuanzhou prefect Li Yi sat on twenty-four thousand strings of corruption; he was assembled and beaten to death before the crowd; his household was confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Li Yi was beaten to death before the people for embezzling twenty-four thousand strings.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸未朔。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on guiwei new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, guiwei new moon.

sentences.zh: 己丑，宗正卿吳王祗奏上《皇室永泰新論》二十卷，太常博士柳芳撰。

translations.literal: On jichou Director of the Imperial Clan Court Prince of Wu Li Zhi memorialized presenting the Imperial Clan's Yongtai New Treatise in twenty scrolls, composed by Court of Imperial Sacrifices erudite Liu Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the imperial clan genealogy Yongtai New Treatise was presented.

sentences.zh: 和蕃使楊漳與蕃使論位藏等來朝。

translations.literal: Commissioner to harmonize with Tibet Yang Zhang and Tibetan envoys Lun Weizang and others came to court.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetan peace envoys came with Yang Zhang.

sentences.zh: 丙申，令宰臣宴論位藏於中書省。

translations.literal: On bingshen an order made chancellors feast Lun Weizang at the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen chancellors banqueted the Tibetan envoys.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲寅，乾陵令於陵署得赤兔以獻。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiayin, Qianling magistrate at the tomb office obtained a red hare and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: a red hare was sent from Qianling.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔：

translations.literal: On bingchen an edict:
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen an edict proclaimed:

sentences.zh: 甲子，日長至，上御含元殿，下制大赦天下，改永泰二年為大歷元年。

translations.literal: On jiazi the day length reached solstice; the emperor went to Hanyuan Hall and issued a decree of great amnesty under Heaven, changing Yongtai 2 to Dali 1.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he proclaimed solstice amnesty and the era name Dali.

sentences.zh: 十二月己亥，彗起匏瓜，其長尺餘，犯宦者星。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jihai, a comet rose in Gourd constellation, more than a chi long, violating the eunuch star.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month: a comet in Gourd threatened the eunuch constellation.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，同華節度使周智光專殺陜州監軍張志斌、前虢州刺史龐充，據華州謀叛。

translations.literal: On guimao Tong-Hua military commissioner Zhou Zhiguang on his own authority killed Shaanxi army inspector Zhang Zhibin and former Guo prefect Pang Chong, held Huazhou and plotted rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Zhou Zhiguang murdered officials and rebelled at Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 是冬無雪。

translations.literal: That winter there was no snow.
translations.idiomatic: Snow failed that winter.

sentences.zh: 大歷二年二年春正月壬子朔。

translations.literal: Dali 2, in the first month of spring, on renzi new moon.
translations.idiomatic: First month of spring, Dali 2, renzi new moon.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，密詔關內、河東副元帥郭子儀治兵討周智光。

translations.literal: On dingsi a secret edict ordered Guannei and Hedong deputy commander-in-chief Guo Ziyi to ready troops to attack Zhou Zhiguang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Guo Ziyi was secretly ordered to crush Zhou Zhiguang.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，貶智光為灃州剌史。

translations.literal: On renxu Zhou Zhiguang was demoted to Fengzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Zhiguang was demoted to Fengzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以兵部侍郎張仲光為華州刺史、潼關防禦使，大理卿敬括為同州刺史、長春宮等使。

translations.literal: On jiazi Vice Minister of War Zhang Zhongguang was made Huazhou prefect and Tong Pass defense commissioner; Grand Court Judge Jing Kuo was made Tongzhou prefect and Changchun Palace and the like commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi new commanders were set over Hua and Tong.

sentences.zh: 是日，周智光帳下將斬智光並子元耀、元乾三首，傳之以獻。

translations.literal: That day Zhou Zhiguang's camp officers beheaded Zhiguang and his sons Yuanyao and Yuanqian — three heads — and presented them in succession.
translations.idiomatic: That day his own officers sent Zhiguang's head and those of two sons.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔潼關置兵三千。

translations.literal: On jisi an edict set three thousand troops at Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Tong Pass received three thousand men.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔：

translations.literal: On guiyou an edict:
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou an edict stated:

sentences.zh: 丁丑，升魏州為大都督府，戊寅，敕：「同、華兩州，頃因盜據，民力凋殘，宜給復二年，一切蠲免。

translations.literal: On dingchou Weizhou was elevated to metropolitan prefecture; on wuyin an order stated: "Tong and Hua two prefectures, lately seized by bandits, people's strength withered — they should receive two years' restoration, all exemptions.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Wei became a metropolis; on wuyin Tong and Hua were tax-free for two years.

sentences.zh: 」庚辰，禁王公、宗子、郡縣主之家，不得與軍將婚姻交好，委御史臺察訪彈奏。

translations.literal: 」 On gengchen princes, imperial clan, and commandery and county princesses' households were forbidden to marry or befriend military generals — the Censorate was ordered to investigate and impeach.
translations.idiomatic: Thus ended the order. On gengchen imperial kin were forbidden to marry generals under censor scrutiny.

sentences.zh: 二月壬午，幸昆明池踏青。

translations.literal: In the second month, on renwu, he visited Kunming Pond for spring outing.
translations.idiomatic: Second month: spring outing at Kunming Pond.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，封華州牙將姚懷為感義郡王，李延俊為承化郡王，以斬智光之功也。

translations.literal: On bingxu Huazhou gate officers Yao Huai and Li Yanjun were enfeoffed Prince of Ganyi commandery and Prince of Chenghua commandery — for beheading Zhiguang's merit.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu two officers who killed Zhiguang were enfeoffed as princes.

sentences.zh: 郭子儀自河中來朝。

translations.literal: Guo Ziyi came to court from Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Ziyi came from Hezhong for audience.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，宰臣元載王縉、左僕射裴冕、戶部侍郎第五琦、京兆尹黎幹各出錢三十萬，置宴於子儀之第。

translations.literal: On guimao Chancellor Yuan Zai, Wang Jin, Left Vice Director Pei Mian, Households Vice Minister Diwu Qi, and Jingzhao prefect Li Gan each contributed three hundred thousand cash and set a feast at Ziyi's residence.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the court feasted Guo Ziyi, each minister giving three hundred thousand cash.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥夜，大風。

translations.literal: In the third month, on xinhai night, a great wind.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, xinhai night: a gale.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，河中府獻玄狐。

translations.literal: On dingsi Hezhong prefecture presented a black fox.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Hezhong sent a black fox as tribute.

sentences.zh: 汴宋節度使田神功來朝。

translations.literal: Bian-Song military commissioner Tian Shenggong came to court.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Shenggong of Bian-Song came to court.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，貶太子少保李遵永州司馬，坐贓也。

translations.literal: On wuchen Heir Apparent Junior Tutor Li Zun was demoted to Yongzhou assistant prefect — the crime was corruption.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Li Zun was exiled to Yongzhou for graft.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，魚朝恩宴子儀、宰相、節度、度支使、京兆尹於私第。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Yu Chao'en feasted Ziyi, chancellors, military commissioners, revenue commissioner, and Jingzhao prefect at his private residence.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Yu Chao'en hosted the court elite at his mansion.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，子儀亦置宴於其第。

translations.literal: On yihai Ziyi also set a feast at his residence.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Guo Ziyi returned the feast.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，田神功宴於其第。

translations.literal: On wuyin Tian Shenggong feasted at his residence.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Tian Shenggong held his own banquet.

sentences.zh: 時以子儀元臣，寇難漸平，蹈舞王化，乃置酒連宴。

translations.literal: At the time because Ziyi was the founding minister and bandit trouble gradually pacified, they trod the king's transforming influence — thus wine feasts were set in succession.
translations.idiomatic: With rebellion fading, the realm celebrated its surviving hero in a round of banquets.

sentences.zh: 酒酣，皆起舞。

translations.literal: When wine was deep, all danced.
translations.idiomatic: Deep in wine, everyone danced.

sentences.zh: 公卿大臣列坐於席者百人。

translations.literal: Dukes, ministers, and great officials arrayed at the mats numbered a hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: A hundred dignitaries shared the mats.

sentences.zh: 子儀、朝恩、神功一宴費至十萬貫。

translations.literal: A single feast by Ziyi, Chao'en, and Shenggong cost up to one hundred thousand strings.
translations.idiomatic: Each banquet cost up to a hundred thousand strings.

sentences.zh: 夏四月巳亥，以江面西道都團練觀察等使、洪州刺史李勉為京兆尹，刑部侍郎魏少游為洪州刺史、兼御史大夫、江西觀察團練等使。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jihai, Jiangnan West overall training and observation commissioner and Hongzhou prefect Li Mian was made Jingzhao prefect; Vice Minister of Punishments Wei Shaoyou was made Hongzhou prefect, concurrent Censor-in-Chief, and Jiangxi observation and training commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Summer fourth month: Li Mian came to the capital; Wei Shaoyou went to Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 庚子，宰臣內侍魚朝恩與吐蕃同盟於興唐寺。

translations.literal: On gengzi Chancellor and inner attendant Yu Chao'en allied with Tibet at Xingqing Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Yu Chao'en renewed the Tibetan alliance at Xingqing Temple.

sentences.zh: 丙午，加田神功檢校右僕射。

translations.literal: On bingwu Tian Shenggong was advanced acting Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Tian Shenggong became acting right vice director.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以工部侍郎徐浩為廣州刺史、嶺南節度觀察使。

translations.literal: On guiyou Vice Minister of Works Xu Hao was made Guangzhou prefect and Lingnan military and observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Xu Hao was sent to Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 六月戊戌，山南、劍南副元帥杜鴻漸自蜀入朝。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on wuxu, Shannan and Jiannan deputy commander-in-chief Du Hongjian entered court from Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: Du Hongjian arrived from Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，荊南節度使衛伯玉封城陽郡王。

translations.literal: On renyin Jingnan military commissioner Wei Boyu was enfeoffed Prince of Chengyang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Wei Boyu became Prince of Chengyang.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，御史大夫王翊卒。

translations.literal: On guimao Censor-in-Chief Wang Yi died.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Wang Yi died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申朔，以右散騎常侍於休烈為檢校工部尚書、知省事。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on wushen new moon, Right Palace Companion Yu Xiulie was made acting Minister of Works, knowing ministry affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Yu Xiulie became acting minister of works in charge of the ministries.

sentences.zh: 時方面勛臣升八座者多非正員。

translations.literal: At the time many frontier merit-holders advanced to the Eight Seats were not regular appointees.
translations.idiomatic: Many frontier generals held ministry seats without regular appointment.

sentences.zh: 朝命正員者以知省事為名。

translations.literal: Court orders for regular appointees used the title "knowing ministry affairs."
translations.idiomatic: Regular ministers were styled as "knowing affairs."

sentences.zh: 以中書舍人張延賞檢校河南尹。

translations.literal: Secretariat Drafter Zhang Yanshang was made acting Henan prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yanshang became acting Henan prefect.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以劍南西川節度行軍司馬崔旰為劍南西川節度觀察等使，遂州刺史杜濟為劍南東川節度觀察等使。

translations.literal: On bingyin Jiannan West River campaign chief of staff Cui Gan was made Jiannan West River military and observation commissioner; Suizhou prefect Du Ji was made Jiannan East River military and observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Cui Gan and Du Ji received full Sichuan commands.

sentences.zh: 以杭州刺史張伯儀為安南都護。

translations.literal: Hangzhou prefect Zhang Boyi was made Protector-General of Annan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Boyi became protector of Annan.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，析道州延唐縣置大歷縣。

translations.literal: On guiyou Yantang county of Daozhou was split to establish Dali county.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Dali county was carved from Daozhou.

sentences.zh: 甲戌酉時，有白氣竟天。

translations.literal: On jiaxu at the you hour white vapor filled the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu white mist stretched across the heavens at dusk.

sentences.zh: 八月庚辰，鳳翔節度使李抱玉來朝。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on gengchen, Fengxiang military commissioner Li Baoyu came to court.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: Li Baoyu came to court.

sentences.zh: 壬午，月入氐。

translations.literal: On renwu the moon entered Di.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the moon entered the mansion Di.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，渤海朝貢。

translations.literal: On bingxu Bohai presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Bohai sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，潭、衡水災。

translations.literal: On xinmao Tan and Heng suffered disaster from water.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Tan and Heng flooded.

sentences.zh: 丙申，月犯畢。

translations.literal: On bingchen the moon violated Bi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the moon crossed the mansion Bi.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，太常卿、駙馬都尉姜慶初得罪，賜自盡。

translations.literal: Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Chief Commandant of the Horse Empress Cadet Jiang Qingchu was guilty of an offense and ordered to take his own life.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Qingchu, the empress's son-in-law, was ordered to commit suicide.

sentences.zh: 敕陵廟署復隸宗正寺。

translations.literal: An order made mausoleum offices again subordinate to the Imperial Clan Court.
translations.idiomatic: Mausoleum offices were returned to the imperial clan directorate.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申朔，歲星守東井七日。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on wushen new moon, the Year Star guarded Eastern Well seven days.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Jupiter lingered seven days in Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，吐蕃寇靈州，進寇邠州。

translations.literal: On jiayin Tibet raided Lingzhou and advanced to raid Binzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Tibet struck Lingzhou and pressed Binzhou.

sentences.zh: 詔子儀率師三萬，自河中鎮涇陽，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Ziyi to lead thirty thousand troops from Hezhong to garrison Jingyang; the capital was put on alert.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Ziyi was ordered to thirty thousand men at Jingyang; Chang'an went on alert.

sentences.zh: 戊午夜，白霧起西北竟天。

translations.literal: At midnight on wuwu white mist rose in the northwest and filled the sky.
translations.idiomatic: At midnight on wuwu white fog covered the sky from the northwest.

sentences.zh: 子儀移鎮奉天。

translations.literal: Ziyi shifted garrison to Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Ziyi moved his camp to Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 乙丑晝，有大流星出於午，沒於亥。

translations.literal: In daytime on yichou a great meteor went out from wu and vanished at hai.
translations.idiomatic: By day on yichou a great meteor flashed from noon to the twelfth hour.

sentences.zh: 命左丞李涵宣慰河北。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director Li Han was ordered to comfort Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: Li Han was sent to pacify Hebei.

sentences.zh: 熒惑犯南斗。

translations.literal: The Spark Star violated Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Mars crossed the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 辛未，靺鞨使來朝。

translations.literal: On xinwei Mohe envoys came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Mohe envoys arrived.

sentences.zh: 桂州山獠陷州城，刺史李良遁去。

translations.literal: Guilin mountain barbarians took the prefectural city; prefect Li Liang fled away.
translations.idiomatic: Guilin tribes seized the prefecture; Li Liang fled.

sentences.zh: 十月戊寅，靈州奏破吐蕃二萬，京師解嚴。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on wuyin, Lingzhou memorialized breaking twenty thousand Tibetans; the capital alert was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: Lingzhou reported twenty thousand Tibetans defeated and the capital stood down.

sentences.zh: 甲申，減京官職田三分之一，給軍糧。

translations.literal: On jiashen salary fields of capital officials were reduced one-third to supply army grain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen capital officials lost a third of their salary lands for the army.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，醴泉出於櫟陽，飲之愈疾。

translations.literal: On yiyou a sweet spring appeared at Liyang; drinking it cured illness.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou a healing spring appeared at Liyang.

sentences.zh: 回紇、黨項使來朝。

translations.literal: Uyghur and Tangut envoys came to court.
translations.idiomatic: Uyghur and Tangut embassies arrived.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上御紫宸殿。

translations.literal: On guimao the emperor went to Zichen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he held court at Zichen Hall.

sentences.zh: 策試茂才異行、安貧樂道、孝悌力田、高蹈不仕等四科舉人。

translations.literal: He tested by decree candidates of Outstanding Talent and Unusual Conduct, Content with Poverty and Delighting in the Way, Filial Piety and Diligence in Farming, and Lofty Withdrawal without Office — four categories.
translations.idiomatic: He examined four special moral and scholarly degree categories at Zichen Hall.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚申，改黃門侍郎依舊為門下侍郎。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengshen, Yellow Gate Vice Director was changed back to Chancellery Vice Director as before.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: yellow gate vice directors reverted to chancellery vice directors.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「春秋以九命作上公。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "In Spring and Autumn the nine commands made the upper duke.
translations.idiomatic: An edict recalled that Spring and Autumn enfeoffed the three dukes as the highest ministers.

sentences.zh: 而謂之宰臣者，三公之職。

translations.literal: Those called chancellor were the office of the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: The title chancellor belonged to the three dukes.

sentences.zh: 漢制：中書令出納詔命，典司樞密；

translations.literal: Han statute: the Secretariat Director issued and received edicts and managed the pivot of secrets;
translations.idiomatic: Under Han the director issued edicts and held the secrets of state;

sentences.zh: 侍中上殿稱制，參議政事。

translations.literal: the Palace Attendant ascended the hall and proclaimed regulations, deliberating government affairs.
translations.idiomatic: the palace attendant proclaimed policy and debated affairs on the hall.

sentences.zh: 魏、晉已還益重其任。

translations.literal: From Wei and Jin onward the post grew heavier.
translations.idiomatic: Wei and Jin made the post weightier still.

sentences.zh: 職有關於公府，事不系於尚書，雖陳啟沃之謀，未專宰臣之稱，所以委遇斯大，品秩非崇。

translations.literal: The office concerned the public offices; affairs were not tied to the Imperial Secretariat — though they presented plans of nourishment, they did not yet have the exclusive title of chancellor; therefore trust and encounter were so great while rank and grade were not exalted.
translations.idiomatic: Early chancellors advised the throne without yet bearing the full title, so power outran formal rank.

sentences.zh: 至於國朝，實執其政，當左輔右弼之寄，總代天理物之名，典領百僚，陶鎔景化。

translations.literal: As for Our dynasty, it truly executes their government, bearing the charge of left assistant and right helper, gathering the name of substituting for Heaven and ordering things, directing the hundred officials, molding and assimilating the luminous transformation.
translations.idiomatic: In Tang the chancellor truly governed, assisting the throne and shaping the hundred officials.

sentences.zh: 豈可具瞻之地，命數不加。

translations.literal: How can the place all gaze upon not have rank and number increased?
translations.idiomatic: Such a post deserved higher rank.

sentences.zh: 固當進以等威，副其僉屬。

translations.literal: It should properly be advanced in equal majesty to match its office.
translations.idiomatic: Its dignity should match its burden.

sentences.zh: 其侍中、中書令宜升入正二品，門下、中書侍郎升入正三品。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant and Secretariat Director should be advanced to regular second grade; Chancellery and Secretariat Vice Directors to regular third grade.
translations.idiomatic: Palace attendant and director were raised to second rank; vice directors to third.

sentences.zh: 」壬戌夜，月暈南北河、東井，鎮星入輿鬼，久之方散。

translations.literal: On renxu night the moon haloed the Northern and Southern River and Eastern Well; the Station Star entered Ghost; long afterward it dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu night the moon haloed several mansions until Saturn entered Ghost.

sentences.zh: 甲子，月去軒轅一尺。

translations.literal: On jiazi the moon left Xuanyuan by one chi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the moon stood a foot from Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 己丑，率百官京城士庶出錢以助軍。

translations.literal: On jichou he led the hundred officials and capital gentry and commoners to contribute cash to aid the army.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the court and city were levied for war funds.

sentences.zh: 壬申，京師地震，自東北來，其聲如雷。

translations.literal: On renshen the capital earthquake came from the northeast; its sound was like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen an earthquake rolled from the northeast like thunder.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲申，鳳翔李抱玉來朝。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiashen, Fengxiang Li Baoyu came to court.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month: Li Baoyu came to court again.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，太原節度使辛云京來朝。

translations.literal: On dingyou Hedong military commissioner Xin Yunjing came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Xin Yunjing came to court.

sentences.zh: 熒惑入壁壘。

translations.literal: The Spark Star entered the Ramparts.
translations.idiomatic: Mars entered the celestial ramparts.

sentences.zh: 戊戌黑氣如塵，竟北方。

translations.literal: On wuxu black vapor like dust filled the northern quarter.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu black dust-like haze covered the north.

sentences.zh: 是秋，河東、河南、淮南、浙江東西、福建等道五十五州奏水災。

translations.literal: That autumn fifty-five prefectures of Hedong, Henan, Huainan, Zhejiang east and west, and Fujian circuits memorialized flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn floods were reported from fifty-five prefectures across the east.

sentences.zh: 大歷三年三年春正月丙午朔。

translations.literal: Dali 3, on bingwu new moon of the first month of spring.
translations.idiomatic: First month of spring, Dali 3, bingwu new moon.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，劍南西山置乾州，管招武、寧遠二縣。

translations.literal: On xinhai Jiannan West established Qianzhou, administering Zhaowu and Ningyuan two counties.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Qianzhou was founded in western Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 壬子夜，月掩畢。

translations.literal: On renzi night the moon covered Bi.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi night the moon occulted Bi.

sentences.zh: 甲子，冊新羅國王金乾運母為太妃。

translations.literal: On jiazi the mother of Silla King Kim Geonun was enfeoffed Grand Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Silla's queen mother was enfeoffed grand consort.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以工部侍郎蔣渙為尚書左丞，浙西團練觀察使、蘇州刺史韋元甫為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Vice Minister of Works Jiang Huan was made Left Secretariat Vice Director; Zhexi training and observation commissioner and Suzhou prefect Wei Yuanfu was made Right Secretariat Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Jiang Huan and Wei Yuanfu became left and right vice directors.

sentences.zh: 左丞李涵、右丞賈至並為兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director Li Han and Right Vice Director Jia Zhi were both made Vice Ministers of War.
translations.idiomatic: Li Han and Jia Zhi became vice ministers of war.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，永和公主薨。

translations.literal: On yihai Princess Yonghe died.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Princess Yonghe passed away.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，以常州刺史李棲筠為蘇州刺史、兼御史中丞、浙西團練觀察使。

translations.literal: On jimao Changzhou prefect Li Qiyun was made Suzhou prefect, concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief and Zhexi training and observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Li Qiyun became Suzhou prefect and Zhexi commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬午，邠寧節度使馬璘來朝。

translations.literal: On renwu Binxia military commissioner Ma Lin came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Ma Lin came to court.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on yisi new moon, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 壬申，割恆州行唐縣置泜州，以靈壽、恆陽隸之。

translations.literal: On renshen Xingtang county of Hengzhou was split to establish Qizhou, with Lingshou and Hengyang subordinate.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Qizhou was carved from Hengzhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊寅，以山南西道節度使、鄧國公張獻誠為檢校戶部尚書。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on wuyin, Shannan West military commissioner and Duke of Deng Zhang Xianchéng was made acting Minister of Households.
translations.idiomatic: Summer fourth month: Zhang Xianchéng became acting minister of households.

sentences.zh: 以疾辭位也。

translations.literal: He resigned the post because of illness.
translations.idiomatic: He stepped down citing illness.

sentences.zh: 右羽林將軍張獻恭為梁州刺史、兼御史中丞，充山南西道節度觀察使。

translations.literal: Right Forest Guard General Zhang Xiangong was made Liangzhou prefect, concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief, and Shannan West military and observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xiangong succeeded him in Shannan West at his brother's recommendation.

sentences.zh: 兄獻誠所薦也。

translations.literal: His elder brother Xianchéng had recommended him.
translations.idiomatic: The appointment followed Xianchéng's petition.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，滑亳節度使令狐彰加檢校工部尚書。

translations.literal: On renyin Hua-Bo military commissioner Linghu Zhang was advanced acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Linghu Zhang became acting minister of works.

sentences.zh: 劍南西川節度使、兼御史大夫崔旰來朝。

translations.literal: Jiannan West River military commissioner, concurrent Censor-in-Chief Cui Gan came to court.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Gan of Sichuan came to court.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申，加崔旰檢校右散騎常待。

translations.literal: On wushen Cui Gan was advanced Acting Right Palace Companion.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Cui Gan became acting right palace companion.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，追謚故齊王倓為承天皇帝，興信公主亡女張氏為恭順皇后，祔葬。

translations.literal: On yimao the late Prince of Qi Li Tan was posthumously titled Emperor Chengtian; the deceased daughter of Princess Xingxin, née Zhang, was Empress Gongshun — joint burial.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Li Tan was posthumously enthroned as Chengtian; a Zhang consort was buried with him.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，改桂州臨源縣為全義縣。

translations.literal: On xinyou Guilin Linyuan county was renamed Quanyi county.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Linyuan became Quanyi.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以左散騎常侍崔昭為京兆尹。

translations.literal: On guiyou Left Palace Companion Cui Zhao was made Jingzhao prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Cui Zhao became Jingzhao prefect.

sentences.zh: 是日地震。

translations.literal: That day there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: An earthquake struck that day.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以劍南西川節度使崔旰檢校工部尚書，改名寧。

translations.literal: On wuchen Jiannan West River military commissioner Cui Gan was advanced acting Minister of Works and renamed Ning.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Cui Gan became minister of works and took the name Ning.

sentences.zh: 寧為柏茂林、楊子琳所攻，寧既入朝，子琳乘虛襲據成都府。

translations.literal: Ning was attacked by Bo Maolin and Yang Zilin; Ning having entered court, Zilin seized Chengdu prefecture by surprise.
translations.idiomatic: While Cui Ning was at court, Yang Zilin seized Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 朝廷憂之，即日詔寧還成都。

translations.literal: The court was anxious; that very day an edict ordered Ning to return to Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: The throne immediately ordered him back to Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以邛州剌史鮮於叔明為梓州刺史，充劍南東川節度使。

translations.literal: On gengwu Qiongzhou prefect Xianyu Shuming was made Zizhou prefect and Jiannan East River military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Xianyu Shuming was sent east in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子，承天皇帝祔奉天皇帝廟，同殿異室，庚寅，太子少師王璵卒。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on wuzi, Emperor Chengtian was enshrined in Emperor Fengtian's temple, same hall different chamber; on gengyin Heir Apparent Junior Tutor Wang Yu died.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: Chengtian was enshrined; Wang Yu died on gengyin.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，幽州節度使、檢校侍中、幽州大都督府長史李懷仙為麾下兵馬使朱希彩所殺。

translations.literal: On gengzi Youzhou military commissioner, acting Palace Attendant, chief of Youzhou metropolitan prefecture Li Huaixian was killed by his camp army commissioner Zhu Xicai.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Li Huaixian was murdered by Zhu Xicai at Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚子，淮南節度使檢校尚書左僕射、知省事、揚州大都督府長史、趙國公崔圓卒。

translations.literal: On gengzi Huainan military commissioner, acting Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat, knowing ministry affairs, chief of Yangzhou metropolitan prefecture, Duke of Zhao Cui Yuan died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Cui Yuan, Duke of Zhao and Huainan commissioner, died.

sentences.zh: 閏月己酉，郭子儀加司徒。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on jiyou, Guo Ziyi was advanced Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month: Guo Ziyi became grand mentor.

sentences.zh: 庚申，宰臣充河南副元帥王縉兼幽州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengshen Chancellor and Henan deputy commander-in-chief Wang Jin also took Youzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Wang Jin added the Youzhou command.

sentences.zh: 以尚書右丞韋元甫揚州大都督府長史，兼御史大夫，充淮南節度觀察等使。

translations.literal: Right Secretariat Vice Director Wei Yuanfu was made chief of Yangzhou metropolitan prefecture, concurrent Censor-in-Chief, and Huainan military and observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Yuanfu replaced Cui Yuan in Huainan.

sentences.zh: 西卯，以幽州節度副使、試太常卿朱希彩知幽州留後。

translations.literal: On xinmao Youzhou military vice commissioner, acting Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Zhu Xicai was made acting Youzhou regent.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Zhu Xicai was named acting Youzhou regent.

sentences.zh: 遣兵部侍郎李涵兼御史大夫，使河北宣慰，以幽州亂故也。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of War Li Han was made concurrent Censor-in-Chief and sent to comfort Hebei — because of Youzhou's disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Li Han was sent to Hebei because of the Youzhou chaos.

sentences.zh: 庚午，相州薛嵩、魏州田承嗣、恆州李寶臣並加左右僕射。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on renshen, Xiangzhou Xue Song, Weizhou Tian Chengsi, and Hengzhou Li Baochen were all advanced Left and Right Vice Directors.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: three Hebei warlords became vice directors.

sentences.zh: 七月壬申，崔寧弟寬攻破楊子琳，收復成都府。

translations.literal: That month Cui Ning's younger brother Kuan broke Yang Zilin and recovered Chengdu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month Cui Kuan drove out Yang Zilin and retook Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 是月，五星並聚於東井，占曰：中國之利也。

translations.literal: That month the five planets all gathered in Eastern Well; the omen stated: benefit to the Central State.
translations.idiomatic: That month five planets gathered in Eastern Well — an omen of favor to China.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，王縉赴鎮州。

translations.literal: On yihai Wang Jin went to Zhenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Wang Jin departed for Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月己未，月掩畢。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jiwei, the moon covered Bi.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: lunar occultation of Bi.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，月入東井。

translations.literal: On xinyou the moon entered Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the moon moved into Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，吐蕃十萬寇靈武。

translations.literal: On renxu one hundred thousand Tibetans raided Lingwu.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu a hundred thousand Tibetans struck Lingwu.

sentences.zh: 熒或犯太微垣。

translations.literal: The Spark Star violated the Taiwei enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: Mars entered the Taiwei asterism.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，吐蕃寇邠寧，節度使馬璘破吐蕃二萬於邠州。

translations.literal: On dingmao Tibet raided Binxia; military commissioner Ma Lin broke twenty thousand Tibetans at Binzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Ma Lin defeated twenty thousand Tibetans at Bin.

sentences.zh: 御史大夫崔渙為稅地青青錢使。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Cui Huan was made Green-Sprout land-tax commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Huan took charge of the green-sprout land tax.

sentences.zh: 給百官俸錢不平，詔尚書左丞蔣渙按鞫，貶崔渙為道州刺史。

translations.literal: Official salary cash was unequal; an edict ordered Left Secretariat Vice Director Jiang Huan to investigate — Cui Huan was demoted to Daozhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Huan's inquiry into unequal salaries demoted Cui Huan to Daozhou.

sentences.zh: 庚午，河東節度使、檢校左僕射、太原尹、同中書門下平章事辛云京卒。

translations.literal: On gengwu Hedong military commissioner, acting Left Vice Director, Taiyuan prefect, Associate Grand Secretariat Xin Yunjing died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Xin Yunjing of Hedong died.

sentences.zh: 門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事、兼幽州長史、持節、河南副元帥、都統河南淮西山南東道諸節度行營、兼幽州盧龍等軍節度使、太微宮使、弘文館大學士、兼東都留守、齊國公王縉兼太原尹、北都留守，充河東軍節度，餘官使並如故。

translations.literal: Chancellery Vice Director, Associate Grand Secretariat, concurrent Youzhou chief, holding credentials, Henan deputy commander-in-chief, overall commander of Henan, Huai-Xi, and Hedong South campaign circuits, concurrent Youzhou Lulong and other armies military commissioner, Grand Supreme Ultimate Palace commissioner, Hongwen Hall grand academician, concurrent Eastern Capital garrison commander, Duke of Qi Wang Jin also Taiyuan prefect and Northern Capital garrison commander, charged with Hedong army military commission — other offices and commissioners as before.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jin absorbed Taiyuan and Hedong while keeping his eastern commands.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事、山劍副元帥、太清宮使、崇玄館大學士杜鴻漸兼東都留守。

translations.literal: On xinwei Chancellery Vice Director, Associate Grand Secretariat, Mountain-Sword deputy commander-in-chief, Grand Supreme Clarity Palace commissioner, Chongxuan Hall grand academician Du Hongjian was also Eastern Capital garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Du Hongjian also became Luoyang commandant.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renshen.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, renshen.

sentences.zh: 郭子儀自河中移鎮奉天。

translations.literal: Guo Ziyi shifted garrison from Hezhong to Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Ziyi moved from Hezhong to Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 歲星入輿鬼。

translations.literal: The Year Star entered Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter entered the mansion Ghost.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，濟王環薨。

translations.literal: On dingchou Prince of Ji Li Huan died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Li Huan, Prince of Ji, died.

sentences.zh: 熒惑入太微垣。

translations.literal: The Spark Star entered the Taiwei enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: Mars again entered Taiwei.

sentences.zh: 壬午，吐蕃寇靈州。

translations.literal: On renyang Tibet raided Lingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renyang Tibetans struck Lingzhou again.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以尚書左丞蔣渙為華州刺史，充鎮國軍潼關防禦使。

translations.literal: On jiashen Left Secretariat Vice Director Jiang Huan was made Huazhou prefect and Zhenguo Army Tong Pass defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Jiang Huan was sent to guard Tong Pass at Hua.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，檢校戶部尚書、知省事、鄧國公張獻誠卒。

translations.literal: On bingxu Acting Minister of Households, knowing ministry affairs, Duke of Deng Zhang Xianchéng died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Zhang Xianchéng died.

sentences.zh: 丁亥。

translations.literal: On dinghai.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai [no further entry].

sentences.zh: 工部尚書趙國珍卒。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Zhao Guozhen died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Guozhen, Minister of Works, died.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以華州刺史張重光為尚書左丞。

translations.literal: On gengyin Huazhou prefect Zhang Chongguang was made Left Secretariat Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Zhang Chongguang became left vice director.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，靈州將白元光破吐蕃二萬於靈武。

translations.literal: On renchen Lingzhou general Bai Guangye broke twenty thousand Tibetans at Lingwu.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Bai Guangye defeated twenty thousand Tibetans at Lingwu.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，靈武奏破吐蕃六萬，百僚稱賀，京師解嚴。

translations.literal: On wuxu Lingwu memorialized breaking sixty thousand Tibetans; the hundred officials offered congratulations; the capital alert was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu sixty thousand Tibetans were reported broken; the court congratulated and stood down.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲寅，朔方留後、靈武大都督府長史常廉光加檢校工部尚書。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, jiazi: Shuofang acting commissioner and Lingwu grand protectorate chief administrator Chang Lianguang was made acting minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi of the tenth winter month, acting Shuofang commissioner Chang Lianguang of Lingwu was made acting minister of works.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以京兆尹李勉為廣州刺史，充嶺南節度使。

translations.literal: On yimi, Capital Metropolitan Prefect Li Mian was made Guangzhou prefect and Lingnan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yimi, Li Mian left the capital for Guangzhou as prefect and Lingnan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，子儀自奉天來朝。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Ziyi came to court from Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Guo Ziyi arrived from Fengtian for audience.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁亥，幽州留後朱希彩為幽州長史，充幽州盧龍節度使，癸巳，加廊下百官廚料，增舊五分之一。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, dinghai: Youzhou acting commissioner Zhu Xicai became Youzhou chief administrator and Youzhou-Lulong military commissioner; guisi: corridor officials' kitchen allowances were increased by one-fifth over the old rate.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dinghai Zhu Xicai became Youzhou administrator and Lulong commissioner; on guisi officials' mess stipends rose one-fifth.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅，道州刺史崔渙卒。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, renyin: Daozhou prefect Cui Huan died.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin of the twelfth month, Daozhou prefect Cui Huan died.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以邠寧節度使馬璘為涇原節度，移鎮涇州，其邠寧割隸朔方軍。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Binning military commissioner Ma Lin was made Jingyuan commissioner, headquarters moved to Jingzhou; Binning was detached to the Shuofang army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Ma Lin became Jingyuan commissioner and moved to Jingzhou, while Binning passed to Shuofang command.

sentences.zh: 邠州將吏以燒馬坊為亂，兵馬使段秀實斬其兇首八人，方定。

translations.literal: Bing prefectural officers and clerks rioted over burning the horse yards; military commissioner Duan Xiushi beheaded eight ringleaders before order returned.
translations.idiomatic: At Bing, officers rioted when the horse yards burned; Duan Xiushi executed eight leaders and restored order.

sentences.zh: 大歷四年四年春正月庚午朔。

translations.literal: Dali 4, spring, first month, gengwu new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Dali 4 opened on the gengwu new moon of the first spring month.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，大風。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, great wind.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu a violent wind blew.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，大雪，平地盈尺。

translations.literal: On yihai, heavy snow; a full foot on level ground.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai snow piled a foot deep across the plain.

sentences.zh: 甲申，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the sun was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 子儀回河中。

translations.literal: Ziyi returned to Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Ziyi went back to Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 戊子，敕有司定王公士庶每戶稅錢，分上、中、下三等。

translations.literal: On wuzi, an edict ordered officials to fix per-household tax money for nobles, gentry, and commoners in upper, middle, and lower grades.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the court fixed household taxes in three grades for nobles, gentry, and commoners.

sentences.zh: 宗室潁州刺史李岵專殺，法司以議親，宜賜自盡。

translations.literal: Imperial clansman Yingzhou prefect Li Qi wantonly killed; the law office, citing kinship, recommended he be granted suicide.
translations.idiomatic: Li Qi of Ying prefecture, a royal cousin, murdered wantonly; the law office, citing kinship, urged he be allowed to take his own life.

sentences.zh: 乙未，福建觀察使李承昭請徙汀州於長汀縣之白石村，從之。

translations.literal: On yimi, Fujian observation commissioner Li Chengzhao asked to move Ting prefecture to Baishi village in Changting county; approved.
translations.idiomatic: On yimi, Li Chengzhao won approval to relocate Ting prefecture to Baishi in Changting.

sentences.zh: 黑衣大食國使朝貢。

translations.literal: An envoy of the Black-Robed Abbasid state came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys from the Black-Robed Abbasid realm presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，以瀘州刺史楊子琳為陜州刺史。

translations.literal: Second month, yisi: Luzhou prefect Yang Zilin was made Shaan prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi of the second month, Yang Zilin of Luzhou became Shaan prefect.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，宰臣杜鴻漸讓山劍副元帥，從之。

translations.literal: On yimao, chief minister Du Hongjian resigned as Shannan-Xichuan deputy commander; approved.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Du Hongjian resigned the Shannan-Xichuan deputy command; the emperor assented.

sentences.zh: 丙辰夜，地震，有聲如雷者三。

translations.literal: Night of bingchen, earthquake; three thunderous sounds.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of bingchen the earth shook with three peals like thunder.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以湖南都團練觀察使、衡州刺史韋之晉為潭州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Hunan all-circuits training and observation commissioner and Hengzhou prefect Wei Zhijin was made Tanzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Wei Zhijin of Hunan and Hengzhou was appointed Tanzhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 因是徙湖南軍於潭州。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Hunan army was moved to Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Hunan garrison was then shifted to Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 江西團練使魏少游來朝。

translations.literal: Jiangxi training commissioner Wei Shaoyou came to court.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Shaoyou of Jiangxi came to audience.

sentences.zh: 三月壬申，詔：

translations.literal: Third month, renshen, edict:
translations.idiomatic: On renshen of the third month an edict ran:

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書裴遵慶為右僕射，劉晏改吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Pei Zunqing was made right vice director; Liu Yan became minister of personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Zunqing became right vice director; Liu Yan took the ministry of personnel.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，江西團練使魏少游封趙國公。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Jiangxi training commissioner Wei Shaoyou was enfeoffed Duke of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Wei Shaoyou was made Duke of Zhao.

sentences.zh: 丙申復置仙州。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Xian prefecture was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Xianzhou was re-established.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬寅，陜州虞邑縣復為安邑縣，虢州天平縣復為湖城縣。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, renyin: Shaan Yuyi county reverted to Anyi county; Guo Tianping county reverted to Hucheng county.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin of the fourth month, Yuyi became Anyi again and Tianping became Hucheng.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，京師地震。

translations.literal: Fifth month, bingxu, the capital shook in an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu of the fifth month the capital was shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以僕固懷恩女為崇徽公主，嫁回紇可汗，仍命兵部侍郎李涵往冊命。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Pugu Huai'en's daughter was made Princess Chonghui and married the Uyghur qaghan; Vice Minister of War Li Han was sent to invest her.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Huai'en's daughter became Princess Chonghui and wed the Uyghur qaghan, with Li Han bearing the patent of investiture.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，以太子詹事臧希讓檢校工部尚書，充渭北節度；

translations.literal: Sixth month, dingyou: crown prince tutor Zang Xirang was made acting minister of works and Weibei commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, crown prince tutor Zang Xirang became acting minister of works and Weibei commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以渭北節度李光進為太子太保。

translations.literal: Weibei commissioner Li Guangjin was made grand guardian of the heir.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guangjin of Weibei was made grand guardian of the heir.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，升辰州為都督府，析辰、巫、溪、錦、業等州置團練觀察使。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Chenzhou was raised to a grand protectorate; Chen, Wu, Xi, Jin, Ye, and other prefectures were split off for a training and observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Chenzhou became a protectorate and a training commissioner was set over Chen, Wu, Xi, Jin, Ye, and neighboring prefectures.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己巳，以灃州刺史崔瓘為潭州刺史、湖南都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jisi: Feng prefect Cui Guan was made Tanzhou prefect and Hunan all-circuits training and observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi of the seventh month, Cui Guan of Feng became Tanzhou prefect and Hunan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以天下刑官濫刑，詔：

translations.literal: On guiwei, because penal officials abused punishment throughout the realm, an edict:
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, citing abusive punishments empire-wide, the emperor issued an edict:

sentences.zh: 先是，皇姨弟薛華因酒色之急，手刃三人，棄尸於井，事發系獄，賜自盡，故有是詔。

translations.literal: Earlier, the emperor's maternal cousin Xue Hua, in wine and lust, had slain three with his own hand and cast the bodies in a well; when the affair broke he was imprisoned and granted suicide—hence this edict.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the emperor's cousin Xue Hua, drunk and lustful, had killed three men and hidden them in a well; tried and allowed suicide, which prompted this edict.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申朔。

translations.literal: Eighth month, bingshen new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The eighth month opened on bingshen.

sentences.zh: 自夏四月連雨至此月，京城米斗八百文。

translations.literal: From the fourth month of summer rain continued to this month; capital grain reached eight hundred cash per dou.
translations.idiomatic: Rain since the fourth month drove capital grain to eight hundred cash a dou.

sentences.zh: 官出米二萬石，減估而糶，以惠貧民。

translations.literal: The government released twenty thousand shi of grain, sold at reduced price to aid the poor.
translations.idiomatic: The court sold twenty thousand shi of grain at reduced price to relieve the poor.

sentences.zh: 己卯，虎入長壽坊元載家廟，射生將周皓引弩斃之。

translations.literal: On jimao, a tiger entered Yuan Zai's ancestral temple in Changshou ward; hunting officer Zhou Hao shot it dead with a crossbow.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao a tiger entered Yuan Zai's family shrine in Changshou; Zhou Hao of the hunt shot it dead.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙卯，以汝州刺史孟皞為京兆尹。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, yimao: Ruzhou prefect Meng Hao was made metropolitan prefect of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao of the tenth winter month, Meng Hao of Ruzhou became capital metropolitan prefect.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未，禁畿內弋獵。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, xinwei: hunting within the capital precincts was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei of the eleventh month, hunting inside the capital bounds was banned.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事、衛國公杜鴻漸卒。

translations.literal: On yihai, vice director of the Chancellery, fellow grand councilor, and Duke of Wei Du Hongjian died.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, grand councilor and Duke of Wei Du Hongjian died.

sentences.zh: 丙子以左僕射、冀國公裴冕同中書門下平章事，充東都留守、河南淮南淮西山南東道副元帥。

translations.literal: On bingzi, left vice director and Duke of Ji Pei Mian became fellow grand councilor, eastern capital guardian, and deputy commander of Henan, Huainan, Huai-xi, and Shannan-east circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Pei Mian became grand councilor, Luoyang guardian, and deputy commander over Henan and allied circuits.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙未，敕左右補闕、拾遺、內供奉員左右各置兩員，餘罷之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, yimi: an edict set left and right remonstrating and advising officials and inner attendants at two posts each on either side; the rest were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yimi of the twelfth month, remonstrators and advisers were fixed at two posts per side; surplus posts were cut.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，裴冕卒。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Pei Mian died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Pei Mian died.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，敕京兆府稅宜分作兩等，上等每畝稅一斗，下等稅六升，能耕墾荒地者稅二升。

translations.literal: On xinyou, an edict divided the capital prefecture's land tax into two grades: upper fields one dou per mu, lower six sheng; reclaimed wasteland paid two sheng.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the capital's land tax was split: top grade one dou per mu, lower six sheng, wasteland reclaimed at two sheng.

sentences.zh: 大歷五年五年春正月乙丑朔。

translations.literal: Dali 5, spring, first month, yichou new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Dali 5 began on the yichou new moon of the first spring month.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以陜州節度使皇甫溫判鳳翔尹，充鳳翔、河隴節度使；

translations.literal: On xinmao, Shaan military commissioner Huangfu Wen was made acting Fengxiang metropolitan prefect and Fengxiang-Longyou commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Huangfu Wen of Shaan became acting Fengxiang prefect and Fengxiang-Longyou commissioner;

sentences.zh: 鳳翔節度使李抱玉判梁州事，充山南西道節度使。

translations.literal: Fengxiang commissioner Li Baoyu was made acting Liangzhou administrator and Shannan-west commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Baoyu of Fengxiang took Liangzhou and the Shannan-west command.

sentences.zh: 壬申，河南尹張延賞兼御史大夫，充東都留守。

translations.literal: On renshen, Henan metropolitan prefect Zhang Yanshang was made censor-in-chief and eastern capital guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Zhang Yanshang of Henan became censor-in-chief and Luoyang guardian.

sentences.zh: 罷河南、淮西、山南東道副元帥，所管軍隸東都留守。

translations.literal: The deputy commands of Henan, Huai-xi, and Shannan-east were abolished; their armies passed to the eastern capital guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy commands over Henan, Huai-xi, and Shannan-east were ended and their troops placed under Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌，李抱玉移鎮盩厔，鳳翔軍忿，縱兵大掠，數日乃止。

translations.literal: Second month, wuxu: Li Baoyu moved headquarters to Zhouzhi; Fengxiang troops, enraged, plundered for days before stopping.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Baoyu moved to Zhouzhi; Fengxiang soldiers rioted and looted for days.

sentences.zh: 己亥。

translations.literal: On jihai.
translations.idiomatic: The same day, on jihai,

sentences.zh: 廢仙川，以襄城、葉縣隸汝州。

translations.literal: Xianchuan was abolished; Xiangcheng and Yexian were attached to Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xianchuan was abolished and Xiangcheng and Ye attached to Ruzhou.

sentences.zh: 詔罷魚朝恩觀軍容使。

translations.literal: An edict abolished Yu Chao'en's post as commissioner overseeing the army.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stripped Yu Chao'en of his army-overseer commission.

sentences.zh: 己巳，朝恩自縊而死。

translations.literal: On jisi, Chao'en hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Yu Chao'en took his own life by hanging.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔定京兆府戶稅。

translations.literal: On wuyin, an edict fixed the capital prefecture's household tax.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin an edict fixed household taxes for the capital district.

sentences.zh: 夏稅，上田畝稅六升，下田四升。

translations.literal: Summer tax: upper fields six sheng per mu, lower four.
translations.idiomatic: Summer levy: six sheng per mu on top fields, four on lower.

sentences.zh: 秋稅，上田畝五升，下田三升。

translations.literal: Autumn tax: upper fields five sheng per mu, lower three.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn levy: five sheng on top fields, three on lower.

sentences.zh: 荒田開墾者二升。

translations.literal: Reclaimed wasteland paid two sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Newly opened wasteland paid two sheng.

sentences.zh: 己丑，敕：

translations.literal: On jichou, edict:
translations.idiomatic: On jichou an edict declared:

sentences.zh: 於是悉以度支之務委於宰相。

translations.literal: Thereupon all fiscal affairs of the revenue bureau were entrusted to the chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth all revenue matters went to the chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以兵部侍郎賈至為京兆尹。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Vice Minister of War Jia Zhi was made metropolitan prefect of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Jia Zhi became capital metropolitan prefect.

sentences.zh: 以京西兵馬使李忠臣為鳳翔尹，代皇甫溫。

translations.literal: Capital west military commissioner Li Zhongchen was made Fengxiang metropolitan prefect, replacing Huangfu Wen.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhongchen of the capital west army replaced Huangfu Wen as Fengxiang metropolitan prefect.

sentences.zh: 溫移鎮陜州。

translations.literal: Wen moved headquarters to Shaan.
translations.idiomatic: Huangfu Wen transferred to Shaan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚子，湖南都團練使崔旰為其兵馬使臧玠所殺，玠據潭州為亂，灃州刺史楊子琳、道州刺史裴虯、衡州刺史楊漳出軍討玠。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, gengzi: Hunan training commissioner Cui Gan was killed by his military commissioner Zang Jie; Jie seized Tanzhou in revolt; Feng prefect Yang Zilin, Daozhou prefect Pei Qiu, and Hengzhou prefect Yang Zhang led troops against Jie.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Cui Gan of Hunan was murdered by Zang Jie, who seized Tanzhou; Yang Zilin, Pei Qiu, and Yang Zhang marched against him.

sentences.zh: 乙巳夜，歲星入軒轅。

translations.literal: Night of yisi, the Year Star entered the Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of yisi Jupiter entered the Chariot constellation.

sentences.zh: 丙午，復置先農、馬祖壇，祀之。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the Former Farmer and Horse Ancestor altars were restored and sacrifices offered.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the Former Farmer and Horse Ancestor altars were restored to worship.

sentences.zh: 丁未，封幽州節度使朱希彩為高密郡王。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Youzhou commissioner Zhu Xicai was enfeoffed Prince of Gaomi commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Zhu Xicai of Youzhou was made Prince of Gaomi.

sentences.zh: 己未夜，彗起五車，長三丈。

translations.literal: Night of jiwei, a comet rose at the Five Chariots, three zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of jiwei a three-zhang comet appeared at the Five Chariots.

sentences.zh: 庚申，宰臣太原尹王縉入朝。

translations.literal: On gengshen, chief minister and Taiyuan metropolitan prefect Wang Jin entered court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Wang Jin of Taiyuan came to audience as chief minister.

sentences.zh: 五月辛未，刑部侍郎黎幹為桂州刺史、桂管防禦經略招討觀察等使。

translations.literal: Fifth month, xinwei: Vice Minister of Punishments Li Gan was made Guilin prefect and Guiguan defense, pacification, recruitment, and observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Li Gan became Guilin prefect and commissioner over Guiguan.

sentences.zh: 己卯夜，彗起北方，其色白。

translations.literal: Night of jimao, a comet rose in the north, white in color.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of jimao a white comet rose in the north.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，貶禮儀使、禮部尚書裴士淹為虔州刺史，戶部侍郎、判度支第五琦為饒州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Director of Rites and Minister of Rites Pei Shiyao was demoted to Qianzhou prefect; Vice Minister of Revenue and fiscal commissioner Diwu Qi was demoted to Raozhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Pei Shiyao was sent to Qianzhou and Diwu Qi to Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 皆魚朝恩黨也。

translations.literal: Both were Yu Chao'en's faction.
translations.idiomatic: Both had been partisans of Yu Chao'en.

sentences.zh: 元載既誅朝恩，下制罷使，仍放黜之。

translations.literal: Yuan Zai, having executed Chao'en, issued an edict abolishing the commission and dismissing them.
translations.idiomatic: After killing Chao'en, Yuan Zai abolished the post by edict and cashiered his allies.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以羽林大將軍辛京杲為潭州刺史、湖南觀察使。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Imperial Guard general Xin Jinggao was made Tanzhou prefect and Hunan observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Xin Jinggao of the guard became Tanzhou prefect and Hunan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲申，西北白氣竟天。

translations.literal: On jiashen, white vapor in the northwest filled the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen white mist in the northwest stretched across heaven.

sentences.zh: 徙置當、悉、柘、靜、恭五州於山險要害地，備吐蕃也。

translations.literal: Dang, Xi, Zhe, Jing, and Gong prefectures were moved to mountain strongholds to guard against Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: Dang, Xi, Zhe, Jing, and Gong were relocated to mountain passes against Tibetan raids.

sentences.zh: 六月己未彗星始滅，赦天下見禁囚徒。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jiwei: the comet finally faded; an amnesty freed all prisoners in custody.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the comet vanished and the throne amnestied prisoners empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁卯，以浙東觀察使、越州刺史、御史大夫薛兼訓為檢校工部尚書、太原尹、北都留守，充河東節度使。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, dingmao: Zhedong observation commissioner, Yuezhou prefect, and censor-in-chief Xue Jianxun was made acting minister of works, Taiyuan metropolitan prefect, northern capital guardian, and Hedong military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Xue Jianxun of Zhedong became acting minister of works, Taiyuan prefect, and Hedong commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是月，京城斗米千文。

translations.literal: That month capital grain reached one thousand cash per dou.
translations.idiomatic: That month grain in the capital cost a thousand cash the dou.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，宰臣元載上疏請置中都於河中府，秋杪行幸，春中還京，以避蕃戎侵寇之患。

translations.literal: Eighth month, xinmao: chief minister Yuan Zai memorialized to establish a central capital at Hezhong, traveling there in late autumn and returning in mid-spring to escape Tibetan raids.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Yuan Zai asked to make Hezhong a secondary capital, wintering there and returning in spring to escape Tibetans.

sentences.zh: 疏入不報。

translations.literal: The memorial entered and received no reply.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial went unanswered.

sentences.zh: 載疏大旨以關輔、河東等十州戶稅入奉京師，創置精兵五萬，以威四方。

translations.literal: The gist of Zai's memorial was that household taxes of ten circuits including Guanfu and Hedong should enter the capital, and fifty thousand elite troops be raised to awe the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Zai argued that taxes from Guanfu, Hedong, and eight other regions should feed the capital and fifty thousand crack troops awe the realm.

sentences.zh: 辭多捭闔，欲權歸於己也。

translations.literal: The words were full of maneuver; he wished power to return to himself.
translations.idiomatic: The rhetoric was cunning; he meant to concentrate power in his own hands.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑，以宣、歙、池等州都團練觀察使、宣州刺史、兼御史中丞陳少游充浙江東道團練觀察使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, dingchou: Xu, She, Chi, and other circuits' all-training observation commissioner, Xu prefect, and acting censor-in-chief Chen Shaoyou was made Zhejiang-east training and observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Chen Shaoyou became Zhejiang-east training and observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃寇永壽。

translations.literal: Tibet raided Yongshou.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetans raided Yongshou.

sentences.zh: 汴州田神功來朝。

translations.literal: Bianzhou's Tian Shenggong came to court.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Shenggong of Bianzhou came to audience.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙未，改巫州為漵州，業州為蔣州。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, yimi: Wu prefecture was renamed Xi; Ye prefecture was renamed Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: On yimi of the twelfth month, Wu became Xi prefecture and Ye became Jiang.

sentences.zh: 大歷六年六年春正月己未朔。

translations.literal: Dali 6, spring, first month, jiwei new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Dali 6 opened on the jiwei new moon of the first spring month.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，於鄜州之鄜城置肅戎軍。

translations.literal: On wuyin, the Suwu army was established at Yancheng in Yan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the Suwu army was posted at Yancheng in Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月乙酉御史大夫敬括卒。

translations.literal: Second month, yiyou: censor-in-chief Jing Kuo died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou of the second month, censor-in-chief Jing Kuo died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁巳，上御宣政殿試制舉人，至夕，策未成者，令太官給燭，俾盡其才。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, dingsi: the emperor held the palace examination for decree graduates at Xuanzheng Hall; by evening those whose answers were unfinished were given candles from the imperial kitchen to finish their talent.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the emperor examined decree graduates at Xuanzheng Hall and, when answers ran past nightfall, sent palace candles so they could finish.

sentences.zh: 己未，灃州刺史楊子琳來朝，賜名猷。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Feng prefect Yang Zilin came to court and was granted the name You.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Yang Zilin of Feng came to court and received the name You.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，改果州為充州。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Guo prefecture was renamed Chong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Guo prefecture became Chongzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔：「纂組文繡，正害女紅。

translations.literal: On wuyin, edict: "Ornate weaving and embroidery harm women's proper work.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin an edict declared: "Fine brocades and embroidery waste women's labor.

sentences.zh: 今師旅未息，黎元空虛，豈可使淫巧之風，有虧常制。

translations.literal: Now armies have not ceased and the people are emptied—how can we let wanton craft injure constant regulation?
translations.idiomatic: Armies still march and the people are drained—we cannot let luxury crafts break the law.

sentences.zh: 其綾錦花文所織盤龍、對鳳、麒麟、獅子、天馬、闢邪、孔雀、仙鶴、芝草、萬字、雙勝、透背、及大繝綿、竭鑿、六破已上、並窒禁斷。

translations.literal: All brocades with dragon, paired phoenix, qilin, lion, heavenly horse, demon-queller, crane, sacred fungus, ten-thousand-character, double-victory, open-back patterns, and great floss silks, openwork, and six-break weaves and above are altogether forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Brocades bearing dragons, phoenix pairs, qilin, lions, heavenly horses, demon-quellers, cranes, sacred fungus, wan characters, double victories, open backs, heavy floss, openwork, and six-break weaves or finer are banned outright.

sentences.zh: 其長行高麗白錦、大小花綾錦，任依舊例織造。

translations.literal: Long-run Goryeo white brocades and large and small flowered silks may be woven as before.
translations.idiomatic: Long-run Goryeo white brocades and large and small patterned silks may still be woven under the old rules.

sentences.zh: 有司明行曉諭。

translations.literal: The responsible offices were to proclaim and instruct clearly.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were ordered to publish the ban and explain it clearly.

translations.literal: Closing mark of the edict.
translations.idiomatic: The edict closed."

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯，以河南尹張延賞為御史大夫。

translations.literal: Fifth month, guimao: Henan metropolitan prefect Zhang Yanshang was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao of the fifth month, Zhang Yanshang of Henan became censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙巳，月掩畢。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, yisi: the moon occulted the Net.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi of the seventh month the moon passed before the Net.

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯，淮南節度使韋元甫卒。

translations.literal: Eighth month, yimao: Huainan military commissioner Wei Yuanfu died.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao of the eighth month, Wei Yuanfu of Huainan died.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以東都副留守常休明為檢校左散騎常侍、河陽三城使。

translations.literal: On bingchen, eastern capital deputy guardian Chang Xiuming was made acting left regular cavalry attendant and Heyang Three Cities commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Chang Xiuming became acting left regular cavalry attendant and commissioner of the Heyang Three Cities.

sentences.zh: 夏旱，此月己未始雨。
