translations.literal: Summer drought; only on jiwei of this month did rain begin.
translations.idiomatic: After a summer drought, rain did not come until jiwei of this month.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以御史大夫張延賞為揚州大都督府長史、淮南節度使。

translations.literal: On gengwu, censor-in-chief Zhang Yanshang was made chief administrator of Yangzhou grand protectorate and Huainan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Zhang Yanshang became Yangzhou chief administrator and Huainan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙午、以蘇州刺史、浙江觀察使李棲筠為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Suzhou prefect and Zhejiang observation commissioner Li Qiyun was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Li Qiyun of Suzhou and Zhejiang became censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，獲白兔於太極殿之內廊。

translations.literal: On dingchou a white hare was caught in the inner corridor of Taiji Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou a white hare was found in Taiji Hall's inner corridor.

sentences.zh: 庚辰夜，月入紫微垣。

translations.literal: Night of gengchen, the moon entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of gengchen the moon entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰夜，熒惑犯哭星。

translations.literal: Night of renchen of the ninth month, Mars trespassed the Weeping star.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of renchen in the ninth month, Mars crossed the Weeping star.

sentences.zh: 自八月連雨，害秋稼。

translations.literal: From the eighth month rain continued and harmed the autumn crop.
translations.idiomatic: Rain from the eighth month on ruined the autumn harvest.

sentences.zh: 戊申，於輪臺置靜塞軍。

translations.literal: On wushen, the Jingse army was established at Luntai.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the Jingse army was posted at Luntai.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，熒惑入壁壘。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Mars entered the Ramparts.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Mars entered the Ramparts.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬午，滄州置橫海軍。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, renwu: the Transverse Sea army was established at Cangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu of the tenth winter month the Transverse Sea army was set at Cangzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月己亥，文單國王婆彌來朝，獻馴象一十一。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jihai: King Bomi of Wendantu came to court and presented eleven tame elephants.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, King Bomi of Wendantu came to court with eleven tame elephants.

sentences.zh: 壬寅夜，月入太微，又掩氐。

translations.literal: Night of renyin, the moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure and also occulted Di.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of renyin the moon entered the Supreme Palace and occulted Di.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，江西觀察使、檢校刑部尚書魏少游卒。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jiwei: Jiangxi observation commissioner and acting minister of punishments Wei Shaoyou died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Wei Shaoyou of Jiangxi, acting minister of punishments, died.

sentences.zh: 庚午，制以文單王婆彌開府儀同三司、試殿中監。

translations.literal: On gengwu, by decree King Bomi of Wendantu was made acting master of ceremonies with the same ceremonial rank as a chief minister and trial palace supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, King Bomi was made acting master of ceremonies equal to a chief minister and trial palace supervisor.

sentences.zh: 是歲春旱，米斛至萬錢。

translations.literal: That year spring drought drove grain to ten thousand cash per hu.
translations.idiomatic: Spring drought that year pushed grain to ten thousand cash the hu.

sentences.zh: 大歷七年七年春正月癸未朔。

translations.literal: Dali 7, spring, first month, guiwei new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Dali 7 opened on the guiwei new moon of the first spring month.

sentences.zh: 戊子，於魏州頓邱縣置澶州。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Chao prefecture was established at Dunqiu county in Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Chao prefecture was created at Dunqiu in Wei.

sentences.zh: 以頓邱縣之觀城店置觀城縣，以張之清豐店置清豐縣，並割魏州之臨黃縣，並隸澶州。

translations.literal: Guancheng county was set at Guancheng post in Dunqiu; Qingfeng county at Qingfeng post in Zhang; both were cut from Linhuang in Weizhou and placed under Chao.
translations.idiomatic: Guancheng and Qingfeng counties were carved from Wei's Linhuang and placed under the new Chao prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以貝州臨清縣之張橋店置永濟縣。

translations.literal: Yongji county was established at Zhangqiao post in Linqing of Beizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yongji county was created at Zhangqiao in Beizhou's Linqing.

sentences.zh: 乙未，月犯軒轅。

translations.literal: On yimi, the moon trespassed the Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: On yimi the moon crossed the Chariot.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以檢校戶部尚書路嗣恭為洪州刺史、兼御史大夫、江西觀察使。

translations.literal: On gengzi, acting minister of revenue Lu Sigong was made Hongzhou prefect, concurrent censor-in-chief, and Jiangxi observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Lu Sigong became Hongzhou prefect and Jiangxi commissioner with the censorate.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，太常卿楊綰兼充禮儀使。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Minister of Ceremonies Yang Wan was also made director of rites.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Yang Wan of the ministry of ceremonies also took charge of rites.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，回紇使出鴻臚寺劫坊市，吏不能禁止，復三百騎犯金光、朱雀等門。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Uyghur envoys raided the market outside the Honglu temple; officials could not stop them; three hundred more horsemen violated the Golden Light and Vermilion Bird gates.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Uyghur envoys plundered the Honglu market; when officials failed to stop them, three hundred horsemen broke through the Golden Light and Vermilion Bird gates.

sentences.zh: 是日皇城諸門皆閉，慰諭之方止。

translations.literal: That day all gates of the imperial city were closed; only after reassurance did they cease.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial city gates were shut that day until the court soothed them and the violence ended.

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅，以兵部侍郎李涵為蘇州剌史、兼御史中丞，充浙西觀察使。

translations.literal: Second month, jiayin: Vice Minister of War Li Han was made Suzhou prefect, concurrent acting censor-in-chief, and Zhexi observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Li Han became Suzhou prefect and Zhexi commissioner with an acting censorate post.

sentences.zh: 鎮星臨太微。

translations.literal: The Chronogram star stood at the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn stood in the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 戊午夜，月掩天關。

translations.literal: Night of wuzi, the moon occulted the Celestial Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of wuzi the moon occulted the Celestial Gate.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰，詔諫議大夫置四員為定。

translations.literal: Third month, renchen: remonstrating and advising grand masters were fixed at four posts.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the remonstrating and advising grand masters were fixed at four posts.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲寅，回紇王子李秉義卒，歸國宿衛賜名也。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jiayin: Uyghur prince Li Bingyi died; he had been granted the name on returning to guard the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Uyghur prince Li Bingyi died; he had taken the imperial surname while serving as a hostage guard.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉，雨雹，大風折樹。

translations.literal: Fifth month, yiyou: hail fell and great wind broke trees.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou hail fell and a gale snapped trees.

sentences.zh: 丙戌夜，月入太微。

translations.literal: Night of bingxu, the moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of bingxu the moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，徙忻州之七聖容於太原府之紫極宮。

translations.literal: On xinmao, the Seven Sages image of Xinzhou was moved to the Purple Ultimate Palace in Taiyuan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Xinzhou's Seven Sages shrine was moved to Taiyuan's Purple Ultimate Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔：

translations.literal: On yimi, edict:
translations.idiomatic: On yimi an edict ran:

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以檢校禮部尚書蔣渙充東都留守。

translations.literal: On guihai, acting minister of rites Jiang Huan was made eastern capital guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Jiang Huan became eastern capital guardian.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，有司言日蝕，陰雲不見。

translations.literal: Sixth month, gengxu: the offices reported a solar eclipse, but clouds hid it.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu officials reported an eclipse, but clouds concealed it.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔誡薄葬，不得造假花果及金手脫寶鈿等物。

translations.literal: On dingchou, an edict warned against lavish burial—no false flowers, fruit, gold hand-strips, jeweled hairpins, or the like.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou an edict forbade lavish funerals: no false flowers, gold hand-strips, jeweled pins, or similar display.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸巳，回紇蕃客奪長安縣令邵說所乘馬，人吏不能禁。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, guisi: Uyghur and foreign guests seized the horse of Chang'an magistrate Shao Shuo; clerks and runners could not restrain them.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Uyghur guests seized Chang'an magistrate Shao Shuo's horse and clerks could not stop them.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，賜北庭都護曹令忠姓名曰李元忠。

translations.literal: Eighth month, gengxu: Northern Court protector Cao Lingzhong was granted the surname Li and the name Yuanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Northern Court protector Cao Lingzhong received the surname Li and the name Yuanzhong.

sentences.zh: 九月乙未，工部尚書於休烈卒。

translations.literal: Ninth month, yimi: Minister of Works Yu Xiulie died.
translations.idiomatic: On yimi, Minister of Works Yu Xiulie died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬子，上畋於苑中，矢一發貫二兔，從臣皆賀。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, renzi: the emperor hunted in the park; one arrow pierced two hares; attendants all congratulated.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he hunted in the park and with one arrow struck two hares; the court congratulated him.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以權知幽州盧龍節度留後朱泚檢校左散騎常侍，充幽州盧龍節度使。

translations.literal: On xinwei, acting Youzhou-Lulong commissioner Zhu Ci was made acting left regular cavalry attendant and Youzhou-Lulong military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Zhu Ci became acting left regular cavalry attendant and Youzhou-Lulong commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以太府卿呂崇賁為廣州都督，充嶺南節度使。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Grand Steward Lü Chongben was made Guangzhou metropolitan protector and Lingnan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Lü Chongben became Guangzhou protector and Lingnan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚辰，詔：自頃蕃戎入寇，巴南屢多征役。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, gengchen, edict: "Of late when barbarians raid, Ba south has borne repeated levies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen of the eleventh month an edict declared: "Barbarian raids have lately piled levies on Ba south.

sentences.zh: 其巴、蓬、渠、集、壁、充、通、開等州，宜放二年租庸。

translations.literal: Ba, Peng, Qu, Ji, Bi, Chong, Tong, and Kai prefectures shall have two years' tax and corvée remitted."
translations.idiomatic: Ba, Peng, Qu, Ji, Bi, Chong, Tong, and Kai shall be exempt from tax and corvée for two years."

sentences.zh: 甲申，以福建觀察使李承昭為禮部尚書，華州刺史李琦為福州刺史、福建都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Fujian observation commissioner Li Chengzhao was made minister of rites; Huazhou prefect Li Qi was made Fuzhou prefect and Fujian all-circuits training and observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Li Chengzhao became minister of rites and Li Qi took Fuzhou and the Fujian command.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以嶺南節度李勉為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Lingnan commissioner Li Mian was made minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Li Mian of Lingnan became minister of works.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙寅，雨士。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, bingyin: soil rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin of the twelfth month, soil fell like rain.

sentences.zh: 是夜，長星出於參。

translations.literal: That night a long comet appeared at Shen.
translations.idiomatic: That night a long-tailed comet rose at Shen.

sentences.zh: 辛未，滑州置永平軍。

translations.literal: On xinwei, the Yongping army was established at Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the Yongping army was posted at Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 壬子，禁鑄銅器。

translations.literal: On renzi, casting copper vessels was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the court banned private casting of copper ware.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，大雪。

translations.literal: On guiyou, heavy snow.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou heavy snow fell.

sentences.zh: 是秋稔。

translations.literal: That autumn the harvest ripened.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn brought a full harvest.

sentences.zh: 回紇、吐蕃、大食、渤海、室韋、靺鞨、契丹、奚、牂柯、康國、石國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Uyghurs, Tibet, the Abbasids, Bohai, Shiwei, Mohe, Khitan, Xi, Zangke, Kang, and Shishi all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Uyghurs, Tibetans, Abbasids, Bohai, Shiwei, Mohe, Khitan, Xi, Zangke, Kang, and Shishi all presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 大歷八年八年春正月丁丑朔，壬午，昭義軍節度、檢校右僕射、相州刺史薛嵩卒。

translations.literal: Dali 8, spring, first month, dingchou new moon; on renwu, Zhaoyi military commissioner, acting right vice director, and Xiangzhou prefect Xue Song died.
translations.idiomatic: Dali 8 opened on dingchou; on renwu Xue Song of Zhaoyi, acting right vice director, died.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，敕天下青苗地頭錢每畝十五文，率京畿三十文，自今一例十五文。

translations.literal: On guimao, an edict fixed the green-sprout field-head money at fifteen cash per mu, thirty in the capital circuits—henceforth fifteen everywhere.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the green-sprout levy was fixed at fifteen cash per mu, ending the capital's thirty-cash rate.

sentences.zh: 京官三品已上郎官御史，每年各舉一人堪為刺史縣令者。

translations.literal: Capital officials of third rank and above, bureau directors, and censors each year were to recommend one man fit for prefect or magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Each year capital officials of third rank up, directors, and censors had to nominate one worthy prefect or magistrate.

sentences.zh: 二月甲子，御史大夫李棲筠彈吏部侍郎徐浩。

translations.literal: Second month, jiazi: censor-in-chief Li Qiyun impeached Vice Minister of Personnel Xu Hao.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Li Qiyun impeached Xu Hao of the ministry of personnel.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，幽州節度使朱泚加檢校戶部尚書，封懷寧郡王。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Youzhou commissioner Zhu Ci was made acting minister of revenue and enfeoffed Prince of Huaining commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Zhu Ci of Youzhou became acting minister of revenue and Prince of Huaining.

sentences.zh: 徐浩、薛邕違格，並停知選事。

translations.literal: Xu Hao and Xue Yong violated regulations; both were suspended from selection duties.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Hao and Xue Yong broke the rules and lost control of appointments.

sentences.zh: 壬申，永平軍節度使、檢校右僕射、滑州刺史、霍國公令狐彰卒，遣表薦劉晏、李勉代己。

translations.literal: On renshen, Yongping commissioner, acting right vice director, Huazhou prefect, and Duke of Huo Linghu Zhang died, leaving a memorial recommending Liu Yan and Li Mian to succeed him.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Linghu Zhang of Yongping died, recommending Liu Yan and Li Mian as his successors.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子，以工部尚書李勉兼御史大夫、滑州刺史，充永平軍節度、滑亳觀察等使。

translations.literal: Third month, bingzi: Minister of Works Li Mian was made concurrent censor-in-chief and Huazhou prefect, Yongping commissioner and Bo-Mei observer.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Li Mian became censor-in-chief, Huazhou prefect, and Yongping commissioner.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申，乾陵上仙觀天尊殿有雙鵲銜紫泥補殿之隙缺，凡十五處。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, wushen: at Qianling's Shangxian Abbey Heavenly Lord hall two magpies carried purple mud and filled fifteen gaps in the hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, at Qianling two magpies patched fifteen gaps in the Heavenly Lord hall with purple mud.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以太僕卿吳仲孺為鄂州刺史、鄂岳沔等州團練觀察使。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Grand Steward Wu Zhongru was made Ezhou prefect and E-Yue-Mian training and observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Wu Zhongru became Ezhou prefect and commissioner over E, Yue, and Mian.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉，貶吏部侍郎徐浩明州別駕，薛邕歙州刺史，京兆尹杜濟杭州刺史，皆坐典選也。

translations.literal: Fifth month, yiyou: Vice Minister of Personnel Xu Hao was demoted to Mingzhou assistant prefect; Xue Yong to Shezhou prefect; capital metropolitan prefect Du Ji to Hangzhou prefect—all for controlling selection.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Xu Hao, Xue Yong, and Du Ji were banished from the capital for rigging appointments.

sentences.zh: 以太府卿於頎為京兆尹。

translations.literal: Grand Steward Yu Yi was made metropolitan prefect of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yi became capital metropolitan prefect.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，鄭王邈薨，贈昭靜太子。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Prince of Zheng Miao died; posthumously titled Tranquil Zhao crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Prince of Zheng Miao died and was posthumously named Tranquil Zhao crown prince.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，曲赦京城系囚。

translations.literal: On renchen, a partial amnesty freed capital prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the capital prisoners received a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔赦天下系囚，死罪降從流，流已下並放。

translations.literal: On guimao, an edict amnestied prisoners empire-wide: death reduced to exile, exile and below all released.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao a general amnesty cut death sentences to exile and freed lesser offenders.

sentences.zh: 六月，隴州華亭縣置義寧軍。

translations.literal: Sixth month: the Yining army was established at Huating in Longzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the Yining army was posted at Huating in Long.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，戶部侍郎、判度支韓滉奏安邑鹽池生乳鹽。

translations.literal: On guihai, Vice Minister of Revenue and fiscal commissioner Han Huang reported curdled salt forming in the Anyi salt ponds.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Han Huang reported curdled salt forming in the Anyi ponds.

sentences.zh: 是夏，城奉天以備蕃寇。

translations.literal: That summer walls were built at Fengtian against barbarian raids.
translations.idiomatic: That summer Fengtian was walled against barbarian attack.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己卯，太白入東井。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jimao: Venus entered the Well.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao of the seventh month Venus entered the Well.

sentences.zh: 乙未，月掩畢。

translations.literal: On yimi, the moon occulted the Net.
translations.idiomatic: On yimi the moon passed before the Net.

sentences.zh: 八月甲寅，詔吏部尚書劉晏知三銓選事。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jiayin: an edict put Minister of Personnel Liu Yan in charge of all three selection bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Liu Yan was given all three appointment bureaus.

sentences.zh: 己未，吐蕃寇靈武。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Tibet raided Lingwu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Tibetans raided Lingwu.

sentences.zh: 庚午，靈武奏蕃軍退去。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Lingwu reported the barbarian army had withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Lingwu reported the Tibetans had withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 辛未，幽州節度使朱泚弟滔率五千騎來朝，請河西防秋。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Youzhou commissioner Zhu Ci's younger brother Tao led five thousand cavalry to court, requesting autumn defense on the Hexi frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Zhu Tao of Youzhou brought five thousand horsemen to court seeking a Hexi autumn command.

sentences.zh: 詔千騎迓於國門，許自皇城南面出開遠門，赴涇州行營。

translations.literal: An edict sent a thousand horsemen to meet them at the state gate; they were allowed out Kaiyuan Gate south of the imperial city to the Jingzhou camp.
translations.idiomatic: A thousand horsemen met them at the gate; they marched out Kaiyuan Gate to the Jingzhou camp.

sentences.zh: 九月癸酉，臨晉公主薨。

translations.literal: Ninth month, guiyou: Princess of Linjin died.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the Princess of Linjin died.

sentences.zh: 壬午，嶺南節度使、廣州刺史呂崇賁為部將哥舒晃所殺。

translations.literal: On renwu, Lingnan commissioner and Guangzhou prefect Lü Chongben was killed by his officer Geshu Huang.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Lü Chongben of Lingnan was murdered by his officer Geshu Huang.

sentences.zh: 癸未，晉州男子郇謨以麻辮發，持竹筐及葦席，哭於東市，請進三十字，如不稱旨，請裹尸於席筐。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Jinzhou commoner Xun Mo, hair braided with hemp, held a bamboo basket and reed mat and wept at the eastern market, offering thirty characters and asking that if they displeased, his corpse be wrapped in the mat and basket.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Xun Mo of Jinzhou wove his hair with hemp, wept at the eastern market with a basket and mat, and offered thirty characters—begging to die in the mat if they failed.

sentences.zh: 上召見，賜衣館之禁中。

translations.literal: The emperor summoned and clothed him and lodged him in the palace.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor received him, gave clothes, and housed him in the palace.

sentences.zh: 內二字曰「監團」，欲去諸道監軍、團練使也。

translations.literal: Two characters read "supervise regiments," intending to abolish circuit army supervisors and training commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Two characters meant "abolish supervisors and training commissioners" on every circuit.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，貶左巡使、殿中侍御史楊護，以其抑郇謨而不上聞也，戊子，詔京官五品以上各上封事，議政得失。

translations.literal: On dinghai, left patrol commissioner and palace censor Yang Hu was demoted for suppressing Xun Mo and not reporting upward; on wuzi, an edict ordered capital officials of fifth rank and above each to submit sealed memorials on policy gains and losses.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Yang Hu was punished for silencing Xun Mo; on wuzi every capital official of fifth rank or higher had to submit a sealed critique.

sentences.zh: 己丑夜，太白入太微。

translations.literal: Night of jichou, Venus entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of jichou Venus entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 甲午，東都留守蔣瓊兼知東都貢舉。

translations.literal: On jiawu, eastern capital guardian Jiang Qiong was also put in charge of the eastern capital examination.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Jiang Qiong of Luoyang also supervised the eastern capital examinations.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以辰、錦觀察使李昌巙為桂州刺史、桂管防禦觀察使。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Chen and Jin observation commissioner Li Changqi was made Guilin prefect and Guiguan defense and observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Li Changqi became Guilin prefect and Guiguan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 大鳥見武功，肉翅狐首，四足有爪，爪長四尺三寸，毛赤如蝙蝠，群鳥隨而噪之。

translations.literal: A great bird appeared at Wugong with fleshy wings and fox head, four feet with claws four chi three cun long, red fur like a bat; flocks of birds followed shrieking.
translations.idiomatic: At Wugong a monstrous bird appeared—fox-headed, winged, four clawed feet, bat-red—and lesser birds screamed after it.

sentences.zh: 神策將張日芬射斃以獻。

translations.literal: Shence general Zhang Rifen shot it dead and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Rifen of the Shence guard shot it and presented the carcass.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸卯，魏博田承嗣加同平章事。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, guimao: Weibo's Tian Chengsi was made fellow grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Tian Chengsi of Weibo became fellow grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 丁巳夜，月掩畢。

translations.literal: Night of dingsi, the moon occulted the Net.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of dingsi the moon occulted the Net.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃寇涇州、邠州。

translations.literal: Tibet raided Jing and Bing.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetans raided Jing and Bing.

sentences.zh: 甲子，子儀先鋒將琿瑊與吐蕃戰於宜錄，我師不利。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Ziyi's vanguard Huai Mei fought Tibet at Yilu; our army was unfavorable.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Guo Ziyi's vanguard Huai Mei fought Tibet at Yilu and was beaten.

sentences.zh: 瑊與涇原馬璘極力追躡，蕃軍潰去。

translations.literal: Mei and Jingyuan's Ma Lin pursued with all force; the barbarian army broke and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Huai Mei and Ma Lin of Jingyuan pursued hard until the Tibetans broke and fled.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以江西觀察使路嗣恭為廣州刺史，充嶺南節度使，封翼國公。

translations.literal: On yichou, Jiangxi observation commissioner Lu Sigong was made Guangzhou prefect and Lingnan military commissioner, enfeoffed Duke of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Lu Sigong became Guangzhou prefect, Lingnan commissioner, and Duke of Yi.

sentences.zh: 以浙東觀察使、越州刺史陳少游為揚州大都督府長史，充淮南節度使。

translations.literal: Zhedong observation commissioner and Yuezhou prefect Chen Shaoyou was made chief administrator of Yangzhou grand protectorate and Huainan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Shaoyou of Zhedong became Yangzhou chief administrator and Huainan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，郭子儀奏破吐蕃十萬，百僚稱賀。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Guo Ziyi memorialized crushing one hundred thousand Tibet; the hundred officials congratulated.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Guo Ziyi reported defeating one hundred thousand Tibetans and the court rejoiced.

sentences.zh: 己卯夜，月入羽林。

translations.literal: Night of jimao, the moon entered the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of jimao the moon entered the Feathered Forest.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，月入太微。

translations.literal: On guisi, the moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅朔。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, renyin new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The eleventh month opened on renyin.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，汴宋節度使田神功來朝。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Bian-Song military commissioner Tian Shenggong came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Tian Shenggong of Bian-Song came to audience.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，淮西節度使李忠臣來朝。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Huai-xi military commissioner Li Zhongchen came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Li Zhongchen of Huai-xi came to audience.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸酉，月入羽林。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, guiyou, the moon entered the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou of the twelfth month the moon entered the Feathered Forest.

sentences.zh: 是冬，無雪。

translations.literal: That winter there was no snow.
translations.idiomatic: That winter brought no snow.

sentences.zh: 是歲，大有年。

translations.literal: That year was a great harvest.
translations.idiomatic: That year the harvest was abundant.

sentences.zh: 大歷九年九年正月庚子朔。

translations.literal: Dali 9, first month, gengzi new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Dali 9 opened on the gengzi new moon of the first month.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，汴宋節度使、太子少師、檢校尚書右僕射、兼御史大夫、汴州刺史田神功卒。

translations.literal: On renyin, Bian-Song commissioner, grand tutor of the heir, acting right vice director, concurrent censor-in-chief, and Bianzhou prefect Tian Shenggong died.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Tian Shenggong of Bian-Song, grand tutor and acting right vice director, died.

sentences.zh: 灃朗兩州鎮遏使、灃州刺史楊猷擅浮江而下，至鄂州。

translations.literal: Feng and Lang barrier commissioner and Feng prefect Yang You sailed downriver without authority as far as Ezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yang You of Feng and Lang sailed down the river without orders as far as Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 詔許赴汝州，遂溯漢而上，復、郢、襄等州皆閉城拒之。

translations.literal: An edict allowed him to go to Ruzhou; he went up the Han, and Fu, Ying, Xiang, and other prefectures all shut their walls against him.
translations.idiomatic: The court let him proceed to Ruzhou, but as he went up the Han, Fu, Ying, Xiang, and others closed their gates.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，以田神功弟神玉權知汴宋留後。

translations.literal: Second month, jichou: Tian Shenggong's younger brother Shenyu was made acting Bian-Song commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Shenyu was made acting Bian-Song commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，郭子儀自邠州來朝，李抱玉自鳳翔來朝。

translations.literal: On guisi, Guo Ziyi came from Bing; Li Baoyu came from Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Guo Ziyi arrived from Bing and Li Baoyu from Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 三月丙午，禁畿內漁獵採捕，自正月至五月晦，永為常式。

translations.literal: Third month, bingwu: fishing and hunting within the capital bounds was forbidden from the first month through the last day of the fifth month, permanently.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, capital fishing and hunting were banned from the first through the fifth month, forever after.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以灃州刺史楊猷為洮州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Feng prefect Yang You was made Tao prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Yang You was transferred from Feng to Tao.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁丑，月入太微。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, dingchou, the moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou of the fourth month the moon entered the Supreme Palace.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以桂管觀察使黎幹為京兆尹、兼御史大夫。

translations.literal: On jimao, Guiguan observation commissioner Li Gan was made capital metropolitan prefect and concurrent censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Li Gan became capital metropolitan prefect with the censorate.

sentences.zh: 甲申，中書舍人常袞率兩省官一十八人詣閣請論事，詔三人各盡所懷。

translations.literal: On jiashen, drafting secretary Chang Gai led eighteen officials of the two departments to the gate to petition discussion; an edict allowed three to speak their minds fully.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Chang Gai and eighteen officials petitioned at the gate; three were allowed to speak freely.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔郭子儀等大閱兵師以備吐蕃。

translations.literal: On yiyou, an edict ordered Guo Ziyi and others to review troops against Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the court ordered Guo Ziyi and others to muster armies against Tibet.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔赦大闢以下系囚，無輕重釋放。

translations.literal: On renchen, an edict amnestied prisoners down to great treason without regard to severity—all were released.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen a sweeping amnesty freed even those guilty of great treason.

sentences.zh: 乙未，華陽公主薨，上悲惜之，累日不聽朝，宰臣抗疏陳請。

translations.literal: On yimi, Princess Huayang died; the emperor grieved and for days did not hold court; chief ministers remonstrated in memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On yimi, Princess Huayang died; the emperor mourned for days without court until ministers protested.

sentences.zh: 五月庚戌，廢泜州。

translations.literal: Fifth month, gengxu: Si prefecture was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu of the fifth month, Si prefecture was abolished.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔度支使支七十萬貫、轉運使五十萬貫和糴，歲豐穀賤也。

translations.literal: On gengshen, an edict ordered the fiscal commissioner to disburse seven hundred thousand strings and the transport commissioner five hundred thousand for government purchase of grain—the year was abundant and grain cheap.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the court spent 1.2 million strings buying grain in a year of plenty.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔：

translations.literal: On yichou, edict:
translations.idiomatic: On yichou an edict declared:

sentences.zh: 涇原節度使馬璘來朝。

translations.literal: Jingyuan military commissioner Ma Lin came to court.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Lin of Jingyuan came to audience.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，加馬璘尚書左僕射、知省事。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Ma Lin was made left vice director and director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Ma Lin became left vice director and head of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 璘諷將士進狀求宰相，故有是授。

translations.literal: Lin prompted his officers to submit petitions seeking the chancellorship—hence this appointment.
translations.idiomatic: His soldiers petitioned for him to become chancellor, which explains the promotion.

sentences.zh: 幽州節度使朱泚遣弟滔奉表請自入朝，兼自率五千騎防秋。

translations.literal: Youzhou commissioner Zhu Ci sent his younger brother Tao with a memorial asking to enter court in person and also to lead five thousand cavalry for autumn defense.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Ci sent Zhu Tao to ask leave to come to court in person with five thousand horsemen for autumn defense.

sentences.zh: 許之，詔所司築第待之。

translations.literal: Approved; an edict ordered offices to build a residence awaiting him.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed and ordered a mansion prepared for him.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，月掩南斗。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jimao: the moon occulted the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao of the sixth month the moon occulted the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，月入太微。

translations.literal: On gengchen, the moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，月掩房，又入羽林。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jiachen: the moon occulted Fang and also entered the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the moon occulted Fang and entered the Feathered Forest.

sentences.zh: 久旱，京兆尹黎幹歷禱諸祠，未雨。

translations.literal: Long drought; capital metropolitan prefect Li Gan prayed at many shrines without rain.
translations.idiomatic: After a long drought, Li Gan prayed at many shrines without result.

sentences.zh: 又請禱文宣廟，上曰「丘之禱久矣。

translations.literal: He also asked to pray at the temple of Confucius; the emperor said, "Confucius prayed long ago.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to pray at Confucius' temple; the emperor said, "Confucius prayed long ago.
Let him pray there himself."

sentences.zh: 八月辛未，以虢州刺史宋晦為同州刺史，充長春宮營田等使。

translations.literal: Eighth month, xinwei: Guo prefect Song Hui was made Tong prefect and commissioner of Changchun Palace estates.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Song Hui of Guo became Tong prefect and Changchun Palace estate commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以陜州大都督府長史皇甫溫為越州剌史，充浙東觀察使。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Shaan grand protectorate chief administrator Huangfu Wen was made Yuezhou prefect and Zhedong observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Huangfu Wen became Yue prefect and Zhedong commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，月掩軒轅。

translations.literal: On xinmao, the moon occulted the Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the moon occulted the Chariot.

sentences.zh: 九月庚子，幽州節度使朱泚來朝。

translations.literal: Ninth month, gengzi: Youzhou commissioner Zhu Ci came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Zhu Ci of Youzhou came to audience.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，渭北節度使、坊州刺史臧希讓卒。

translations.literal: On yisi, Weibei commissioner and Fang prefect Zang Xirang died.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Zang Xirang of Weibei and Fang died.

sentences.zh: 是秋大雨。

translations.literal: That autumn there was heavy rain.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn brought heavy rains.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬申，信王瑝薨。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, renshen: Prince of Faith Wang Huang died.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Prince of Faith Wang Huang died.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，梁王璿薨。

translations.literal: On yihai, Prince of Liang Wang Xuan died.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Prince of Liang Wang Xuan, Prince of Liang, died.

sentences.zh: 以前宣州刺史季廣琛為右散騎常侍。

translations.literal: Former Xu prefect Ji Guangchen was made right regular cavalry attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Guangchen, former Xu prefect, became right regular cavalry attendant.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌，大雪。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, wuxu: heavy snow.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu of the eleventh month heavy snow fell.

sentences.zh: 平地盈尺。

translations.literal: On level ground a full foot.
translations.idiomatic: A foot piled on level ground.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以商州刺史李國清為陜州大都督府長史，充陜州觀察使。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Shangzhou prefect Li Guoqing was made Shaan grand protectorate chief administrator and Shaan observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Li Guoqing became Shaan chief administrator and observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅，以中書舍人楊炎、秘書少監韋肇並為吏部侍郎，中書舍人常袞為禮部待郎。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, gengyin: drafting secretaries Yang Yan and Wei Zhao were made vice ministers of personnel; Chang Gai was made vice minister of rites.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Yang Yan and Wei Zhao became vice ministers of personnel and Chang Gai vice minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，赦京系囚，死罪降從流，流已下並釋放。

translations.literal: On renchen, capital prisoners were amnestied: death reduced to exile, exile and below released.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the capital amnesty cut death to exile and freed lesser sentences.

sentences.zh: 大歷十年十年春正月乙未朔。

translations.literal: Dali 10, spring, first month, yimi new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Dali 10 opened on the yimi new moon of the first spring month.

sentences.zh: 己酉，昭義牙將裴志清逐其帥薛摐，薛摐奔洺州，上章待罪。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Zhaoyi guard officer Pei Zhiqing expelled his commander Xue Zong; Zong fled to Mozhou and submitted a memorial awaiting punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Pei Zhiqing of Zhaoyi drove out Xue Zong, who fled to Mo and begged punishment.

sentences.zh: 志清率眾歸田承嗣。

translations.literal: Zhiqing led the troops to Tian Chengsi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhiqing took the army to Tian Chengsi.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，壽王瑁薨。

translations.literal: On renyin, Prince of Longevity Wang Mei died.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Prince of Longevity Wang Mei passed away.

sentences.zh: 乙未，朱泚抗表乞留京師，西征吐蕃，請以弟滔權為幽州留後，許之。

translations.literal: On yimi, Zhu Ci submitted a memorial begging to remain in the capital and campaign west against Tibet, asking his younger brother Tao to act as Youzhou commissioner; approved.
translations.idiomatic: On yimi, Zhu Ci asked to stay in the capital against Tibet and leave Tao as acting Youzhou commissioner; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 以昭義將薛擇為相州刺史，薛雄為衛州刺史，薛堅為洺州刺史，皆嵩之族人也。

translations.literal: Zhaoyi officers Xue Ze, Xiong, and Jian were made prefects of Xiang, Wei, and Mo—all clansmen of Song.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Ze, Xiong, and Jian of Zhaoyi kin were made prefects of Xiang, Wei, and Mo.

sentences.zh: 戊申，遣使慰諭田承嗣，令各守封疆，承嗣不奉詔。

translations.literal: On wushen, envoys were sent to reassure Tian Chengsi to keep to his borders; Chengsi did not obey the edict.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen envoys urged Tian Chengsi to keep the peace; he refused.

sentences.zh: 壬子，充州復為果州。

translations.literal: On renzi, Chong prefecture reverted to Guo.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Chongzhou became Guo again.

sentences.zh: 癸丑。

translations.literal: On guichou.
translations.idiomatic: The same day, on guichou,

sentences.zh: 田承嗣盜取洺州，又破衛州。

translations.literal: Tian Chengsi seized Mozhou and also broke Wei prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Chengsi stole Mozhou and overran Wei.

sentences.zh: 二月乙丑，盜殺衛州刺史薛雄。

translations.literal: Second month, yichou: rebels murdered Wei prefect Xue Xiong.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, rebels killed Wei prefect Xue Xiong.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，罷辰、錦、溪、獎、漵五州經略使，復隸黔中。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the Chen, Jin, Xi, Jiang, and Xi commissioners were abolished and again subordinated to Qianzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, five southwestern commissioners were abolished and returned to Qianzhong.

sentences.zh: 辛未，制第四子述封睦王，充嶺南節度度支營田、王府經略觀察處置等大使。

translations.literal: On xinwei, by decree the fourth son Shu was enfeoffed Prince of Mu and made Lingnan commissioner for revenue, estates, princely mansion, defense, observation, and disposition.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the fourth son Shu was made Prince of Mu and Lingnan commissioner with full powers.

sentences.zh: 第五子逾可封郴王，充渭北鄜坊等州節度大使。

translations.literal: The fifth son Yu was to be enfeoffed Prince of Chen and made Weibei-Bin-Fang commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth son Yu was named Prince of Chen and Weibei-Bin-Fang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 第六子連封恩王。

translations.literal: The sixth son Lian was enfeoffed Prince of En.
translations.idiomatic: The sixth son Lian was made Prince of En.

sentences.zh: 第七子韓王迥可充汴宋節度大使。

translations.literal: The seventh son, Prince of Han Wang Hui, was to be made Bian-Song commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The seventh son Hui was named Prince of Han and Bian-Song commissioner.

sentences.zh: 第八子遘可封鄜王。

translations.literal: The eighth son Sui was to be enfeoffed Prince of Bin.
translations.idiomatic: The eighth son Sui was to become Prince of Bin.

sentences.zh: 第十三子造封忻王，充昭義節度大使。

translations.literal: The thirteenth son Zao was enfeoffed Prince of Xin and made Zhaoyi military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The thirteenth son Zao became Prince of Xin and Zhaoyi commissioner.

sentences.zh: 第十四子暹封韶王。

translations.literal: The fourteenth son Xian was enfeoffed Prince of Shao.
translations.idiomatic: The fourteenth son Xian was made Prince of Shao.

sentences.zh: 十五子運封嘉王。

translations.literal: The fifteenth son Yun was enfeoffed Prince of Jia.
translations.idiomatic: The fifteenth son Yun was made Prince of Jia.

sentences.zh: 十六子遇封端王。

translations.literal: The sixteenth son Yu was enfeoffed Prince of Duan.
translations.idiomatic: The sixteenth son Yu was made Prince of Duan.

sentences.zh: 十七子遹封循王。

translations.literal: The seventeenth son Yu was enfeoffed Prince of Xun.
translations.idiomatic: The seventeenth son Yu was made Prince of Xun.

sentences.zh: 十八子通封恭王。

translations.literal: The eighteenth son Tong was enfeoffed Prince of Gong.
translations.idiomatic: The eighteenth son Tong was made Prince of Gong.

sentences.zh: 十九子達封原王。

translations.literal: The nineteenth son Da was enfeoffed Prince of Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: The nineteenth son Da was made Prince of Yuan.

sentences.zh: 二十子逸封雅王。

translations.literal: The twentieth son Yi was enfeoffed Prince of Ya.
translations.idiomatic: The twentieth son Yi was made Prince of Ya.

sentences.zh: 並可開府儀同三司，不出閣。

translations.literal: All could hold ceremonial rank equal to the Three Excellencies without leaving the palace.
translations.idiomatic: All received ceremonial rank equal to chief ministers but did not leave the palace.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以華州刺史李承昭為相州刺史。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Huazhou prefect Li Chengzhao was made Xiangzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Li Chengzhao became Xiangzhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 知昭義兵馬留後。

translations.literal: Acting Zhaoyi military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He also acted as Zhaoyi military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 時田承嗣盡盜入相、衛所管四州之地，自署長吏。

translations.literal: At the time Tian Chengsi had seized all four prefectures under Xiang and Wei and appointed his own magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Chengsi had already seized Xiang and Wei's four prefectures and installed his own officials.

sentences.zh: 是日河陽軍亂，逐城使常休明，迫牙將王惟恭為留後，軍士大掠數日，休明奔東都。

translations.literal: That day the Heyang army mutinied, expelled garrison commissioner Chang Xiuming, and forced guard officer Wang Weigong as commissioner; soldiers plundered for days; Xiuming fled to the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: That day Heyang mutinied, drove out Chang Xiuming, made Wang Weigong commissioner, and looted for days before Xiuming fled to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以平盧淄青節度觀察海運押新羅渤海兩蕃等使、檢校工部尚書、青州刺史李正己檢校尚書左僕射；

translations.literal: On jiashen, Pinglu-Ziqing commissioner, sea-transport commissioner for Silla and Bohai, acting minister of works, and Qing prefect Li Zhengji was made acting left vice director;
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Li Zhengji of Pinglu became acting left vice director;

sentences.zh: 前隴右節度副使、隴州刺史馬燧為商州刺史，充本州防禦使。

translations.literal: former Longyou deputy commissioner and Long prefect Ma Sui was made Shangzhou prefect and defense commissioner of that prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Sui of Longyou became Shangzhou prefect and its defense commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三月甲午，陜州軍亂，逐觀察使李國清，縱兵大掠。

translations.literal: Third month, jiawu: the Shaan army mutinied, expelled observation commissioner Li Guoqing, and plundered freely.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Shaan troops expelled Li Guoqing and looted the city.

sentences.zh: 國清卑詞遍拜將士，方免禍，一夕而定。

translations.literal: Guoqing with humble words bowed to all officers and barely escaped harm; order returned in one night.
translations.idiomatic: Guoqing bowed to every officer and escaped; by nightfall order returned.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，薛崿、常休明至闕下，素服待罪。

translations.literal: On yisi, Xue E and Chang Xiuming reached the gate in white awaiting punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Xue E and Chang Xiuming came to court in white to await judgment.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以左散騎常侍孟皞為華州刺史，充潼關防禦使。

translations.literal: On dingwei, left regular cavalry attendant Meng Hao was made Huazhou prefect and Tong Pass defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Meng Hao became Huazhou prefect and Tong Pass defender.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，熒惑入壁壘。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Mars entered the Ramparts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Mars entered the Ramparts.

sentences.zh: 四月，太常寺奏：諸州府所用斗秤，當寺給銅斗秤，州府依樣製造而行，從之。

translations.literal: Fourth month: the ministry of ceremonies reported that dou and steelyard weights used in prefectures should be issued in bronze by the ministry for local manufacture—approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the ministry ordered bronze weights issued to prefectures as models—approved.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，制：魏博節度使、開府儀岵司、太尉、檢校尚書左僕射、同中書門下平章事、魏州大都督府長史、上柱國、雁門郡王田承嗣可貶永州刺史。

translations.literal: On yichou, decree: Weibo commissioner, ceremonial chief minister, grand master, acting left vice director, fellow grand councilor, Wei chief administrator, pillar of state, and Prince of Yanmen Tian Chengsi is demoted to Yongzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Tian Chengsi of Weibo was demoted to Yongzhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 仍詔河東、鎮冀、幽州、淄青、淮西、滑毫、汴宋、澤潞、河陽道出師進討。

translations.literal: Edicts also ordered Hedong, Zhen-Ji, Youzhou, Ziqing, Huai-xi, Hua-Mei, Bian-Song, Ze-Lu, and Heyang circuits to march and attack.
translations.idiomatic: Nine circuits were ordered to march against him.

sentences.zh: 甲申，大雨雹，暴風拔樹，飄屋瓦，落鴟吻，人震死者十之二，京畿損稼者七縣。

translations.literal: On jiashen, great hail and violent wind broke trees, blew off roof tiles and ridge beasts; two in ten people were killed by thunder; seven capital counties lost crops.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen hail and a gale wrecked roofs and killed one in five in seven counties around the capital.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未，田承嗣部將霍榮國以磁州歸。

translations.literal: Fifth month, yimi: Tian Chengsi's officer Huo Rongguo surrendered Cizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yimi, Huo Rongguo surrendered Cizhou to the court.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，劍南置昌州。

translations.literal: On guimao, Chang prefecture was established in Jiannan.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Changzhou was created in Jiannan.

sentences.zh: 罷兩都貢舉，都集上都，停童子科。

translations.literal: Examinations at the two capitals were abolished; all were gathered at the upper capital; the child prodigy category was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Both capitals' examinations were ended; all candidates went to Chang'an; the child prodigy category was dropped.

sentences.zh: 六月辛未，田承承嗣遣其黨裴志清攻圍冀州，為李寶臣所敗。

translations.literal: Sixth month, xinwei: Tian Chengsi sent his partisan Pei Zhiqing to besiege Jizhou and was defeated by Li Baochen.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Chengsi's agent Pei Zhiqing besieged Ji and was routed by Li Baochen.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jiwei.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei of the seventh month,

sentences.zh: 戶部尚書暢璀卒。

translations.literal: Minister of Revenue Chang Cui died.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Cui, minister of revenue, died.

sentences.zh: 杭州大風，海水翻潮，溺州民五千家，船千艘。

translations.literal: At Hangzhou a great wind turned the sea; tidal surge drowned five thousand households and a thousand boats.
translations.idiomatic: A Hangzhou gale drove the tide inland, drowning five thousand homes and a thousand boats.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，田承嗣上表請束身歸朝。

translations.literal: Eighth month, dingmao: Tian Chengsi submitted a memorial asking to submit and return to court.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Tian Chengsi asked to surrender and return to allegiance.

sentences.zh: 戊子夜，月入太微。

translations.literal: Night of wuzi, the moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of wuzi the moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 己丑，田承嗣將盧子期攻磁州。

translations.literal: On jichou, Tian Chengsi's officer Lu Ziqi attacked Cizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Lu Ziqi of Chengsi's army attacked Cizhou.

sentences.zh: 九月戊戌，荊南節度使衛伯玉來朝。

translations.literal: Ninth month, wuxu: Jingnan military commissioner Wei Boyu came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Wei Boyu of Jingnan came to audience.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，宥京城系囚。

translations.literal: On renyin, capital prisoners were amnestied.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the capital prisoners were amnestied.

sentences.zh: 戊申，回紇白晝殺人於市，吏捕之，拘於萬年獄。

translations.literal: On wushen, Uyghurs killed a man in broad daylight in the market; officers seized him and held him in Wannian jail.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Uyghurs killed a man in the market by day; officers jailed the killer in Wannian.

sentences.zh: 其首領赤心持兵入縣，劫囚而出，斫傷獄吏。

translations.literal: Their chief Chixin entered the county with weapons, seized the prisoner, and wounded jail clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Chixin armed his men, stormed the jail, freed the killer, and cut down the clerks.

sentences.zh: 月暈，熒惑犯昴、五車、參、東井等星。

translations.literal: The moon wore a halo; Mars trespassed Mao, the Five Chariots, Shen, and the Well.
translations.idiomatic: The moon haloed while Mars crossed Mao, the Five Chariots, Shen, and the Well.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，吐蕃寇隴州，鳳翔李抱玉擊之。

translations.literal: On guichou, Tibet raided Longzhou; Fengxiang's Li Baoyu struck them.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Tibet raided Long and Li Baoyu of Fengxiang counterattacked.

sentences.zh: 戊午，幽州節度使朱泚鎮奉天。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Youzhou commissioner Zhu Ci garrisoned Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Zhu Ci of Youzhou took post at Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛酉日，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, xinyou day: the sun was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou of the tenth winter month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以商州刺史馬燧檢校左散騎常侍、河陽三城使。

translations.literal: On guihai, Shangzhou prefect Ma Sui was made acting left regular cavalry attendant and Heyang Three Cities commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Ma Sui became acting left regular cavalry attendant and Heyang Three Cities commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲子，昭義節度使李承昭與盧子期戰於磁州清水縣，大破之，生擒子期以獻。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Zhaoyi commissioner Li Chengzhao fought Lu Ziqi at Qingshui in Cizhou and crushed him, capturing Ziqi alive for presentation.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Li Chengzhao routed Lu Ziqi at Qingshui and sent him captive to court.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，貴妃獨孤氏薨，追贈曰貞懿皇后。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Noble Consort Dugu died; posthumously titled Empress Zhenyi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Noble Consort Dugu died and was posthumously named Empress Zhenyi.

sentences.zh: 己丑，尚書右僕射裴遵慶卒。

translations.literal: On jichou, right vice director Pei Zunqing died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Pei Zunqing, right vice director, died.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛卯，新平公主薨。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, xinmao: Princess of Xinping died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the Princess of Xinping died.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，田承嗣所署瀛州刺史吳希光以城降。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Wu Xiguang, Chengsi's installed Ying prefect, surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Ying prefect Wu Xiguang, Chengsi's man, surrendered.

sentences.zh: 丁未，路嗣恭攻破廣州，擒哥舒晃，斬首以獻。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Lu Sigong broke Guangzhou, captured Geshu Huang, and presented his head.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Lu Sigong took Guangzhou, seized Geshu Huang, and sent his head to court.

sentences.zh: 大歷十一年十一年春正月庚寅朔，田承嗣上表請罪。

translations.literal: Dali 11, spring, first month, gengyin new moon: Tian Chengsi submitted a confession.
translations.idiomatic: Dali 11 opened on gengyin; Tian Chengsi submitted a confession of guilt.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遣諫議大夫杜亞使魏州宣慰，許其自新。

translations.literal: On renchen, remonstrating grand master Du Ya was sent to Weizhou to proclaim reassurance and allow his renewal.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Du Ya was sent to Weizhou to offer Chengsi a chance to repent.

sentences.zh: 辛亥。

translations.literal: On xinhai.
translations.idiomatic: That same day, on xinhai,

sentences.zh: 劍南節度使崔寧奏大破吐蕃二十萬，斬首萬級，生擒首領一千一百五十人，獻於闕下。

translations.literal: Jiannan commissioner Cui Ning memorialized crushing two hundred thousand Tibet, ten thousand heads cut, eleven hundred fifty leaders captured alive and presented at court.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Ning of Jiannan reported defeating two hundred thousand Tibetans, taking ten thousand heads and 1,150 leaders alive.

sentences.zh: 二月癸亥，荊南節度使衛伯玉卒於京師。

translations.literal: Second month, guihai: Jingnan commissioner Wei Boyu died in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Wei Boyu of Jingnan died at court.

sentences.zh: 戊子，河陽軍復亂，大掠三日，監軍使冉廷蘭率兵斬其亂首。

translations.literal: On wuzi, the Heyang army mutinied again and plundered for three days; army supervisor Ran Tinglan led troops and beheaded the ringleaders.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Heyang mutinied and looted three days until Ran Tinglan beheaded the leaders.

sentences.zh: 方定。

translations.literal: Order was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Order returned.

sentences.zh: 戊申，昌樂公主薨。

translations.literal: On wushen, Princess of Changle died.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the Princess of Changle died.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，御史大夫李棲筠卒。

translations.literal: On xinhai, censor-in-chief Li Qiyun died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Li Qiyun, censor-in-chief, died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊午朔。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, wuwu new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth summer month opened on wuwu.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以浙西觀察使、蘇州刺史、御史大夫李涵知臺事，充京畿觀察使。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Zhexi observation commissioner, Suzhou prefect, and censor-in-chief Li Han was put in charge of the censorate and made capital-circuits observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Li Han became censor-in-chief and capital-circuits observer.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以前淮南節度使、陽州大都督府長史、御史大夫張延賞為江陵尹、兼御史大夫充荊南節度使。

translations.literal: On jimao, former Huainan commissioner and Yangzhou chief administrator Zhang Yanshang was made Jiangling metropolitan prefect, concurrent censor-in-chief, and Jingnan commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Zhang Yanshang became Jiangling prefect and Jingnan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 五月癸巳，以永平軍節度使李勉為汴州刺史，充汴宋等八州節度觀察留後，時汴將李靈耀專殺濮州刺史孟鑒，北連田承嗣。

translations.literal: Fifth month, guisi: Yongping commissioner Li Mian was made Bian prefect and Bian-Song and seven other circuits' observation commissioner; at the time Bian officer Li Lingyao had murdered Pu prefect Meng Jian and allied north with Tian Chengsi—hence Mian was also given Bian.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Li Mian took Bian because Li Lingyao had killed Pu's prefect and joined Chengsi.

sentences.zh: 故命勉兼領汴州。

translations.literal: Lingyao was appointed Pu prefect but refused the edict.
translations.idiomatic: Lingyao was named Pu prefect and rejected the order.

sentences.zh: 授靈耀濮州刺史，靈耀不受詔。

translations.literal: Lingyao was made Pu prefect; Lingyao did not accept the edict.
translations.idiomatic: Though named Pu prefect, Lingyao would not obey.

sentences.zh: 六月戊戌，以李靈耀為汴州刺史，充節度留後。

translations.literal: Sixth month, wuxu: Li Lingyao was made Bian prefect and acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Li Lingyao was made acting Bian commissioner.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊子夜，暴澍雨，平地水深盈尺，溝渠漲溢，壞坊民千二百家。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, wuzi night: a cloudburst; water on level ground a full foot deep; ditches overflowed and ruined twelve hundred ward households.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of wuzi a cloudburst flooded the capital a foot deep and wrecked twelve hundred homes.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，田承嗣兵寇滑州，李勉拒戰而敗。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Tian Chengsi's troops raided Huazhou; Li Mian resisted and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Chengsi raided Hua and beat Li Mian.

sentences.zh: 八月丙寅，幽州節度使朱泚加同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Eighth month, bingyin: Youzhou commissioner Zhu Ci was made fellow grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Zhu Ci became fellow grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 李靈耀據汴叛。

translations.literal: Li Lingyao held Bian in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Li Lingyao rebelled at Bian.

sentences.zh: 甲申，命淮西李忠臣、滑州李勉、河陽馬燧三鎮兵討之。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Huai-xi Li Zhongchen, Hua Li Mian, and Heyang Ma Sui were ordered to march against him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Li Zhongchen, Li Mian, and Ma Sui were ordered to crush Lingyao.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁酉，太白經天。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, dingyou: Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on dingyou Venus crossed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 九月乙丑，李忠臣等兵進營鄭州，靈耀之眾來薄戰。

translations.literal: Ninth month, yichou: Li Zhongchen and others encamped at Zhengzhou; Lingyao's masses came to fight closely.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, loyal armies camped at Zhengzhou as Lingyao's troops pressed them.

sentences.zh: 淮西兵亂，乃退軍於滎澤。

translations.literal: The Huai-xi army mutinied and withdrew to Xingze.
translations.idiomatic: Huai-xi troops mutinied and fell back to Xingze.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，淄青李正己奏取鄆、濮二州。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Ziqing's Li Zhengji memorialized taking Yan and Pu prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Li Zhengji claimed Yan and Pu.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙酉，忠臣等宮破賊於中牟，進軍，又敗賊於汴州郭外，乃攻之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, yiyou: loyal armies broke the bandits at Zhongmou, advanced, defeated them again outside Bian, and besieged the city.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, imperial troops routed Lingyao at Zhongmou and again outside Bian, then besieged the city.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，承嗣遣侄悅率兵三萬援靈耀。

translations.literal: On yichou, Chengsi sent his nephew Yue with thirty thousand to aid Lingyao.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Chengsi sent thirty thousand under his nephew Yue to rescue Lingyao.

sentences.zh: 丙午，淮西、河陽之師合擊田悅營，其眾大敗，悅脫身北走。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Huai-xi and Heyang forces jointly struck Tian Yue's camp; his masses were crushed and Yue fled north bare.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, loyal armies shattered Tian Yue's camp and he fled north.

sentences.zh: 靈耀聞悅之敗，棄城遁走。

translations.literal: Hearing of Yue's defeat, Lingyao abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: When Lingyao heard Yue had lost, he abandoned Bian and ran.

sentences.zh: 汴州平。

translations.literal: Bianzhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Bian was recovered.

sentences.zh: 丁未，滑將杜如江生擒靈耀而獻。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Hua officer Du Rujiang captured Lingyao alive and presented him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Du Rujiang took Lingyao alive and sent him to court.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，加平盧淄青節度使、檢校尚書左僕射、青州刺史、饒陽王李正己為檢校司空、同中書門下平章事，成德軍節度使、太子太傅、檢校尚書左僕射、隴西郡王李寶臣檢校司空、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, dinghai: Pinglu-Ziqing commissioner, acting left vice director, Qing prefect, and Prince of Raoyang Li Zhengji was made acting grand master and fellow grand councilor; Chengde commissioner, grand tutor of the heir, acting left vice director, and Prince of Longxi Li Baochen was made acting grand master and fellow grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Li Zhengji and Li Baochen were both made acting grand masters and fellow grand councilors.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，涇原節度使、檢校尚書左僕射、知省事、扶風郡王馬璘卒。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Jingyuan commissioner, acting left vice director, director of state affairs, and Prince of Fufeng Ma Lin died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Ma Lin of Jingyuan, left vice director, died.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以涇原節度副使、試太常卿、張掖郡王段秀實權知河東節度留後，北都留守薛兼訓病故也。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Jingyuan deputy commissioner, trial minister of ceremonies, and Prince of Zhangye Duan Xiushi was made acting Hedong commissioner—northern capital guardian Xue Jianxun had died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Duan Xiushi acted for Hedong after Xue Jianxun's death.

sentences.zh: 昭義節度使李承昭搞表稱疾，以澤潞行軍司馬李抱真權知磁、邢兵馬留後。

translations.literal: Zhaoyi commissioner Li Chengzhao memorialized illness; Ze-Lu marching chief Li Baozhen was made acting Ci-Xing military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chengzhao claimed illness; Li Baozhen took acting command of Ci and Xing.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，加淮西節度、檢校右僕射、安州刺史、西平郡王李忠臣檢校司空、同中書門下平章事，仍兼汴州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Huai-xi commissioner, acting right vice director, An prefect, and Prince of Xiping Li Zhongchen was made acting grand master and fellow grand councilor, still concurrent Bian prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Li Zhongchen became grand councilor while keeping Bian.

sentences.zh: 大歷十二年十二年春正月甲寅朔。

translations.literal: Dali 12, spring, first month, jiayin new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Dali 12 opened on the jiayin new moon of the first spring month.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以四鎮北庭涇原節度副使、知節度使事、張掖郡王段秀實為涇州刺史、兼御史大夫，充本州團練使。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Four Garrisons-Northern Court-Jingyuan deputy commissioner and acting commissioner, Prince of Zhangye Duan Xiushi was made Jing prefect, concurrent censor-in-chief, and training commissioner of that prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Duan Xiushi became Jing prefect and its training commissioner.

sentences.zh: 月掩軒轅。

translations.literal: The moon occulted the Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: The moon passed before the Chariot.

sentences.zh: 渤海使獻日本國舞女十一人。

translations.literal: Bohai envoys presented eleven Japanese dancing girls.
translations.idiomatic: Bohai presented eleven Japanese dancers.

sentences.zh: 癸酉夜，月掩心前大星，又入南斗魁。

translations.literal: Night of guiyou, the moon occulted the great star before the Heart and also entered the southern Dipper leader.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of guiyou the moon occulted the Heart and entered the Dipper's leader.

sentences.zh: 京師旱，分命祈禱。

translations.literal: The capital was dry; orders went out for prayers in separate quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Drought in the capital brought orders for prayers throughout the city.

sentences.zh: 二月戊子，淄青節度使李正己之子納為青州刺史，充淄青節度留後。

translations.literal: Second month, wuzi: Ziqing commissioner Li Zhengji's son Na was made Qing prefect and acting Ziqing commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Li Zhengji's son Na became Qing prefect and acting Ziqing commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以朗州刺史李國清為黔州刺史、經略招討觀察使。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Lang prefect Li Guoqing was made Qian prefect and defense, pacification, recruitment, and observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Li Guoqing became Qian prefect and southwestern commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，河西隴右副元帥、鳳翔懷澤潞秦隴等州節度觀察等使、兵部尚書門下平章事、潞州大都督府長史、知鳳翔府事、上柱國、涼國公李抱玉卒。

translations.literal: Third month, yimao: Hexi-Longyou deputy commander, Fengxiang-Huai-Ze-Lu-Qin-Long commissioner, minister of war, fellow grand councilor, Lu chief administrator, acting Fengxiang metropolitan prefect, pillar of state, and Duke of Liang Li Baoyu died.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Li Baoyu of Fengxiang and many commands died.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，月入太微。

translations.literal: On renxu, the moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以太原少尹、河東節度行軍司馬、權知河留後鮑防為太原尹、御史大夫，充北都留守、河東節度使。

translations.literal: On guihai, Taiyuan junior metropolitan prefect, Hedong marching chief, and acting Hedong commissioner Bao Fang was made Taiyuan metropolitan prefect, censor-in-chief, northern capital guardian, and Hedong commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Bao Fang became Taiyuan prefect and Hedong commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊辰夜，月逼心前星。

translations.literal: Night of wuchen, the moon pressed the star before the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of wuchen the moon neared the Heart.

sentences.zh: 庚午，左降官永州刺史田承嗣復授魏博節度使，餘官並如故。

translations.literal: On gengwu, demoted official Yongzhou prefect Tian Chengsi was restored as Weibo commissioner; other posts as before.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Chengsi was restored to Weibo after his demotion to Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 承嗣侄悅、子綰緒綸並復舊官。

translations.literal: Chengsi's nephew Yue and sons Guan, Xu, and Lun likewise recovered their old posts.
translations.idiomatic: His nephew Yue and sons Guan, Xu, and Lun regained their offices.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，宰相元載、王縉得罪下獄，命吏部尚書劉晏訊鞫之。

translations.literal: On gengchen, chief ministers Yuan Zai and Wang Jin were charged and imprisoned; Minister of Personnel Liu Yan was ordered to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Yuan Zai and Wang Jin were jailed; Liu Yan was told to try them.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，制：中書侍郎、平章事元載賜自盡，門下侍郎、平章事王縉貶括州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinsi, decree: drafting vice director and fellow councilor Yuan Zai was granted suicide; Chancellery vice director and fellow councilor Wang Jin was demoted to Kuozhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Yuan Zai was ordered to kill himself and Wang Jin was sent to Kuozhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬午，以朝議大夫、守太常卿、兼修國史楊綰為中書侍郎，尚書禮部郎、集賢院學士常袞為門下侍郎，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, renwu: court gentleman and acting minister of ceremonies and state-history compiler Yang Wan was made drafting vice director; ministry of rites director and Hanlin academician Chang Gai was made Chancellery vice director—both fellow grand councilors.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Yang Wan and Chang Gai became the new chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以右庶子潘炎為禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: On guiwei, right heir-apparent tutor Pan Yan was made vice minister of rites.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Pan Yan became vice minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 貶吏部侍郎楊炎為道州司馬，元載黨也。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Personnel Yang Yan was demoted to Daozhou aide—Yuan Zai's faction.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yan, Zai's man, was banished to Daozhou.

sentences.zh: 諫議大夫、知制誥韓洄王定包佶徐璜，戶部侍郎趙縱，大理少卿裴翼，太常少卿王紞，起居舍人韓會等十餘人，皆坐元載貶官也。

translations.literal: Remonstrating grand master and drafting drafter Han Hui, Wang Ding, Bao Ji, Xu Huang, Vice Minister of Revenue Zhao Zong, assistant minister of justice Pei Yi, vice minister of ceremonies Wang He, and recorder Han Hui and more than ten others were all demoted for Yuan Zai.
translations.idiomatic: More than ten of Zai's allies, including Han Hui and Zhao Zong, were demoted with him.

sentences.zh: 給事中杜亞使魏州，賜田承嗣鐵券。

translations.literal: Drafting drafter Du Ya, on mission to Weizhou, granted Tian Chengsi an iron certificate.
translations.idiomatic: Du Ya, en route to Weizhou, gave Chengsi an iron amnesty bond.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以前秘書監李揆為睦州刺史。

translations.literal: On guisi, former secretary supervisor Li Kui was made Muzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Li Kui was made Muzhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 揆故宰相，為元載所忌，二十年流落丐食江湖間，載誅，方得為郡。

translations.literal: Kui had been chief minister; Yuan Zai hated him; for twenty years he wandered begging on rivers and lakes; when Zai was executed he finally received a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Li Kui, once chancellor, had begged on the waterways twenty years until Zai's fall won him a post again.

sentences.zh: 又召顏真卿於湖州，亦載所忌斥外也。

translations.literal: Yan Zhenqing was also recalled from Huzhou—he too had been driven out by Zai.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Zhenqing was recalled from Huzhou, another exile Zai had engineered.

sentences.zh: 乙未，月掩心前星。

translations.literal: On yimi, the moon occulted the star before the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On yimi the moon occulted the Heart.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，西川破吐蕃於望漢城，擒蕃將大籠官論器然以獻。

translations.literal: On dingyou, western Sichuan defeated Tibet at Wanghan city and presented the captive general Dalon Gar Lunqiran.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, western Sichuan beat Tibet at Wanghan and sent up the general Lunqiran.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以前商州刺史烏崇福為安南都護、本營經略使。

translations.literal: On renyin, former Shang prefect Wu Chongfu was made protector of Annan and commissioner of that garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Wu Chongfu became protector of Annan.

sentences.zh: 渤海、奚、契丹、室韋、靺鞨並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Bohai, Xi, Khitan, Shiwei, and Mohe all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Bohai, Xi, Khitan, Shiwei, and Mohe presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 己酉，加京官料錢，文武班諸司共二千七百九十六員，文官一千八五十四員，武官九百四十二員，歲加給一十五萬六千貫，並舊給凡二十六萬貫。

translations.literal: On jiyou, capital officials' stipends were increased: civil and military bureaus totaled 2,796 posts—1,854 civil, 942 military—adding 156,000 strings yearly, 260,000 with the old pay.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the court raised stipends for 2,796 posts, adding 156,000 strings a year.

sentences.zh: 以關內副元帥、兵馬使渾瑊兼邠州刺史。

translations.literal: Inner frontier deputy commander and military commissioner Hun Jian was made concurrent Bing prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Hun Jian of the inner frontier also became Bing prefect.

sentences.zh: 五月辛亥。

translations.literal: Fifth month, xinhai.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai of the fifth month,

sentences.zh: 罷天下州團練守捉使名。

translations.literal: The name "training and defense commissioner" was abolished throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit training and defense commissioners were abolished empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，諸道邸務在上都名曰留後，改為進奏院。

translations.literal: On jiayin, circuit relay offices in the upper capital called "acting commissioner" were renamed presentation courts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, capital relay offices of acting commissioners were renamed presentation courts.

sentences.zh: 丙辰夜，月入太微。

translations.literal: Night of bingchen, the moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of bingchen the moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，貶刑部尚書王昂連州刺史，昂至萬州卒。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Minister of Punishments Wang Ang was demoted to Lianzhou prefect; Ang died at Wanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Wang Ang was sent to Lianzhou and died at Wan.

sentences.zh: 庚午，敕毀元載祖、父墳，剖棺棄骸，焚毀私廟主於大寧里。

translations.literal: On gengwu, an edict destroyed the tombs of Yuan Zai's grandfather and father, opened the coffins and cast out the bones, and burned the private temple tablets in Daning ward.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the court desecrated Zai's family tombs and burned his private ancestral tablets.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以前安南都護張伯儀為廣州刺史、兼御史大夫，充嶺南節度使。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, former protector of Annan Zhang Boyi was made Guangzhou prefect, concurrent censor-in-chief, and Lingnan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Zhang Boyi became Guangzhou prefect and Lingnan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳，時小旱，上齋居祈禱，聖體不康，是日不視朝。

translations.literal: Sixth month, guisi: slight drought; the emperor fasted and prayed; his sacred person was unwell; that day he did not hold court.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi a light drought and illness kept the emperor from court while he fasted and prayed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊午，罷潤州丹陽軍、蘇州長洲軍。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, wuwu: Runzhou Danyang army and Suzhou Changwu army were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, armies at Danyang and Changwu were disbanded.

sentences.zh: 己巳，中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事、集賢殿崇文館大學士、兼修國史楊綰卒。

translations.literal: On jisi, drafting vice director, fellow grand councilor, Hanlin grand academician of the Chongwen Hall, and state-history compiler Yang Wan died.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, chief minister Yang Wan died.

sentences.zh: 八月癸巳，賜東川節度使鮮於叔明姓李氏。

translations.literal: Eighth month, guisi: eastern Sichuan commissioner Xianyu Shuming was granted the surname Li.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Xianyu Shuming of eastern Sichuan received the surname Li.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，宰臣讓賜食。

translations.literal: On guimao, chief ministers declined gifted meals.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the chief ministers refused imperial meals.

sentences.zh: 先是元載、王縉輔政，每日賜食，因為故事。

translations.literal: Earlier when Yuan Zai and Wang Jin held power, daily meals were granted and this became precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Zai and Wang Jin had made daily imperial meals a precedent for chancellors.

sentences.zh: 至是，常袞等上表云：「飧錢已多，更頒御膳，胡顏自安，乞停賜食。

translations.literal: Now Chang Gai and others memorialized: "Stipends are already ample; to receive imperial fare besides—how could we bear the shame? We beg the gifted meals be stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Gai wrote: "Our pay is already lavish; daily palace meals shame us—please stop them.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed."

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以湖州刺史顏真卿為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Huzhou prefect Yan Zhenqing was made minister of punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Yan Zhenqing became minister of punishments.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以久雨宥常參百僚，不許御史點班。

translations.literal: On yisi, because of long rain the regular court officials were amnestied; censors were forbidden to mark absences.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, long rain brought amnesty for regular officials and barred censors from marking absences.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯，許以庶人禮葬元載。

translations.literal: Ninth month, yimao: Yuan Zai was permitted burial as a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Yuan Zai was allowed a commoner's funeral.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以涇原節度副使段秀實為四鎮北庭行營、涇原鄭潁等節度使。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Jingyuan deputy commissioner Duan Xiushi was made Four Garrisons-Northern Court field commissioner and Jingyuan-Zheng-Ying military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Duan Xiushi took the Four Garrisons and Jingyuan-Zheng-Ying commands.

sentences.zh: 庚午，吐蕃寇坊州，掠黨項羊馬而去。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Tibet raided Fangzhou and drove off Tangut sheep and horses.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Tibet raided Fang and carried off Tangut herds.

sentences.zh: 是秋，宋、亳、陳、滑等州水。

translations.literal: That autumn Song, Bo, Chen, and Hua flooded.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn floods struck Song, Bo, Chen, and Hua.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁亥，戶部待郎、判度支韓滉言解縣兩池生瑞鹽，乃置祠，號寶應靈慶池。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, dinghai: Vice Minister of Revenue and fiscal commissioner Han Huang reported auspicious salt at the two Jie county ponds; a shrine was established, titled the Baoying Spirit-Blessing Pond.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Han Huang reported miracle salt at Jie and founded the Baoying Spirit-Blessing shrine.

sentences.zh: 壬寅夜，月掩昴，又入太微。

translations.literal: Night of renyin, the moon occulted Mao and also entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of renyin the moon occulted Mao and entered the Supreme Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以滑州牙將劉洽為宋州刺史。

translations.literal: On yisi, Hua guard officer Liu Qia was made Song prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Liu Qia of Hua became Song prefect.

sentences.zh: 京兆尹黎幹奏水損田三萬一千頃。

translations.literal: Capital metropolitan prefect Li Gan reported thirty-one thousand mu of flood-damaged fields.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gan reported thirty-one thousand mu of fields ruined by flood.

sentences.zh: 度支使韓滉奏所損不多。

translations.literal: Fiscal commissioner Han Huang memorialized the damage was not great.
translations.idiomatic: Han Huang said the damage was slight.

sentences.zh: 兼渭南令劉藻曲附滉，亦云部內田不損。

translations.literal: Concurrent Weinan magistrate Liu Zao curried favor with Huang and likewise said fields in his district were undamaged.
translations.idiomatic: Weinan magistrate Liu Zao, flattering Huang, denied any local damage.

sentences.zh: 差御史趙計檢渭南田，亦附滉云不損。

translations.literal: Censor Zhao Ji inspected Weinan fields and also followed Huang in saying undamaged.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Zhao Ji inspected Weinan and also denied damage.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「水旱咸均，不宜渭南獨免。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Flood and drought should be equal—Weinan alone should not be exempt.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Flood and drought ought to fall on all alike—Weinan cannot stand alone.

sentences.zh: 」復命御史朱敖檢之，渭南損田三千頃。

translations.literal: " Censor Zhu Ao was again ordered to inspect; Weinan damaged fields three thousand mu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Ao found three thousand mu ruined in Weinan."

sentences.zh: 上嘆息曰：「縣令職在字人，不損亦宜稱損，損而不聞，豈有恤隱之意耶！

translations.literal: The emperor sighed and said: "A magistrate's duty is to cherish the people; even if undamaged he should claim damage—if damaged and unreported, where is compassionate care!
translations.idiomatic: He sighed: "A magistrate should shield the people—even without damage he should report some; to hide real loss is cruelty.

sentences.zh: 劉藻、趙計皆貶官。

translations.literal: Liu Zao and Zhao Ji were both demoted."
translations.idiomatic: He demoted Liu Zao and Zhao Ji."

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑，太白臨哭星。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, guichou: Venus stood at the Weeping star.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Venus stood at the Weeping star.

sentences.zh: 乙卯夜，月入羽林。

translations.literal: Night of yimao, the moon entered the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of yimao the moon entered the Feathered Forest.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以右散騎常侍蕭昕為工閱尚書。

translations.literal: On guiyou, right regular cavalry attendant Xiao Xin was made minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Xiao Xin became minister of works.

sentences.zh: 刑部尚書顏真卿獻所著《韻海鏡源》三百六十卷。

translations.literal: Minister of Punishments Yan Zhenqing presented his work Rhyme Sea Mirror Source in 360 juan.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Zhenqing presented his 360-juan Rhyme Sea Mirror Source.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，西川崔寧奏於西山破吐蕃十萬，斬首八千，生擒九百人。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, dinghai: western Sichuan Cui Ning memorialized defeating one hundred thousand Tibet west of the mountains, eight thousand heads, nine hundred captives.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Cui Ning reported crushing one hundred thousand Tibetans west of the mountains.

sentences.zh: 己亥，天下仙洞靈跡禁樵捕。

translations.literal: On jihai, logging and hunting at all immortal grottoes and numinous sites in the realm were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the court banned logging and hunting at sacred sites empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以幽州節度使朱泚兼隴右節度副大使，權知河西、澤潞行營兵馬事。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Youzhou commissioner Zhu Ci was made concurrent Longyou deputy commander and acting commissioner of Hexi and Ze-Lu field armies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Zhu Ci also took Longyou and field command over Hexi and Ze-Lu.

sentences.zh: 京兆尹請修六門堰，許之。

translations.literal: The capital metropolitan prefect asked to repair the Six-Gate weir; approved.
translations.idiomatic: The capital prefect won approval to repair the Six-Gate weir.

sentences.zh: 大歷十三年十三年春正月戊申朔。

translations.literal: Dali 13, spring, first month, wushen new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Dali 13 opened on the wushen new moon of the first spring month.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，壞白渠碾磑八十餘所，以奪農溉田也。

translations.literal: On xinyou, more than eighty mills on the White Canal were destroyed to restore irrigation to farmland.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, eighty White Canal mills were torn down to free water for fields.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，刑部尚書、魯郡公顏真卿三抗章乞致仕，不允。

translations.literal: On renxu, Minister of Punishments and Duke of Lu Yan Zhenqing thrice memorialized begging retirement; not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Yan Zhenqing thrice asked to retire and was refused.

sentences.zh: 淄青節度使李正己請附屬籍，從之。

translations.literal: Ziqing commissioner Li Zhengji asked to be entered in the imperial genealogy; approved.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhengji was allowed to enter the imperial clan register.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，回紇寇太原，鮑防與之戰，我師不利。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Uyghurs raided Taiyuan; Bao Fang fought them; our army was unfavorable.
